function renderWorkbenchForecastEdges() {
  const layer = document.getElementById('kw-forecast-edge-layer');
  const board = document.getElementById('kw-forecast-workflow-board');
  const viewport = document.getElementById('kw-forecast-stage-viewport');
  if (!layer || !board) return;
  const nodes = Array.isArray(kwForecastGraph.nodes) ? kwForecastGraph.nodes : [];
  const edges = Array.isArray(kwForecastGraph.edges) ? kwForecastGraph.edges : [];
  const width = Math.max(1800, ...nodes.map((item) => Number(item.x || 0) + 280));
  const height = Math.max(760, ...nodes.map((item) => Number(item.y || 0) + 180));
  board.style.width = `${width}px`;
  board.style.height = `${height}px`;
  if (viewport) {
    viewport.style.width = `${width}px`;
    viewport.style.height = `${height}px`;
  }
  layer.setAttribute('width', String(width));
  layer.setAttribute('height', String(height));
  layer.setAttribute('viewBox', `0 0 ${width} ${height}`);
  layer.innerHTML = `
    <defs>
      <marker id="kw-workflow-arrowhead" viewBox="0 0 12 12" refX="10" refY="6" markerWidth="12" markerHeight="12" markerUnits="userSpaceOnUse" orient="auto">
        <path d="M 0 1 L 11 6 L 0 11 z" fill="rgba(47, 116, 192, 0.96)"></path>
      </marker>
    </defs>
    ${edges.map((edge) => {
      const fromNode = nodes.find((item) => item.id === edge.from);
      const toNode = nodes.find((item) => item.id === edge.to);
      if (!fromNode || !toNode) return '';
      const startX = Number(fromNode.x || 0) + 220;
      const startY = Number(fromNode.y || 0) + 52;
      const endX = Number(toNode.x || 0);
      const endY = Number(toNode.y || 0) + 52;
      const deltaX = endX - startX;
      const controlOffset = Math.max(80, Math.min(180, Math.abs(deltaX) * 0.45));
      const controlA = startX + (deltaX >= 0 ? controlOffset : -controlOffset);
      const controlB = endX - (deltaX >= 0 ? controlOffset : -controlOffset);
      const path = `M ${startX} ${startY} C ${controlA} ${startY}, ${controlB} ${endY}, ${endX} ${endY}`;
      return `
        <g data-edge-id="${escapeAttr(edge.id || '')}">
          <path class="kw-workflow-edge-shadow" d="${path}"></path>
          <path class="kw-workflow-edge" d="${path}" marker-end="url(#kw-workflow-arrowhead)"></path>
          <circle class="kw-workflow-edge-anchor" cx="${startX}" cy="${startY}" r="5"></circle>
          <circle class="kw-workflow-edge-anchor" cx="${endX}" cy="${endY}" r="5"></circle>
        </g>
      `;
    }).join('')}
  `;
}

function bindWorkbenchForecastGraphEvents() {
  document.querySelectorAll('.kw-workflow-node').forEach((node) => {
    node.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
      if (event.target instanceof HTMLElement && event.target.dataset.portAction) return;
      kwSelectedForecastNodeId = node.dataset.nodeId || '';
      renderWorkbenchForecastWorkflow();
      renderWorkbenchForecastConfigBoard();
      renderWorkbenchForecastNodeDebug();
    });
    node.addEventListener('pointerdown', (event) => {
      if (event.target instanceof HTMLElement && event.target.dataset.portAction) return;
      const nodeId = node.dataset.nodeId || '';
      const item = (kwForecastGraph.nodes || []).find((row) => row.id === nodeId);
      if (!item) return;
      kwSelectedForecastNodeId = nodeId;
      kwForecastDragState = {
        nodeId,
        startX: event.clientX,
        startY: event.clientY,
        originX: Number(item.x || 0),
        originY: Number(item.y || 0),
      };
      node.setPointerCapture?.(event.pointerId);
    });
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-port-action="link"]').forEach((node) => {
    node.addEventListener('pointerdown', (event) => {
      const target = event.currentTarget;
      if (!(target instanceof HTMLElement) || !target.closest('.kw-workflow-node')) return;
      kwForecastLinkState = {from: target.dataset.nodeId || ''};
      renderWorkbenchForecastWorkflow();
      renderWorkbenchForecastConfigBoard();
      event.preventDefault();
    });
    node.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
      const target = event.currentTarget;
      if (!(target instanceof HTMLElement) || !target.closest('.kw-workflow-node')) return;
      kwForecastLinkState = {from: target.dataset.nodeId || ''};
      renderWorkbenchForecastWorkflow();
      renderWorkbenchForecastConfigBoard();
    });
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-port-action="select"]').forEach((node) => {
    node.addEventListener('pointerup', (event) => {
      const target = event.currentTarget;
      if (!(target instanceof HTMLElement) || !target.closest('.kw-workflow-node')) return;
      const nodeId = target.dataset.nodeId || '';
      if (kwForecastLinkState?.from && kwForecastLinkState.from !== nodeId) {
        addWorkbenchForecastEdge(kwForecastLinkState.from, nodeId);
        kwForecastLinkState = null;
        renderWorkbenchForecastWorkflow();
        renderWorkbenchForecastConfigBoard();
        renderWorkbenchForecastNodeDebug();
        showToast('连线已完成');
        event.preventDefault();
      }
    });
    node.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
      const target = event.currentTarget;
      if (!(target instanceof HTMLElement) || !target.closest('.kw-workflow-node')) return;
      const nodeId = target.dataset.nodeId || '';
      if (kwForecastLinkState?.from && kwForecastLinkState.from !== nodeId) {
        addWorkbenchForecastEdge(kwForecastLinkState.from, nodeId);
        kwForecastLinkState = null;
        renderWorkbenchForecastWorkflow();
        renderWorkbenchForecastConfigBoard();
        renderWorkbenchForecastNodeDebug();
        showToast('连线已完成');
        return;
      }
      kwSelectedForecastNodeId = nodeId;
      renderWorkbenchForecastWorkflow();
      renderWorkbenchForecastConfigBoard();
      renderWorkbenchForecastNodeDebug();
    });
  });
}

window.addEventListener('pointermove', (event) => {
  if (!kwForecastDragState) return;
  const item = (kwForecastGraph.nodes || []).find((row) => row.id === kwForecastDragState.nodeId);
  if (!item) return;
  const zoom = kwForecastZoom || 1;
  item.x = Math.max(8, kwForecastDragState.originX + (event.clientX - kwForecastDragState.startX) / zoom);
  item.y = Math.max(8, kwForecastDragState.originY + (event.clientY - kwForecastDragState.startY) / zoom);
  renderWorkbenchForecastWorkflow();
  renderWorkbenchForecastConfigBoard();
  renderWorkbenchForecastNodeDebug();
});

window.addEventListener('pointerup', () => {
  kwForecastDragState = null;
});

function addWorkbenchForecastNode(processor) {
  const catalog = Array.isArray(kwForecastWorkflowMeta.catalog) ? kwForecastWorkflowMeta.catalog : [];
  const spec = catalog.find((item) => item.processor === processor) || {label: processor, params: []};
  const nextIndex = (kwForecastGraph.nodes || []).length + 1;
  const nodeId = `${processor}_${Date.now()}_${nextIndex}`;
  const params = {};
  (spec.params || []).forEach((item) => {
    params[item.key] = '';
  });
  kwForecastGraph.nodes.push({
    id: nodeId,
    label: spec.label || processor,
    processor,
    x: 120 + (nextIndex % 3) * 260,
    y: 120 + Math.floor(nextIndex / 3) * 120,
    params,
  });
  kwSelectedForecastNodeId = nodeId;
  renderWorkbenchForecastWorkflow();
  renderWorkbenchForecastConfigBoard();
  renderWorkbenchForecastNodeDebug();
}

function addWorkbenchForecastEdge(fromId, toId) {
  if (!fromId || !toId || fromId === toId) return;
  if ((kwForecastGraph.edges || []).some((item) => item.from === fromId && item.to === toId)) return;
  kwForecastGraph.edges.push({id: `edge_${Date.now()}_${kwForecastGraph.edges.length + 1}`, from: fromId, to: toId});
}

function deleteWorkbenchForecastNode() {
  if (!kwSelectedForecastNodeId) return;
  kwForecastGraph.nodes = (kwForecastGraph.nodes || []).filter((item) => item.id !== kwSelectedForecastNodeId);
  kwForecastGraph.edges = (kwForecastGraph.edges || []).filter((item) => item.from !== kwSelectedForecastNodeId && item.to !== kwSelectedForecastNodeId);
  kwSelectedForecastNodeId = (kwForecastGraph.nodes || [])[0]?.id || '';
  renderWorkbenchForecastWorkflow();
  renderWorkbenchForecastConfigBoard();
  renderWorkbenchForecastNodeDebug();
}

function centerWorkbenchForecastView() {
  const stage = document.querySelector('#workbench-section-forecast-model .kw-workflow-stage');
  const viewport = document.getElementById('kw-forecast-stage-viewport');
  if (!stage) return;
  const targetWidth = viewport ? viewport.offsetWidth * kwForecastZoom : stage.scrollWidth;
  const targetHeight = viewport ? viewport.offsetHeight * kwForecastZoom : stage.scrollHeight;
  stage.scrollLeft = Math.max(0, (targetWidth - stage.clientWidth) / 2);
  stage.scrollTop = Math.max(0, (targetHeight - stage.clientHeight) / 2);
}

function collectWorkbenchForecastConfig() {
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-kw-forecast-field]').forEach((fieldNode) => {
    const field = fieldNode.dataset.kwForecastField;
    if (!field) return;
    kwForecastConfig[field] = Number(fieldNode.value || 0);
  });
  const selectedNode = (kwForecastGraph.nodes || []).find((item) => item.id === kwSelectedForecastNodeId);
  if (selectedNode) {
    const labelNode = document.querySelector('[data-kw-node-label]');
    if (labelNode instanceof HTMLInputElement) {
      selectedNode.label = labelNode.value || selectedNode.label;
    }
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-kw-node-param]').forEach((fieldNode) => {
      const field = fieldNode.dataset.kwNodeParam;
      if (!field) return;
      selectedNode.params = selectedNode.params || {};
      selectedNode.params[field] = fieldNode.value;
    });
  }
  kwForecastGraph.tuning = {...kwForecastConfig};
}

async function loadWorkbenchForecastModel(forceReload) {
  if (kwForecastLoaded && !forceReload && kwForecastEditorBootstrapped) return;
  const res = await fetch('/api/admin/forecast-config');
  const data = await res.json();
  if (!res.ok || data.ok === false) throw new Error(data.error || 'forecast_config_failed');
  kwForecastConfig = data.config || {};
  kwForecastWorkflowMeta = data.workflow_meta || {};
  kwForecastGraph = kwForecastWorkflowMeta.graph || {nodes: [], edges: [], tuning: kwForecastConfig};
  kwForecastGraph.tuning = {...kwForecastConfig};
  kwSelectedForecastNodeId = (kwForecastGraph.nodes || [])[0]?.id || '';
  kwForecastLoaded = true;
  renderWorkbenchForecastWorkflow();
  renderWorkbenchForecastConfigBoard();
  renderWorkbenchForecastNodeDebug();
  centerWorkbenchForecastView();
}

async function saveWorkbenchForecastConfigs() {
  collectWorkbenchForecastConfig();
  const statusNode = document.getElementById('kw-forecast-save-status');
  if (statusNode) statusNode.textContent = '保存中...';
  const res = await fetch('/api/admin/forecast-config', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
    body: JSON.stringify({graph: {...kwForecastGraph, tuning: kwForecastConfig}, config: kwForecastConfig}),
  });
  const data = await res.json();
  if (!res.ok || data.ok === false) throw new Error(data.error || 'save_failed');
  kwForecastConfig = data.config || {};
  kwForecastWorkflowMeta = data.workflow_meta || {};
  kwForecastGraph = kwForecastWorkflowMeta.graph || kwForecastGraph;
  kwForecastGraph.tuning = {...kwForecastConfig};
  kwSelectedForecastNodeId = (kwForecastGraph.nodes || [])[0]?.id || '';
  renderWorkbenchForecastWorkflow();
  renderWorkbenchForecastConfigBoard();
  renderWorkbenchForecastNodeDebug();
  if (statusNode) statusNode.textContent = '预测算法配置已保存';
  showToast('预测算法配置已保存');
}

function initWorkbenchForecastEditorEvents() {
  if (kwForecastEditorBootstrapped) return;
  kwForecastEditorBootstrapped = true;
  document.getElementById('kw-save-forecast-configs')?.addEventListener('click', async () => {
    try {
      await saveWorkbenchForecastConfigs();
    } catch (error) {
      showToast(error.message || '保存失败');
    }
  });
  document.getElementById('kw-forecast-reset-graph')?.addEventListener('click', async () => {
    try {
      await resetWorkbenchForecastGraph();
    } catch (error) {
      showToast(error.message || '恢复失败');
    }
  });
  document.getElementById('kw-forecast-center-view')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
    centerWorkbenchForecastView();
  });
  document.getElementById('kw-forecast-zoom-in')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
    kwForecastZoom = Math.min(1.8, Number((kwForecastZoom + 0.1).toFixed(2)));
    applyWorkbenchForecastZoom();
  });
  document.getElementById('kw-forecast-zoom-out')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
    kwForecastZoom = Math.max(0.6, Number((kwForecastZoom - 0.1).toFixed(2)));

  });
}

  url.searchParams.set('section', name);
  window.history.replaceState({}, '', url);

const WORKBENCH_NAV_STORAGE_KEY = 'gangtise-workbench-nav-groups-v1';

function readWorkbenchNavState() {
  try {
    return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(WORKBENCH_NAV_STORAGE_KEY) || '{}');
  } catch (error) {
    return {};
  }
}

function writeWorkbenchNavState(state) {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(WORKBENCH_NAV_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(state || {}));
  } catch (error) {
    // ignore storage write failures
  }
}

function setWorkbenchNavGroupCollapsed(groupEl, collapsed) {
  if (!groupEl) return;
  groupEl.classList.toggle('is-collapsed', !!collapsed);
  const toggle = groupEl.querySelector('.admin-nav-group-toggle');
  if (toggle) toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', collapsed ? 'false' : 'true');
}

function toggleWorkbenchNavGroup(toggleEl) {
  const groupEl = toggleEl ? toggleEl.closest('.admin-nav-group') : null;
  if (!groupEl) return;
  const collapsed = !groupEl.classList.contains('is-collapsed');
  setWorkbenchNavGroupCollapsed(groupEl, collapsed);
  const state = readWorkbenchNavState();
  const key = groupEl.dataset.navGroup;
  if (key) {
    state[key] = collapsed;
    writeWorkbenchNavState(state);
  }
}

function initWorkbenchNavGroups() {
  const state = readWorkbenchNavState();
  document.querySelectorAll('.admin-nav-group[data-nav-group]').forEach((groupEl) => {
    const key = groupEl.dataset.navGroup;
    const collapsed = !!state[key];
    setWorkbenchNavGroupCollapsed(groupEl, collapsed);
  });
}

function showToast(message) {
  const toast = document.getElementById('toast');
  if (!toast) return;
  toast.textContent = message;
  toast.classList.add('show');

}

function kwBizChart(hostId, option, emptyMessage = '当前暂无可展示的数据') {
  const host = document.getElementById(hostId);
  if (!host) return;
  const series = Array.isArray(option && option.series) ? option.series : [];
  const hasValues = series.some((item) => {
    const data = item && item.data;
    return Array.isArray(data) && data.length > 0;
  });
  if (!hasValues) {
    host.innerHTML = `<div class="kw-biz-chart-empty">${escapeHtml(emptyMessage)}</div>`;
    return;
  }
  if (!window.GangtiseEcharts || typeof window.GangtiseEcharts.render !== 'function') {
    host.innerHTML = '<div class="kw-biz-chart-empty">图表组件暂未就绪，请刷新页面后重试</div>';
    return;
  }
  window.requestAnimationFrame(() => {
    const target = document.getElementById(hostId);
    if (!target) return;
    window.GangtiseEcharts.render(target, option);
    window.GangtiseEcharts.flush(target.parentElement || target);
  });
}

async function refreshKwBusinessAnalytics() {
  const tenantSlug = (window.ACTIVE_TENANT && window.ACTIVE_TENANT.slug) || '';
  if (!tenantSlug) return;
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`/api/kol/business-analytics?tenant=${encodeURIComponent(tenantSlug)}`, {cache: 'no-store'});
    const data = await res.json();
    if (!res.ok || data.ok === false) throw new Error(data.error || 'load_business_analytics_failed');
    window.WORKBENCH_DATA = window.WORKBENCH_DATA || {};
    window.WORKBENCH_DATA.stats = data.stats || window.WORKBENCH_DATA.stats || {};
    window.WORKBENCH_DATA.business_analytics = data.analytics || {};
    renderKwOpsStats();
    const section = document.getElementById('workbench-section-biz-dashboard');
    if (section && section.style.display !== 'none') renderKwBizDashboard();
  } catch (error) {
    showToast(error.message || '数据分析加载失败');
  }
}

}

function requestKwFanStatusChange(userId) {
  const fan = kwFans.find((item) => Number(item.id || 0) === Number(userId || 0));
  const modal = document.getElementById('kw-fan-status-modal');
  const host = document.getElementById('kw-fan-status-modal-content');
  if (!fan || !modal || !host) return;
  const nextStatus = fan.status === 'disabled' || fan.status === 'pending_approval' ? 'active' : 'disabled';
  const action = fan.status === 'pending_approval' ? '审批通过' : (nextStatus === 'disabled' ? '停用' : '启用');
  host.innerHTML = `
    <div class="kw-review-modal-head">
      <div>
        <div class="kw-review-modal-title">${action}粉丝账号</div>
        <div class="kw-review-modal-subtitle">当前租户：${escapeHtml((window.ACTIVE_TENANT && window.ACTIVE_TENANT.name) || '--')}</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="kw-card" style="margin-top:12px">
      <div class="kw-card-title">确认${action}“${escapeHtml(fan.username || '该粉丝')}”吗？</div>
      <div class="kw-card-desc" style="margin-top:8px">${fan.status === 'pending_approval' ? '审批通过后，该粉丝才能登录 H5、使用 Hermes 和访问当前租户服务。' : (nextStatus === 'disabled' ? '停用后该粉丝将无法登录 H5、使用 Hermes 或访问当前租户服务，但其自选股、评论、标注和历史数据都会保留。' : '启用后该粉丝可以重新登录当前租户，原有自选股、评论、标注和历史数据会恢复可用。')}</div>
      <div style="display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:8px;margin-top:16px">
        <button class="btn-outline" type="button" style="padding:8px 12px;font-size:12px" onclick="closeKwFanStatusModal()">取消</button>
        <button class="btn-gold" type="button" style="padding:8px 12px;font-size:12px" onclick="confirmKwFanStatusChange(${Number(fan.id || 0)}, '${nextStatus}')">确认${action}</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  `;
  modal.classList.add('show');
}

async function confirmKwFanStatusChange(userId, status) {
  const tenantSlug = (window.ACTIVE_TENANT && window.ACTIVE_TENANT.slug) || '';
  if (!tenantSlug) return;
  const host = document.getElementById('kw-fan-status-modal-content');
  if (host) host.innerHTML += '<div class="kw-dashboard-panel-note" style="margin-top:10px">正在更新账号状态，请稍候...</div>';
  try {
    const response = await fetch(`/api/kol/users/status?tenant=${encodeURIComponent(tenantSlug)}`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
      body: JSON.stringify({user_id: userId, status}),
    });
    const data = await response.json();
    if (!response.ok || data.ok === false) {
      const messages = { tenant_user_not_found: '未找到当前租户下的粉丝账号。', database_unavailable: '数据库当前不可用，请稍后重试。' };
      throw new Error(messages[data.error] || data.error || '账号状态更新失败');
    }
    kwFans = Array.isArray(data.users) ? data.users.map(normalizeKwFan) : kwFans;
    renderKwFans();
    closeKwFanStatusModal();
    await refreshKwBusinessAnalytics();
    showToast(status === 'disabled' ? '粉丝账号已停用' : '粉丝账号已启用');
  } catch (error) {
    if (host) host.innerHTML += `<div style="font-size:12px;color:#F2B8B5;margin-top:10px">${escapeHtml(error.message || '账号状态更新失败')}</div>`;
    showToast(error.message || '账号状态更新失败');
  }
}

function normalizeKwFan(user) {
  const fan = user || {};
  return {
    id: Number(fan.id || 0),
    username: fan.username || fan.name || '',
    membership: fan.membership || fan.tier || '投资者视角',
    is_paid_sample: !!fan.is_paid_sample,
    source: fan.source || fan.source_label || '用户导入',
    created_at: fan.created_at || fan.joined || '--',
    paid_sample_note: fan.paid_sample_note || '',
    labels: Array.isArray(fan.labels) ? fan.labels : (fan.is_paid_sample ? ['付费用户'] : []),
    phone_masked: fan.phone_masked || fan.value || '--',
    status: fan.status || 'active',
  };
}

function toggleKwFanSelection(userId, checked) {
  const normalizedId = Number(userId || 0);
  if (!normalizedId) return;
  if (checked) kwSelectedFanIds.add(normalizedId);
  else kwSelectedFanIds.delete(normalizedId);
  renderKwFans();
}

function toggleKwFanSelectAll(checked) {
  kwSelectedFanIds = checked
    ? new Set(kwFans.map((fan) => Number(fan.id || 0)).filter(Boolean))
    : new Set();
  renderKwFans();

async function loadKwCommerce() {
  const host = document.getElementById('kw-commerce-summary');
  if (!host) return;
  try {
    const response = await fetch(`/api/kol/commerce?tenant=${encodeURIComponent(kwCommerceTenantSlug())}`, {cache:'no-store'});
    const data = await response.json();
    if (!response.ok || !data.ok) throw new Error(data.error || 'commerce_load_failed');
    const commerce = data.commerce || {};
    const settings = commerce.settings || {};
    document.getElementById('kw-commerce-instructions').value = settings.payment_instructions || '';
    document.getElementById('kw-commerce-qr-url').value = settings.collection_qr_url || '';
    document.getElementById('kw-commerce-paywall').value = settings.paywall_enabled ? 'on' : 'off';
    document.getElementById('kw-commerce-review-access').value = settings.default_review_access === 'free' ? 'free' : 'subscriber';

function renderKwCommerceOrders(orders) {
  const host = document.getElementById('kw-commerce-orders');
  if (!host) return;
  const rows = Array.isArray(orders) ? orders : [];
  if (!rows.length) {
    host.innerHTML = '<div class="kw-card-desc">暂无订阅订单。粉丝完成下单后会在这里出现，只有人工核验到账才会开通权益。</div>';

  host.innerHTML = `<div class="table-wrap" style="margin-top:0"><div class="table-header"><div class="table-title">订阅订单</div><span class="kw-tag">最近 ${rows.length} 笔</span></div><table><thead><tr><th>粉丝</th><th>产品 / 金额</th><th>订单号</th><th>状态</th><th>操作</th></tr></thead><tbody>${rows.map((order) => {
    const status = String(order.status || 'pending');
    const statusLabel = {pending:'待确认到账', paid:'已开通', expired:'已过期', cancelled:'已取消', refunded:'已退款'}[status] || status;
    const action = status === 'pending' ? `<button class="btn-gold" type="button" style="padding:5px 9px;font-size:11px" onclick="confirmKwCommerceOrder('${escapeAttr(order.order_no || '')}')">确认到账</button>` : '—';

async function submitKwFanImportRows() {
  const tenantSlug = (window.ACTIVE_TENANT && window.ACTIVE_TENANT.slug) || '';
  const users = collectKwFanImportRows();
  if (!tenantSlug) {
    showToast('tenant_missing');

      method: 'POST',
      headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
      body: JSON.stringify({users}),

  }
  const hub = (window.WORKBENCH_DATA && window.WORKBENCH_DATA.indicator_hub) || {};
  const smartItems = Array.isArray(hub.smart_items) ? hub.smart_items : [];

  return {

function kwBuildFallbackSmartTags(catalog) {
  const tags = [];
  const seen = new Set();
  Object.values(WATCHLIST_DETAILS_MAP || {}).forEach((detail) => {
    const stockCode = String(detail.code || '').toUpperCase();
    const relatedIds = Array.isArray(detail.related_indicator_ids) ? detail.related_indicator_ids : [];
    const relatedNames = Array.isArray(detail.related_indicator_names) ? detail.related_indicator_names : [];
    if (!stockCode || !relatedIds.length) return;
    const tagCode = `watchlist:${stockCode}`;
    if (seen.has(tagCode)) return;
    seen.add(tagCode);
    tags.push({
      tag_code: tagCode,
      label: detail.name || stockCode,
      tag_type: 'watchlist',
      category: detail.industry || '自选股',
      subtitle: '自选股标签',
      selected_indicators: relatedIds.map((indicatorCode, index) => ({
        indicator_code: indicatorCode,
        indicator_name: relatedNames[index] || indicatorCode,
      })),
    });
  });
  (catalog.base_indicators || []).forEach((item) => {
    const indicatorCode = String(item.indicator_code || '').trim();
    if (!indicatorCode) return;
    const tagCode = `indicator:${indicatorCode}`;
    if (seen.has(tagCode)) return;
    seen.add(tagCode);
    tags.push({
      tag_code: tagCode,
      label: item.indicator_name || indicatorCode,
      tag_type: 'indicator',
      category: item.category || '指标',
      subtitle: item.source_type_label || '基础指标',
      selected_indicators: [{ indicator_code: indicatorCode, indicator_name: item.indicator_name || indicatorCode }],
    });
  });
  return tags;
}

function kwFindBaseIndicator(indicatorCode) {

}

function kwFindIndicatorForTag(tagCode) {
  const tag = kwFindSmartTagByCode(tagCode);
  const selectedIndicators = tag && Array.isArray(tag.selected_indicators) ? tag.selected_indicators : [];
  if (!tag || selectedIndicators.length !== 1) return null;
  const indicatorCode = String(selectedIndicators[0].indicator_code || '').trim();
  const smart = kwFindSmartIndicatorCatalogItem(indicatorCode);
  const base = kwFindBaseIndicator(indicatorCode);
  return smart || base || {
    indicator_code: indicatorCode,
    indicator_name: selectedIndicators[0].indicator_name || tag.label || indicatorCode,
    category: tag.category || '指标',
    value: tag.value || '--',
    unit: tag.unit || '',
    assessment: tag.subtitle || '',
    interpretation: tag.subtitle || '',
    selected_indicators: selectedIndicators,
  };
}

function kwGetDirectPreviewCandidate(selectedTagCodes) {
  const tagCodes = Array.isArray(selectedTagCodes) ? selectedTagCodes.filter(Boolean) : [];
  if (tagCodes.length !== 1) return null;
  const prompt = String(kwSmartIndicatorDraft.promptText || '').trim();
  const tag = kwFindSmartTagByCode(tagCodes[0]);
  if (!tag) return null;
  const normalizedLabel = kwNormalizeSmartTagLabel(tag.label);
  if (!normalizedLabel || !new Set([normalizedLabel, `【${normalizedLabel}】`]).has(prompt)) return null;
  const indicator = kwFindIndicatorForTag(tagCodes[0]);
  if (!indicator || !String(indicator.indicator_code || '').trim()) return null;
  const selectedIndicators = Array.isArray(indicator.selected_indicators) && indicator.selected_indicators.length
    ? indicator.selected_indicators
    : [{ indicator_code: indicator.indicator_code, indicator_name: indicator.indicator_name || normalizedLabel }];
  return {
    indicator_code: String(indicator.indicator_code || '').trim(),
    indicator_name: kwSmartIndicatorDraft.indicatorName || indicator.indicator_name || normalizedLabel,
    category: indicator.category || tag.category || '直接引用指标',
    value: indicator.value || '--',
    numeric_value: indicator.numeric_value,
    unit: indicator.unit || '',
    assessment: indicator.interpretation || indicator.assessment || '直接引用原指标，不需要额外加工。',
    interpretation: indicator.interpretation || indicator.assessment || '直接引用原指标，不需要额外加工。',
    algorithm_detail: indicator.algorithm_detail || indicator.description || '直接引用已有指标，不生成新的计算公式。',
    prompt_text: prompt,
    selected_indicators: selectedIndicators,

function kwNormalizeSmartTagLabel(label) {
  return String(label || '').replace(/[【】]/g, '').trim();
}

function kwEscapeRegExp(value) {
  return String(value || '').replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');
}

function kwCollectPromptMatchedTagCodes(promptText, tagCatalog) {
  const prompt = String(promptText || '').trim();
  if (!prompt) return [];
  const normalize = (value) => String(value || '').replace(/[\s_\-.\/：:，,。.!！?？【】\[\]()（）]/g, '').toLowerCase();
  const normalizedPrompt = normalize(prompt);
  const catalog = Array.isArray(tagCatalog) ? tagCatalog.slice() : [];
  const explicitLabels = Array.from(prompt.matchAll(/【([^】]+)】/g)).map((match) => kwNormalizeSmartTagLabel(match[1]));
  // A bracketed label is an explicit formula reference. Do not widen it with
  // fuzzy matching to similarly named historical smart-indicator definitions.
  if (explicitLabels.length) {
    return Array.from(new Set(explicitLabels.map((label) => {
      const tag = catalog.find((item) => kwNormalizeSmartTagLabel(item && item.label) === label);
      return tag && tag.tag_code;
    }).filter(Boolean)));
  }
  return catalog
    .filter((tag) => tag && tag.auto_match !== false)
    .sort((left, right) => kwNormalizeSmartTagLabel(right.label).length - kwNormalizeSmartTagLabel(left.label).length)
    .filter((tag) => {
      const candidates = [tag && tag.label].concat(Array.isArray(tag && tag.prompt_aliases) ? tag.prompt_aliases : []);
      return candidates.some((candidate) => {
        const normalizedCandidate = normalize(kwNormalizeSmartTagLabel(candidate));
        if (!normalizedCandidate) return false;
        if (normalizedPrompt.includes(normalizedCandidate)) return true;
        if (normalizedPrompt.length >= 3 && normalizedCandidate.includes(normalizedPrompt)) return true;
        return normalizedPrompt.length >= 3 && normalizedPrompt.length <= 8 && normalizedCandidate.includes(normalizedPrompt);
      });
    })
    .map((tag) => tag.tag_code)
    .filter(Boolean);
}

function kwEscapeSmartRegExp(value) {
  return String(value || '').replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');
}

function kwCanonicalizeSmartPrompt(promptText, tagCatalog) {
  const source = String(promptText || '');
  const candidates = [];
  const seen = new Set();
  (Array.isArray(tagCatalog) ? tagCatalog : []).filter((tag) => tag && tag.auto_match !== false).forEach((tag) => {
    const label = kwNormalizeSmartTagLabel(tag && tag.label);
    if (!label) return;
    [label].concat(Array.isArray(tag && tag.prompt_aliases) ? tag.prompt_aliases : []).forEach((value) => {
      const alias = kwNormalizeSmartTagLabel(value);
      const key = `${alias}\u0000${label}`;
      if (!alias || alias.length < 2 || seen.has(key)) return;
      seen.add(key);
      candidates.push({ alias, label });
    });
  });
  candidates.sort((left, right) => right.alias.length - left.alias.length);
  if (!candidates.length) return source;
  const pattern = new RegExp(candidates.map((item) => kwEscapeSmartRegExp(item.alias)).join('|'), 'gi');
  // Preserve an unclosed reference while the user is editing it. Otherwise
  // Backspace can turn "【指标" into "【【指标】" on every input event.
  return source.split(/(【[^】]*(?:】|$))/g).map((part) => {
    if (/^【/.test(part)) return part;
    return part.replace(pattern, (match) => {
      const normalized = kwNormalizeSmartTagLabel(match).toLowerCase();
      const found = candidates.find((item) => item.alias.toLowerCase() === normalized);
      return found ? `【${found.label}】` : match;
    });
  }).join('');
}

function kwTokenizeSmartPrompt(promptText, tagCatalog) {
  const prompt = String(promptText || '');
  const tags = Array.isArray(tagCatalog) ? tagCatalog : [];
  if (!prompt) return [];
  return prompt.split(/(【[^】]+】|[+\-*\/()])/g).filter((part) => part !== '').map((part) => {
    if (/^【[^】]+】$/.test(part)) {
      const label = kwNormalizeSmartTagLabel(part);
      const tag = tags.find((item) => kwNormalizeSmartTagLabel(item && item.label) === label);
      const selected = tag && Array.isArray(tag.selected_indicators) ? tag.selected_indicators : [];
      return {
        type: 'reference',
        label,
        tagCode: tag ? tag.tag_code : '',
        indicatorCode: selected.length === 1 ? selected[0].indicator_code : '',
      };
    }
    if (/^[+\-*\/()]$/.test(part)) return { type: 'operator', text: part };
    if (/^\d+(\.\d+)?$/.test(part.trim())) return { type: 'number', text: part.trim() };
    return { type: 'text', text: part };
  });
}

function kwGetSmartIndicatorEffectiveTagCodes() {
  const manualCodes = Array.isArray(kwSmartIndicatorDraft.selectedTagCodes) ? kwSmartIndicatorDraft.selectedTagCodes : [];
  const matchedCodes = kwCollectPromptMatchedTagCodes(kwSmartIndicatorDraft.promptText, kwGetSmartTagCatalog());
  const suppressed = new Set(kwSmartIndicatorDraft.suppressedTagCodes || []);
  return Array.from(new Set(manualCodes.concat(matchedCodes))).filter((code) => !suppressed.has(code));
}

function kwRenderSmartIndicatorTagSelection() {
  const tagCatalog = kwGetSmartTagCatalog();
  const effectiveTagCodes = kwGetSmartIndicatorEffectiveTagCodes();
  const selectedTagSet = new Set(effectiveTagCodes);
  const selectedTags = tagCatalog.filter((tag) => selectedTagSet.has(tag.tag_code));
  const selectedHost = document.getElementById('kw-smart-indicator-selected-tags');
  const poolHost = document.getElementById('kw-smart-indicator-tag-pool');
  const toggleHost = document.getElementById('kw-smart-indicator-tag-toggle');
  const matchedCodes = new Set(kwCollectPromptMatchedTagCodes(kwSmartIndicatorDraft.promptText, tagCatalog));
  const previewList = kwSmartIndicatorDraft.tagPoolExpanded ? tagCatalog : tagCatalog.slice(0, 5);
  if (selectedHost) {
    selectedHost.innerHTML = selectedTags.length
      ? selectedTags.map((tag) => {
          const autoMatched = matchedCodes.has(tag.tag_code);
          return `<button class="kw-dashboard-chip active" type="button" onclick="kwToggleSmartTag('${escapeHtml(tag.tag_code)}')" title="点击移除该标签">${escapeHtml(tag.label)}${autoMatched ? ' · 已识别' : ''} ×</button>`;
        }).join('')
      : '<span style="font-size:12px;color:#8899aa">在上方选择指标，或直接在下方输入与指标名完全一致的词。</span>';
  }
  if (poolHost) {
    poolHost.innerHTML = previewList.map((tag) => `<button class="kw-dashboard-chip ${selectedTagSet.has(tag.tag_code) ? 'active' : ''}" type="button" onclick="kwToggleSmartTag('${escapeHtml(tag.tag_code)}')">${escapeHtml(tag.label)}</button>`).join('');
  }
  if (toggleHost) {
    toggleHost.innerHTML = tagCatalog.length > 5
      ? `<button class="kw-dashboard-chip" type="button" onclick="kwToggleSmartTagPool()">${kwSmartIndicatorDraft.tagPoolExpanded ? '收起' : '...'}</button>`
      : '';
  }
}

function kwToggleSmartTagPool() {
  kwSmartIndicatorDraft.tagPoolExpanded = !kwSmartIndicatorDraft.tagPoolExpanded;
  kwRenderSmartIndicatorTagSelection();
}

function kwHandleSmartIndicatorPromptInput(value) {
  const input = document.getElementById('kw-smart-indicator-draft-prompt');
  kwSmartIndicatorDraft.promptText = kwCanonicalizeSmartPrompt(value, kwGetSmartTagCatalog());
  if (input && input.value !== kwSmartIndicatorDraft.promptText) input.value = kwSmartIndicatorDraft.promptText;
  kwSmartIndicatorDraft.isGenerating = false;
  kwSmartIndicatorDraft.directIndicatorCode = '';
  kwSmartIndicatorDraft.preview = null;
  const matchedCodes = kwCollectPromptMatchedTagCodes(kwSmartIndicatorDraft.promptText, kwGetSmartTagCatalog());
  kwSmartIndicatorDraft.selectedTagCodes = (kwSmartIndicatorDraft.selectedTagCodes || [])
    .filter((code) => matchedCodes.includes(code));
  kwSmartIndicatorDraft.suppressedTagCodes = (kwSmartIndicatorDraft.suppressedTagCodes || []).filter((code) => matchedCodes.includes(code));
  kwRenderSmartIndicatorTagSelection();
}

function kwFocusSmartIndicatorPrompt() {

function kwToggleSmartTag(tagCode) {
  const effective = kwGetSmartIndicatorEffectiveTagCodes();
  const matched = kwCollectPromptMatchedTagCodes(kwSmartIndicatorDraft.promptText, kwGetSmartTagCatalog()).includes(tagCode);
  if (effective.includes(tagCode)) {
    kwSmartIndicatorDraft.selectedTagCodes = kwSmartIndicatorDraft.selectedTagCodes.filter((code) => code !== tagCode);
    if (matched && !(kwSmartIndicatorDraft.suppressedTagCodes || []).includes(tagCode)) kwSmartIndicatorDraft.suppressedTagCodes = (kwSmartIndicatorDraft.suppressedTagCodes || []).concat(tagCode);
  } else {
    kwSmartIndicatorDraft.suppressedTagCodes = (kwSmartIndicatorDraft.suppressedTagCodes || []).filter((code) => code !== tagCode);
    kwSmartIndicatorDraft.selectedTagCodes = kwSmartIndicatorDraft.selectedTagCodes.concat(tagCode);
  }
  kwSmartIndicatorDraft.preview = null;
  kwRenderSmartIndicatorEditorModal();
}

async function kwPreviewSmartIndicator() {
  if (kwSmartIndicatorDraft.isGenerating || kwSmartIndicatorDraft.isSaving) return;
  const nameInput = document.getElementById('kw-smart-indicator-draft-name');
  const promptInput = document.getElementById('kw-smart-indicator-draft-prompt');
  kwSmartIndicatorDraft.indicatorName = nameInput ? nameInput.value.trim() : '';
  kwSmartIndicatorDraft.promptText = kwCanonicalizeSmartPrompt(promptInput ? promptInput.value.trim() : '', kwGetSmartTagCatalog());
  if (promptInput) promptInput.value = kwSmartIndicatorDraft.promptText;
  const tenantSlug = (window.ACTIVE_TENANT && window.ACTIVE_TENANT.slug) || '';
  if (!kwSmartIndicatorDraft.promptText) {
    showToast('请先填写提示词');
    return;
  }
  const selectedTagCodes = kwGetSmartIndicatorEffectiveTagCodes();
  const directPreview = kwGetDirectPreviewCandidate(selectedTagCodes);
  if (directPreview) {
    kwSmartIndicatorDraft.isGenerating = false;
    kwSmartIndicatorDraft.selectedTagCodes = selectedTagCodes;
    kwSmartIndicatorDraft.directIndicatorCode = directPreview.indicator_code || '';
    kwSmartIndicatorDraft.preview = directPreview;
    kwRenderSmartIndicatorEditorModal();
    showToast('已直接引用指标，无需重复生成');
    return;
  }
  kwSmartIndicatorDraft.directIndicatorCode = '';
  kwSmartIndicatorDraft.isGenerating = true;
  kwSmartIndicatorDraft.preview = null;
  kwRenderSmartIndicatorEditorModal();
  try {
    const resp = await fetch(`/api/tenant/${encodeURIComponent(tenantSlug)}/smart-indicators`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        action: 'preview',
        indicator_name: kwSmartIndicatorDraft.indicatorName,
        prompt_text: kwSmartIndicatorDraft.promptText,
        selected_tag_codes: selectedTagCodes,
        suppressed_tag_codes: kwSmartIndicatorDraft.suppressedTagCodes || [],
        formula_tokens: kwTokenizeSmartPrompt(kwSmartIndicatorDraft.promptText, kwGetSmartTagCatalog()),
      }),
    });
    const payload = await resp.json();
    if (!resp.ok || !payload.success) throw new Error(payload.error || 'smart_indicator_preview_failed');
    kwSetSmartIndicatorCatalog(payload.smart_indicator_catalog);
    kwSmartIndicatorDraft.preview = payload.preview || null;
    const resolvedCodes = (kwSmartIndicatorDraft.preview && Array.isArray(kwSmartIndicatorDraft.preview.selected_indicators))
      ? kwSmartIndicatorDraft.preview.selected_indicators.map((item) => item && item.indicator_code).filter(Boolean)
      : [];
    const resolvedTagCodes = kwGetSmartTagCatalog()
      .filter((tag) => (tag.selected_indicators || []).some((item) => resolvedCodes.includes(item.indicator_code)))
      .map((tag) => tag.tag_code);
    kwSmartIndicatorDraft.selectedTagCodes = Array.from(new Set(selectedTagCodes.concat(resolvedTagCodes)));
    if (kwSmartIndicatorDraft.preview && kwSmartIndicatorDraft.preview.indicator_name) {
      kwSmartIndicatorDraft.indicatorName = kwSmartIndicatorDraft.preview.indicator_name;
    }
    kwSmartIndicatorDraft.isGenerating = false;
    kwRenderSmartIndicatorEditorModal();
  } catch (error) {
    kwSmartIndicatorDraft.isGenerating = false;
    kwRenderSmartIndicatorEditorModal();
    showToast(error.message || '预览生成失败');
  }
}

async function kwConfirmSmartIndicator() {
  if (kwSmartIndicatorDraft.isSaving) return;
  const preview = kwSmartIndicatorDraft.preview;
  if (!preview) {
    showToast('请先生成预览');
    return;
  }
  const tenantSlug = (window.ACTIVE_TENANT && window.ACTIVE_TENANT.slug) || '';
  const active = kwGetActiveDashboardConfig();
  const layout = active.layout || '2x2';
  const target = kwGetDashboardCardTarget(layout);
  const slotIndex = Number(kwSmartIndicatorDraft.slotIndex);
  if (!Number.isInteger(slotIndex) || slotIndex < 0 || slotIndex >= target) {
    showToast('请选择 Dashboard 中的空白格后再创建指标');
    return;
  }
  const selectedSlot = Array.isArray(active.cards) ? active.cards[slotIndex] : null;
  if (selectedSlot && !kwIsSmartPlaceholderCard(selectedSlot)) {
    showToast('该格已被占用，请重新选择空白格');
    return;
  }
  kwSmartIndicatorDraft.isSaving = true;
  kwRenderSmartIndicatorEditorModal();
  try {
    if (preview.direct_reference === true && preview.indicator_code) {
      const nextCards = Array.from({ length: target }, (_, index) => {
        const raw = Array.isArray(active.cards) && typeof active.cards[index] === 'object' ? active.cards[index] : {};
        const indicatorCode = String(raw.indicatorCode || raw.indicator_code || '').trim();
        return indicatorCode ? { indicatorCode } : {};
      });
      nextCards[slotIndex] = { indicatorCode: preview.indicator_code };
      await kwSyncFundDashboard('save_draft', { ...active, layout, cards: nextCards }, '已直接加入 Dashboard 草稿');
      kwSmartIndicatorEditingCode = preview.indicator_code;
      kwSmartIndicatorSelectedCodes = (preview.selected_indicators || []).map((item) => item && item.indicator_code).filter(Boolean);
      kwSmartIndicatorDraft.isSaving = false;
      kwCloseSmartIndicatorEditor();
      return;
    }
    const resp = await fetch(`/api/tenant/${encodeURIComponent(tenantSlug)}/smart-indicators`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        action: 'save',
        indicator_name: preview.indicator_name || kwSmartIndicatorDraft.indicatorName,
        prompt_text: preview.prompt_text || kwSmartIndicatorDraft.promptText,
        category: preview.category || '',
        unit: preview.unit || '',
        selected_indicators: preview.selected_indicators || [],
        formula_js: preview.formula_js || '',
        add_to_dashboard: false,
      }),
    });
    const payload = await resp.json();
    if (!resp.ok || !payload.success) throw new Error(payload.error || 'smart_indicator_save_failed');
    kwSetSmartIndicatorCatalog(payload.smart_indicator_catalog);
    const nextCards = Array.from({ length: target }, (_, index) => {
      const raw = Array.isArray(active.cards) && typeof active.cards[index] === 'object' ? active.cards[index] : {};
      const indicatorCode = raw && (raw.indicatorCode || raw.indicator_code) ? (raw.indicatorCode || raw.indicator_code) : '';
      return indicatorCode ? { indicatorCode } : {};
    });
    nextCards[slotIndex] = { indicatorCode: ((payload.definition || {}).indicator_code) || '' };
    const nextDashboard = {
      ...active,
      layout,
      cards: nextCards,
    };
    await kwSyncFundDashboard('save_draft', nextDashboard, '智能指标已加入 Dashboard 草稿');
    kwSmartIndicatorEditingCode = ((payload.definition || {}).indicator_code) || '';
    kwSmartIndicatorSelectedCodes = ((preview.selected_indicators || []).map((item) => item.indicator_code)).filter(Boolean);
    kwSmartIndicatorDraft.isSaving = false;
    kwCloseSmartIndicatorEditor();
  } catch (error) {
    kwSmartIndicatorDraft.isSaving = false;
    kwRenderSmartIndicatorEditorModal();
    showToast(error.message || '智能指标保存失败');
  }
}

function kwFindSmartIndicatorCatalogItem(indicatorCode) {
  return (kwGetSmartIndicatorCatalog().tenant_smart_indicators || []).find((entry) => entry.indicator_code === indicatorCode);
}

function kwIsSmartPlaceholderCard(card) {
  const item = card && typeof card === 'object' ? card : {};
  const indicatorCode = String(item.indicatorCode || item.indicator_code || '').trim();
  const name = String(item.name || '').trim();
  return !!(
    item.isEmpty
    || (!indicatorCode && /^待添加智能指标\s*\d*$/u.test(name))
    || (!indicatorCode && !String(item.prompt || '').trim() && !Array.isArray(item.selectedIndicators))
  );
}

    indicatorCode: item.indicatorCode || item.indicator_code || '',
    name: item.name,
    value: item.value || '--',
    unit: item.unit || '',
    prompt: item.prompt || '',
    updatedAt: item.updatedAt || active.updatedAt || '',
    algorithmDetail: item.algorithmDetail || (catalogItem && catalogItem.algorithm_detail) || '',

    alertTemplate: (catalogItem && catalogItem.alert) || '',

    data_unavailable: item.data_unavailable === true || (catalogItem && catalogItem.data_unavailable === true),
    slotIndex: index,

async function kwSaveSmartIndicatorDefinitionFromDetail(indicatorCode) {
  const item = kwFindSmartIndicatorCatalogItem(indicatorCode);
  const nameInput = document.getElementById('kw-smart-indicator-detail-name');
  const categoryInput = document.getElementById('kw-smart-indicator-detail-category');
  const unitInput = document.getElementById('kw-smart-indicator-detail-unit');
  const interpretationInput = document.getElementById('kw-smart-indicator-detail-interpretation');
  const algorithmInput = document.getElementById('kw-smart-indicator-detail-algorithm');
  const promptInput = document.getElementById('kw-smart-indicator-detail-prompt');
  const name = nameInput ? nameInput.value.trim() : '';
  const category = categoryInput ? categoryInput.value.trim() : '';
  const unit = unitInput ? unitInput.value.trim() : '';
  const interpretation = interpretationInput ? interpretationInput.value.trim() : '';
  const algorithm = algorithmInput ? algorithmInput.value.trim() : '';
  const promptText = promptInput ? promptInput.value.trim() : '';
  const tenantSlug = (window.ACTIVE_TENANT && window.ACTIVE_TENANT.slug) || '';
  if (!item || !name || !promptText) {
    showToast('名称和提示词不能为空');
    return;
  }
  kwOpenSmartIndicatorDetailModal({...cardFromSmartIndicatorItem(item), isSaving: true});
  const controller = new AbortController();
  const timeoutId = window.setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 90000);
  try {
    const resp = await fetch(`/api/tenant/${encodeURIComponent(tenantSlug)}/smart-indicators`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      signal: controller.signal,
      body: JSON.stringify({
        action: 'save',
        indicator_code: item.indicator_code,
        indicator_name: name,
        category,
        unit,
        prompt_text: promptText,
        description: algorithm,
        assessment_template: interpretation,
        alert_template: item.alert || '',
        selected_indicator_codes: (item.selected_indicators || []).map((source) => source.indicator_code).filter(Boolean),
        add_to_dashboard: false,
      }),
    });
    const payload = await resp.json();
    if (!resp.ok || !payload.success) throw new Error(payload.error || 'smart_indicator_update_failed');
    kwSetSmartIndicatorCatalog(payload.smart_indicator_catalog);
    kwFundDashboardState = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(payload.fund_dashboard_state || kwFundDashboardState || {}));
    if (window.WORKBENCH_DATA) {
      window.WORKBENCH_DATA.fund_dashboard_state = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(kwFundDashboardState || {}));
      window.WORKBENCH_DATA.fund_dashboard = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify((payload.dashboard || {}).fund_dashboard || {}));
    }
    kwCloseSmartIndicatorDetailModal();
    kwRenderDashboardPreview();
    kwRenderSmartIndicatorLibrary();
    showToast('指标已更新，结果已重新计算');
  } catch (error) {
    kwOpenSmartIndicatorDetailModal({
      ...cardFromSmartIndicatorItem(item),
      name,
      category,
      unit,
      prompt: promptText,
      algorithmDetail: algorithm,
      assessmentTemplate: interpretation,
    });
    showToast(error && error.name === 'AbortError' ? '保存超时，请检查服务端任务状态后重试' : (error.message || '指标更新失败'));
  } finally {
    window.clearTimeout(timeoutId);
  }
}

async function kwAddExistingIndicatorToDraft(indicatorCode) {
  const active = kwGetActiveDashboardConfig();
  const layout = active.layout || '2x2';
  const target = kwGetDashboardCardTarget(layout);
  const nextCards = Array.from({ length: target }, (_, index) => {
    const item = Array.isArray(active.cards) ? active.cards[index] : null;
    const code = item && (item.indicatorCode || item.indicator_code);
    return code ? { indicatorCode: code } : {};
  });
  if (nextCards.some((item) => item.indicatorCode === indicatorCode)) {
    showToast('该指标已经在 Dashboard 草稿中');
    return;
  }
  const emptyIndex = nextCards.findIndex((item) => !item.indicatorCode);
  if (emptyIndex < 0) {
    showToast('当前布局已无空白格，请先调整布局或移出一个指标');
    return;
  }
  nextCards[emptyIndex] = { indicatorCode };
  active.cards = nextCards;
  try {
    await kwSyncFundDashboard('save_draft', active, '已加入 Dashboard 草稿');
  } catch (error) {
    showToast(error.message || '加入 Dashboard 草稿失败');
  }
}

async function kwRemoveSmartDashboardCard(index) {
  if (!window.confirm('确认只从当前 Dashboard 草稿移除这个指标吗？指标定义、快照和历史数据会保留。')) return;
  const active = kwGetActiveDashboardConfig();
  const target = kwGetDashboardCardTarget(active.layout || '2x2');
  const nextCards = Array.from({ length: target }, (_, slotIndex) => {
    const raw = Array.isArray(active.cards) && typeof active.cards[slotIndex] === 'object' ? active.cards[slotIndex] : {};
    if (slotIndex === index) return {};
    const indicatorCode = raw && (raw.indicatorCode || raw.indicator_code) ? (raw.indicatorCode || raw.indicator_code) : '';
    return indicatorCode ? { indicatorCode } : {};
  });
  active.cards = nextCards;
  try {
    await kwSyncFundDashboard('save_draft', active, '已从草稿移除，指标定义仍保留');
  } catch (error) {
    showToast(error.message || '从 Dashboard 移除失败');
  }
}

async function kwDeleteSmartIndicator(indicatorCode, fromDetail = false) {
  const tenantSlug = (window.ACTIVE_TENANT && window.ACTIVE_TENANT.slug) || '';
  if (!window.confirm('确认删除这个指标定义吗？删除后会从指标库、草稿和已发布看板移除，并清理快照与历史数据，且无法撤销。')) return;
  const item = kwFindSmartIndicatorCatalogItem(indicatorCode);
  if (fromDetail && item) kwOpenSmartIndicatorDetailModal({...cardFromSmartIndicatorItem(item), isDeleting: true});
  try {
    const resp = await fetch(`/api/tenant/${encodeURIComponent(tenantSlug)}/smart-indicators`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ action: 'delete', indicator_code: indicatorCode }),
    });
    const payload = await resp.json();
    if (!resp.ok || !payload.success) throw new Error(payload.error || 'smart_indicator_delete_failed');
    kwSetSmartIndicatorCatalog(payload.smart_indicator_catalog);
    kwFundDashboardState = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify((payload.dashboard || {}).fund_dashboard_state || kwFundDashboardState || {}));
    if (fromDetail) kwCloseSmartIndicatorDetailModal();
    kwRenderDashboardPreview();
    kwRenderSmartIndicatorLibrary();
    showToast('智能指标已删除');
  } catch (error) {
    if (fromDetail && item) kwOpenSmartIndicatorLibraryDetail(indicatorCode);
    showToast(error.message || '智能指标删除失败');
  }
}

async function loadWorkbenchHermesUsageStats() {
  if (kwHermesUsageState.loading) return;
  const tenantSlug = String(((window.ACTIVE_TENANT || {}).slug) || '').trim();
  kwHermesUsageState.loading = true;
  try {
    const resp = await fetch(`/api/kol/hermes/usage-stats?tenant=${encodeURIComponent(tenantSlug)}`);

function renderWorkbenchHermesCapabilityGrowth() {
  const host = document.getElementById('kw-hermes-capability-growth');
  if (!host) return;
  const growth = kwHermesCapabilityState.growth || {};
  const summary = growth.summary || {};
  const trend = Array.isArray(growth.trend) ? growth.trend : [];
  const renderChips = (items, emptyText) => {
    const rows = Array.isArray(items) ? items : [];
    return rows.length
      ? `<div class="kw-capability-chip-list">${rows.map((item) => `<span class="kw-capability-chip">${escapeHtml(item.label || '未命名')} ${escapeHtml(String(item.count || 0))}</span>`).join('')}</div>`
      : `<div class="kw-capability-card-desc">${escapeHtml(emptyText)}</div>`;
  };
  const metrics = [
    ['可追溯资产', Number(summary.source_asset_count || 0), `${Number(summary.knowledge_count || 0)} 条知识 · ${Number(summary.review_count || 0)} 篇复盘`],
    ['研究覆盖', Number(summary.coverage_count || 0), '按主题与标的去重后统计'],
    ['验证闭环', `${Number(summary.verification_ratio || 0).toFixed(1)}%`, `${Number(summary.validated_review_count || 0)} 篇复盘含证据链或标注`],
    ['近30天研究对话', Number(summary.recent_turn_count || 0), `前30天 ${Number(summary.previous_turn_count || 0)} 轮`],
  ];
  host.innerHTML = `
    <div class="kw-capability-hero">
      <div>
        <div class="kw-capability-kicker">AUDITABLE CAPABILITY GROWTH</div>
        <div class="kw-capability-title">${escapeHtml(summary.stage || '能力沉淀')}</div>
        <div class="kw-capability-copy">能力来自大V持续的知识治理、洞见发布和研究交互。当前先观察哪些资产已经结构化、哪些洞见形成验证闭环，为后续的评估、蒸馏和受控使用建立基线。</div>
      </div>
      <div class="kw-capability-score">
        <div class="kw-capability-score-value">${escapeHtml(String(summary.readiness_score || 0))}</div>
        <div class="kw-capability-score-label">沉淀就绪度 / 100</div>
        <div class="kw-capability-score-note">资产可追溯，不代表模型已训练</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="kw-capability-metric-grid">
      ${metrics.map(([label, value, note]) => `<div class="kw-capability-metric"><div class="kw-capability-metric-label">${escapeHtml(label)}</div><div class="kw-capability-metric-value">${escapeHtml(String(value))}</div><div class="kw-capability-metric-note">${escapeHtml(note)}</div></div>`).join('')}
    </div>
    <div class="kw-capability-grid">
      <div class="kw-capability-card">
        <div class="kw-capability-card-title">资产增长轨迹</div>
        <div class="kw-capability-card-desc">按月记录新增入库知识、发布洞见与 Hermes 研究对话。</div>
        ${trend.length ? trend.map((item) => `<div class="kw-capability-trend-row"><span>${escapeHtml(item.month || '--')}</span><span class="kw-capability-trend-value">知识 ${escapeHtml(String(item.knowledge || 0))}</span><span class="kw-capability-trend-value">复盘 ${escapeHtml(String(item.reviews || 0))}</span><span class="kw-capability-trend-value">对话 ${escapeHtml(String(item.research_turns || 0))}</span></div>`).join('') : '<div class="kw-capability-card-desc">暂无月度沉淀记录。</div>'}
      </div>
      <div class="kw-capability-card">
        <div class="kw-capability-card-title">已沉淀研究方法</div>
        <div class="kw-capability-card-desc">来自 Hermes 已记录研究意图与发布洞见的研究方式聚合。</div>
        ${renderChips(growth.methods, '尚无可归类的研究方法。')}
        <div class="kw-capability-card-title" style="margin-top:18px">重点主题与标的</div>
        ${renderChips(growth.topics, '尚无主题标签。')}
        ${renderChips(growth.objects, '尚无标的覆盖。')}
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="kw-capability-principles">${(Array.isArray(growth.principles) ? growth.principles : []).map((item) => escapeHtml(item)).join('<br>')}</div>
  `;
}

function kwRenderDashboardPreview() {
  const previewHost = document.getElementById('kw-dashboard-preview');
  const metaHost = document.getElementById('kw-dashboard-meta');
  const tag = document.getElementById('kw-dashboard-layout-tag');
  if (!previewHost || !metaHost) return;
  kwRenderSmartDashboardLayoutRow();
  kwRenderSmartIndicatorLibrary();
  const active = kwGetActiveDashboardConfig();
  const cards = Array.isArray(active.cards) ? active.cards : [];
  const filledCount = cards.filter((item) => item && !item.isEmpty && (item.indicatorCode || item.indicator_code || item.name || item.prompt)).length;
  metaHost.textContent = kwFundDashboardState && kwFundDashboardState.draft
    ? `当前是草稿版 · ${filledCount} 个智能指标 · ${active.layout || '2x2'}`
    : `当前展示已发布版本 · ${filledCount} 个智能指标`;
  if (tag) tag.textContent = (active.layout || '2x2').toUpperCase();
  previewHost.innerHTML = kwRenderSmartDashboardPreviewCards(cards);
}

function kwSetDashboardPublishActionState(action) {
  kwDashboardPublishAction = action || '';
  if (kwDashboardPublishActionTimer) {
    clearInterval(kwDashboardPublishActionTimer);
    kwDashboardPublishActionTimer = null;
  }
  const publishButton = document.getElementById('kw-dashboard-publish-button');
  const resetButton = document.getElementById('kw-dashboard-reset-button');
  const note = document.getElementById('kw-smart-dashboard-publish-note');
  const isPublishing = action === 'publish';
  const isRestoring = action === 'restore';
  [publishButton, resetButton].filter(Boolean).forEach((button) => {
    button.disabled = !!action;
    button.style.opacity = action ? '0.65' : '';
    button.style.cursor = action ? 'wait' : '';
  });
  const dots = '<span class="kw-publish-dots" aria-hidden="true"><span>.</span><span>.</span><span>.</span></span>';
  if (publishButton) publishButton.innerHTML = isPublishing ? `正在发布 ${dots}` : '发布到前台';
  if (resetButton) resetButton.innerHTML = isRestoring ? `正在恢复 ${dots}` : '恢复发布版';
  if (!action || !note) return;
  const renderProgress = () => {
    const message = isPublishing ? '正在发布到前台' : '正在等待服务端确认草稿已恢复';
    note.innerHTML = `${message} ${dots}`;
  };
  renderProgress();
}

async function kwPublishFundDashboard() {
  if (kwDashboardPublishAction) return;
  const draft = kwFundDashboardState && kwFundDashboardState.draft;
  if (!draft) {
    showToast('请先至少生成一个智能指标草稿');
    return;
  }
  kwSetDashboardPublishActionState('publish');
  try {
    await kwSyncFundDashboard('publish', draft, '已发布到前台 H5 和租户门户');
  } catch (error) {
    showToast(error.message || '发布失败，请稍后重试');
  } finally {
    kwSetDashboardPublishActionState('');
  }
}

async function kwResetFundDashboardDraft() {
  if (kwDashboardPublishAction) return;
  kwSetDashboardPublishActionState('restore');
  try {
    await kwSyncFundDashboard('reset_draft', null, '已恢复到当前发布版');
  } catch (error) {
    showToast(error.message || '恢复失败，请稍后重试');
  } finally {
    kwSetDashboardPublishActionState('');
  }
}

    showWorkbenchSection('overview');
    return;
  }
  if (['watchlist', 'watchlist-pool', 'watchlist-insights'].includes(section) && !isWorkbenchFeatureEnabled('watchlist')) {
    showWorkbenchSection('overview');
    return;
  }
  if (section === 'dashboard' && !isWorkbenchFeatureEnabled('core_indicators')) {
    showWorkbenchSection('overview');
    return;
  }
  if (section === 'indicator-smart' && !isWorkbenchFeatureEnabled('core_indicators')) {

    showWorkbenchSection('indicator-overview');
    return;

  if (section && workbenchSectionMeta[section]) {
    showWorkbenchSection(section);

  initWorkbenchForecastEditorEvents();
  renderWorkbenchAnnotationViews();
});

/* ===== BOTTOM NAV (6 items) ===== */

.h5-nav-label { font-size: 10px; color: var(--gray-400); margin-top: 2px; }

/* ===== COMMUNITY ===== */
.community-subtabs { display:flex; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(200,169,110,0.1); }
.community-subtab { flex:1; text-align:center; padding:10px; font-size:13px; color:var(--gray-400); cursor:pointer; border-bottom:2px solid transparent; }

.post-card { background:var(--navy-mid); border:1px solid rgba(200,169,110,0.08); border-radius:12px; padding:14px; margin-bottom:10px; }
.post-author-row { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; margin-bottom:8px; }
.post-avatar { width:36px; height:36px; border-radius:50%; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-size:18px; flex-shrink:0; }

.post-avatar.verified { background:linear-gradient(135deg,#3182CE,#2C5282); }
.post-avatar.normal { background:var(--navy-light); }
.post-name { font-size:13px; font-weight:600; color:var(--white); }
.post-badge-dav { font-size:10px; background:rgba(200,169,110,0.2); color:var(--gold); padding:1px 6px; border-radius:8px; border:1px solid rgba(200,169,110,0.3); }
.post-badge-verified { font-size:10px; background:rgba(49,130,206,0.2); color:#63B3ED; padding:1px 6px; border-radius:8px; }
.post-time { font-size:11px; color:var(--gray-400); margin-left:auto; }
.post-content { font-size:13px; color:var(--white); line-height:1.7; margin-bottom:8px; display:-webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp:3; -webkit-box-orient:vertical; overflow:hidden; }

.post-tags { display:flex; gap:6px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-bottom:10px; }
.post-footer { display:flex; gap:16px; align-items:center; }
.post-action { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:4px; font-size:12px; color:var(--gray-400); cursor:pointer; padding:4px 0; }
.post-action:active { color:var(--gold); }
.post-points-badge { margin-left:auto; font-size:10px; color:var(--gold); background:rgba(200,169,110,0.1); padding:2px 8px; border-radius:8px; }

/* KOL cards */
.kol-card { background:var(--navy-mid); border:1px solid rgba(200,169,110,0.12); border-radius:12px; padding:16px; margin-bottom:10px; }
.kol-header { display:flex; align-items:flex-start; gap:12px; margin-bottom:10px; }
.kol-avatar-lg { width:52px; height:52px; border-radius:50%; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-size:24px; flex-shrink:0; background:linear-gradient(135deg,#C8A96E,#A8893E); border:2px solid rgba(200,169,110,0.4); position:relative; }

.kol-info { flex:1; }
.kol-name { font-size:14px; font-weight:700; color:var(--white); }
.kol-platform { font-size:11px; color:var(--gray-400); margin-top:2px; }
.kol-followers { font-size:11px; color:var(--gold); margin-top:2px; }
.kol-preview { font-size:12px; color:var(--gray-400); line-height:1.6; margin-bottom:10px; }
.kol-footer { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; }
.kol-stats { display:flex; gap:12px; }
.kol-stat { font-size:11px; color:var(--gray-400); }
.kol-stat span { color:var(--gold); font-weight:600; }

/* Event cards */
.event-card { background:var(--navy-mid); border:1px solid rgba(200,169,110,0.1); border-radius:12px; padding:14px; margin-bottom:10px; }
.event-type-badge { display:inline-block; font-size:10px; padding:2px 8px; border-radius:4px; font-weight:600; margin-bottom:8px; }
.event-live { background:rgba(231,76,60,0.2); color:#E74C3C; }
.event-activity { background:rgba(200,169,110,0.15); color:var(--gold); }
.event-meeting { background:rgba(49,130,206,0.15); color:#63B3ED; }
.event-title { font-size:14px; font-weight:600; color:var(--white); margin-bottom:6px; }
.event-meta { font-size:12px; color:var(--gray-400); margin-bottom:8px; }
.event-footer { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; }
.event-info { font-size:11px; color:var(--gray-400); }
.event-status-open { font-size:11px; color:var(--green); background:rgba(46,204,113,0.1); padding:2px 8px; border-radius:8px; }
.event-status-closed { font-size:11px; color:var(--gray-400); background:rgba(154,149,144,0.1); padding:2px 8px; border-radius:8px; }

/* Post composer */
.post-composer { background:var(--navy-mid); border:1px solid rgba(200,169,110,0.1); border-radius:12px; padding:12px 14px; margin-bottom:14px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; cursor:pointer; }
.composer-placeholder { flex:1; font-size:13px; color:var(--gray-400); }
.composer-btn { font-size:12px; color:var(--navy); background:var(--gold); padding:5px 14px; border-radius:16px; font-weight:600; flex-shrink:0; }

/* Compose modal */
.modal-overlay { position:fixed; inset:0; background:rgba(13,27,42,0.85); z-index:1000; display:none; align-items:flex-end; justify-content:center; backdrop-filter:blur(4px); }
.modal-overlay.show { display:flex; }
.modal-sheet { background:var(--navy-mid); border-radius:20px 20px 0 0; padding:20px 16px 32px; width:100%; max-width:390px; border-top:1px solid rgba(200,169,110,0.2); }
.modal-handle { width:36px; height:4px; background:rgba(200,169,110,0.3); border-radius:2px; margin:0 auto 16px; }
.modal-close-row { display:flex; justify-content:flex-end; margin:-4px 0 10px; }
.modal-close-btn {
  border:1px solid #2F74C0;

  border-radius:999px;
  padding:6px 12px;
  font-size:12px;
  line-height:1;
  cursor:pointer;
}
.modal-title { font-size:15px; font-weight:600; color:var(--white); margin-bottom:12px; }
.modal-textarea { width:100%; background:rgba(13,27,42,0.6); border:1px solid rgba(200,169,110,0.2); border-radius:10px; color:var(--white); font-size:13px; padding:12px; resize:none; height:100px; font-family:var(--font-main); }
.modal-textarea::placeholder { color:var(--gray-400); }
.modal-actions { display:flex; justify-content:flex-end; gap:10px; margin-top:12px; }
.review-flow-actions {
  align-items:center;
  gap:8px;
  flex-wrap:wrap;
}
.review-flow-actions .btn-outline:first-child {
  margin-right:auto;
}
.review-flow-actions .btn-gold,
.review-flow-actions .btn-outline {
  padding:8px 14px;
  font-size:12px;
  line-height:1.2;
  border-radius:999px;
  white-space:nowrap;
}

/* ===== HERMES ===== */

.hermes-header { background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--navy-mid),#0F2035); padding:14px 16px; border:1px solid rgba(200,169,110,0.15); border-radius:16px; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; gap:10px; overflow:hidden; }

.hermes-header,

.h5-splash-screen {

  --splash-line:rgba(47,116,192,0.13);
  position:fixed;
  inset:0;
  z-index:5000;
  overflow:hidden;
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;
  min-height:100dvh;
  padding:env(safe-area-inset-top) env(safe-area-inset-right) env(safe-area-inset-bottom) env(safe-area-inset-left);
  box-sizing:border-box;
  background:linear-gradient(115deg,rgba(255,255,255,.97),rgba(241,247,253,.99)),#F2F7FC;
  color:var(--splash-ink);
  opacity:1;
  visibility:visible;
  transition:opacity .55s ease,visibility .55s ease;
}
.h5-splash-screen::before,
.h5-splash-screen::after {
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  pointer-events:none;
  border:1px solid var(--splash-line);
  transform:rotate(-18deg);
}
.h5-splash-screen::before { width:72vw; height:72vw; max-width:900px; max-height:900px; left:-28vw; top:-38vw; }
.h5-splash-screen::after { width:54vw; height:54vw; max-width:680px; max-height:680px; right:-22vw; bottom:-30vw; }
.h5-splash-screen.is-hidden { opacity:0; visibility:hidden; pointer-events:none; }
.h5-splash-art { position:absolute; inset:0; width:100%; height:100%; pointer-events:none; }
.h5-splash-art-grid { fill:none; stroke:var(--splash-line); stroke-width:1; }
.h5-splash-art-axis { fill:none; stroke:rgba(47,116,192,.22); stroke-width:1.5; stroke-dasharray:5 8; }
.h5-splash-art-trend,
.h5-splash-art-trend-shadow { fill:none; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round; }
.h5-splash-art-trend { stroke:var(--splash-blue); stroke-width:3; stroke-dasharray:8 12; animation:h5SplashTrend 5s linear infinite; }
.h5-splash-art-trend-shadow { stroke:rgba(184,138,59,.34); stroke-width:8; opacity:.55; }
.h5-splash-art-node { fill:#fff; stroke:var(--splash-gold); stroke-width:2; transform-box:fill-box; transform-origin:center; animation:h5SplashNode 2.2s ease-in-out infinite; }
.h5-splash-art-node:nth-of-type(2) { animation-delay:.35s; }
.h5-splash-art-node:nth-of-type(3) { animation-delay:.7s; }
.h5-splash-content { position:relative; z-index:1; width:100%; min-height:100%; padding:clamp(34px,8vh,92px) 18px calc(132px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); box-sizing:border-box; }

.h5-splash-kicker { margin-bottom:10px; color:var(--splash-gold); font-size:11px; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:2px; text-transform:uppercase; }
.h5-splash-product { max-width:760px; margin:0 auto; color:var(--splash-ink); font-size:clamp(30px,5vw,36px); font-weight:800; line-height:1.2; overflow-wrap:anywhere; }
.h5-splash-subtitle { max-width:520px; margin:12px auto 0; color:#58718D; font-size:13px; line-height:1.8; }
.h5-splash-loader { position:relative; width:112px; height:112px; margin:34px auto 0; }
.h5-splash-loader::before,.h5-splash-loader::after { content:""; position:absolute; inset:0; border-radius:50%; border:1px solid rgba(47,116,192,.18); }
.h5-splash-loader::after { inset:12px; border-color:transparent rgba(184,138,59,.72) transparent rgba(47,116,192,.55); animation:h5SplashSpin 1.25s linear infinite; }
.h5-splash-loader-ring { position:absolute; inset:22px; border-radius:50%; border:2px solid transparent; border-top-color:var(--splash-blue); border-right-color:var(--splash-gold); animation:h5SplashSpin 1.8s linear infinite reverse; }
.h5-splash-loader-dot { position:absolute; inset:47px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--splash-gold); box-shadow:0 0 0 7px rgba(184,138,59,.12),0 0 22px rgba(184,138,59,.42); animation:h5SplashPulse 1.5s ease-in-out infinite; }

.h5-splash-quote-wrap { position:absolute; left:18px; right:18px; bottom:calc(28px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); max-width:760px; margin:0 auto; padding-top:18px; border-top:1px solid rgba(47,116,192,.16); }

@keyframes h5SplashSpin { to { transform:rotate(360deg); } }
@keyframes h5SplashPulse { 0%,100% { transform:scale(.82); opacity:.72; } 50% { transform:scale(1.12); opacity:1; } }

function isDavCapableUser(user) {
  const role = String((user || {}).role || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  return hasRoleCapability(user, 'dav');
}

function hasRoleCapability(user, capability) {
  const role = String((user || {}).role || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const target = String(capability || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const grants = (window.SITE_CONFIG && window.SITE_CONFIG.role_capabilities) || {};
  const capabilities = Array.isArray(grants[role]) ? grants[role] : [];
  return capabilities.map(item => String(item || '').trim().toLowerCase()).includes(target);
}

function isFeatureEnabled(featureName) {
  const siteFeatures = (window.SITE_CONFIG && window.SITE_CONFIG.feature_flags) || {};
  if (!featureName) return true;
  if (featureName === 'workbench') {
    const activeUser = getActiveDemoUser();
    return hasRoleCapability(activeUser, 'workbench');
  }
  if (featureName === 'hermes') {
    const activeUser = getActiveDemoUser() || {};
    const hermesSettings = (window.SITE_CONFIG && window.SITE_CONFIG.hermes_settings) || {};
    if (siteFeatures.hermes === false) return false;
    if (!hasRoleCapability(activeUser, 'hermes')) return false;
    if (isDavCapableUser(activeUser)) return hermesSettings.dav_access_enabled !== false;
    if (hasRoleCapability(activeUser, 'investor')) return hermesSettings.investor_access_enabled !== false;
    return true;
  }
  if (featureName === 'dm') {
    return siteFeatures.dm !== false || siteFeatures.fan_interaction !== false;
  }
  if (featureName === 'knowledge') {
    return siteFeatures.knowledge === true && siteFeatures.knowledge_module_enabled === true;
  }
  if (featureName === 'core_indicators') return siteFeatures.core_indicators === true;
  return siteFeatures[featureName] !== false;
}

function getH5WatermarkDate() {
  const now = new Date();
  const month = String(now.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
  const day = String(now.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
  return `${now.getFullYear()}-${month}-${day}`;
}

function renderH5Watermark() {
  const layer = document.getElementById('h5-watermark-layer');
  if (!layer) return;
  const featureEnabled = isFeatureEnabled('h5_watermark');
  const profile = window.CURRENT_DEMO_PROFILE || getActiveDemoUser() || {};
  const username = String(profile.username || '').trim();
  const loggedIn = hasLoggedInH5User() && !document.querySelector('.h5-wrap')?.classList.contains('is-logged-out');
  if (!featureEnabled || !loggedIn || !username) {
    layer.replaceChildren();
    layer.classList.remove('is-visible');
    return;
  }
  const label = `${username} · ${getH5WatermarkDate()}`;
  const fragment = document.createDocumentFragment();
  for (let index = 0; index < 6; index += 1) {
    const item = document.createElement('span');
    item.className = 'h5-watermark-item';
    item.textContent = label;
    fragment.appendChild(item);
  }
  layer.replaceChildren(fragment);
  layer.classList.add('is-visible');
}

function isStockForecastEnabled() {
  return isFeatureEnabled('stock_forecast');
}

function getFirstEnabledTab() {
  const priority = [
    ['feed', 'fundamental_analysis'],
    ['market', 'watchlist'],
    ['review', 'daily_review'],
    ['knowledge', 'knowledge'],
    ['profile', null],
    ['community', 'community'],
    ['hermes', 'hermes'],
  ];
  const hit = priority.find(([_, feature]) => isFeatureEnabled(feature));
  return hit ? hit[0] : 'profile';
}

function applySiteFeatureFlags() {
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-feature]').forEach(el => {
    const featureName = el.dataset.feature;
    el.style.display = isFeatureEnabled(featureName) ? '' : 'none';
  });
  if (currentWatchlistDetail) {
    renderWatchlistDetail(currentWatchlistDetail, currentWatchlistSection || 'overview');
  }
  const activePage = document.querySelector('.page.active');
  if (activePage && activePage.dataset.feature && !isFeatureEnabled(activePage.dataset.feature)) {
    switchTab(getFirstEnabledTab());
  }
  renderH5Watermark();
}

async function refreshH5SiteConfig(options = {}) {
  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/site-config', { cache: 'no-store' });
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('load_site_config_failed');
    const data = await res.json();
    if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') throw new Error('invalid_site_config');
    window.SITE_CONFIG = data;
    H5_AUTH_SETTINGS = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify((data && data.auth_settings) || H5_AUTH_SETTINGS || {}));
    applySiteFeatureFlags();
    if (!hasLoggedInH5User()) {
      refreshH5AuthOptions({ silent: true, render: true });
    }
  } catch (error) {
    if (!options.silent) {
      showToast('前台功能配置刷新失败');
    }
  }
}

function syncPublishedReviewStateToH5(tenantSlug, result) {
  const normalizedSlug = String(tenantSlug || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const payload = result && typeof result === 'object' ? result : {};
  if (!normalizedSlug) return;
  const nextState = {};
  if (Array.isArray(payload.snapshots)) nextState.review_snapshots = payload.snapshots.slice(0, 20);
  if (payload.message_center_state && typeof payload.message_center_state === 'object') {
    nextState.message_center_state = payload.message_center_state;
  }
  if (!Object.keys(nextState).length) return;
  if (window.SITE_CONFIG && Array.isArray(window.SITE_CONFIG.tenants)) {
    window.SITE_CONFIG.tenants = window.SITE_CONFIG.tenants.map((tenant) => {
      const tenantSlugValue = String((tenant && tenant.slug) || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      return tenantSlugValue === normalizedSlug ? { ...tenant, ...nextState } : tenant;
    });
  }
  if (window.ACTIVE_TENANT && String(window.ACTIVE_TENANT.slug || '').trim().toLowerCase() === normalizedSlug) {
    window.ACTIVE_TENANT = { ...window.ACTIVE_TENANT, ...nextState };
  }
  DEMO_PROFILE_USERS = DEMO_PROFILE_USERS.map((user) => {
    const tenant = user && user.tenant && typeof user.tenant === 'object' ? user.tenant : {};
    const tenantSlugValue = String(tenant.slug || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    return tenantSlugValue === normalizedSlug
      ? { ...user, tenant: { ...tenant, ...nextState } }
      : user;
  });
  if (window.CURRENT_DEMO_PROFILE && window.CURRENT_DEMO_PROFILE.tenant) {
    const currentTenantSlug = String(window.CURRENT_DEMO_PROFILE.tenant.slug || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (currentTenantSlug === normalizedSlug) {
      window.CURRENT_DEMO_PROFILE = {
        ...window.CURRENT_DEMO_PROFILE,
        tenant: { ...window.CURRENT_DEMO_PROFILE.tenant, ...nextState },
      };
    }
  }
  if (currentDemoUser && currentDemoUser.tenant) {
    const currentTenantSlug = String(currentDemoUser.tenant.slug || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (currentTenantSlug === normalizedSlug) {
      currentDemoUser = {
        ...currentDemoUser,
        tenant: { ...currentDemoUser.tenant, ...nextState },
      };
    }
  }
}

function inferDashboardCardMode(card, fallbackMode) {
  const raw = card && typeof card === 'object' ? card : {};

  if (/风险偏好|流动性|政策温度|市场广度|风格轮动|波动压力|主线热度/.test(combined)) return 'market';
  return normalizeDashboardMode(fallbackMode || 'market');
