function kwRenderKnowledgeMap() {
  const board = document.getElementById('kw-kg-board');
  const stage = document.getElementById('kw-kg-stage');
  const stats = document.getElementById('kw-kg-stats');
  const legend = document.getElementById('kw-kg-legend');
  if (!board || !stage || !stats || !legend) return;
  if (!kwKnowledgeMapState.payload) {
    board.innerHTML = '<div class="kw-kg-detail-empty" style="min-height:720px;background:transparent;color:var(--text-sub)">知识图谱尚未加载。</div>';
    kwRenderKnowledgeMapDetail(null);
    return;
  }
  const filtered = kwGetFilteredKnowledgeMapPayload();
  const payload = filtered.payload;
  const maxDepth = Number(payload.max_depth || 4);
  kwKnowledgeMapState.depth = filtered.depth;
  kwKnowledgeMapState.defaultDepth = Number(payload.default_depth || 3);
  stage.textContent = `当前显示 ${filtered.depth} 层 / 共 ${maxDepth} 层。默认优先展示主题、实体、方法和观点，验证信号需要继续展开。`;
  const statPayload = payload.stats || {};
  stats.innerHTML = `
    <div class="kw-kg-stat"><div class="kw-kg-stat-label">知识条目</div><div class="kw-kg-stat-value">${statPayload.artifact_count || 0}</div></div>
    <div class="kw-kg-stat"><div class="kw-kg-stat-label">主题</div><div class="kw-kg-stat-value">${statPayload.topic_count || 0}</div></div>
    <div class="kw-kg-stat"><div class="kw-kg-stat-label">实体</div><div class="kw-kg-stat-value">${statPayload.entity_count || 0}</div></div>
    <div class="kw-kg-stat"><div class="kw-kg-stat-label">方法</div><div class="kw-kg-stat-value">${statPayload.method_count || 0}</div></div>
    <div class="kw-kg-stat"><div class="kw-kg-stat-label">观点</div><div class="kw-kg-stat-value">${statPayload.claim_count || 0}</div></div>
    <div class="kw-kg-stat"><div class="kw-kg-stat-label">验证信号</div><div class="kw-kg-stat-value">${statPayload.signal_count || 0}</div></div>
  `;
  legend.innerHTML = [
    ['root', '根节点'],
    ['topic', '主题'],
    ['entity', '实体'],
    ['method', '方法'],
    ['claim', '观点'],
    ['signal', '验证信号'],
  ].map(([kind, label]) => `<span class="kw-kg-legend-chip"><span class="kw-kg-legend-dot kind-${kind}"></span>${escapeHtml(label)}</span>`).join('');
  if (!filtered.nodes.length) {
    board.innerHTML = '<div class="kw-kg-detail-empty" style="min-height:720px;background:transparent;color:var(--text-sub)">当前没有匹配的知识对象。可以清空搜索词，或先补充结构化知识内容。</div>';
    kwRenderKnowledgeMapDetail(null);
    return;
  }
  const shell = document.querySelector('.kw-kg-board-shell');
  const groups = {};
  filtered.nodes.forEach((node) => {
    const level = Number(node.level || 1);
    if (!groups[level]) groups[level] = [];
    groups[level].push(node);
  });
  Object.keys(groups).forEach((key) => {
    groups[key].sort((a, b) => String(a.label || '').localeCompare(String(b.label || ''), 'zh-Hans-CN'));
  });
  const levelList = Object.keys(groups).map(Number).sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const perRing = 16;
  const baseRadius = 140;
  const levelGap = 110;
  const ringGap = 56;
  let maxRadius = 0;
  levelList.forEach((level) => {
    if (level <= 1) return;
    const groupSize = (groups[level] || []).length;
    const ringIndex = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(groupSize / perRing) - 1);
    maxRadius = Math.max(maxRadius, baseRadius + (level - 2) * levelGap + ringIndex * ringGap);
  });
  const viewportWidth = Math.max(960, shell ? shell.clientWidth : 960);
  const viewportHeight = Math.max(720, shell ? shell.clientHeight : 720);
  const width = Math.max(viewportWidth, maxRadius * 2 + 360);
  const height = Math.max(viewportHeight, maxRadius * 2 + 300);
  const centerX = width / 2;
  const centerY = height / 2;
  const positions = {};
  levelList.forEach((level) => {
    const group = groups[level] || [];
    if (level === 1) {
      const rootNode = group[0];
      if (rootNode) positions[rootNode.id] = { x: centerX, y: centerY };
      return;
    }
    group.forEach((node, index) => {
      const ringIndex = Math.floor(index / perRing);
      const ringRadius = baseRadius + (level - 2) * levelGap + ringIndex * ringGap;
      const ringSize = Math.min(perRing, Math.max(group.length - ringIndex * perRing, 1));
      const angle = ((index % perRing) / ringSize) * Math.PI * 2 - Math.PI / 2;
      positions[node.id] = {
        x: centerX + Math.cos(angle) * ringRadius,
        y: centerY + Math.sin(angle) * ringRadius,
      };
    });
  });
  const nodeMap = new Map(filtered.nodes.map((node) => [node.id, node]));
  const edgeMarkup = filtered.edges.map((edge) => {
    const from = positions[edge.from];
    const to = positions[edge.to];
    if (!from || !to) return '';
    return `<line class="kw-kg-edge" x1="${Math.round(from.x)}" y1="${Math.round(from.y)}" x2="${Math.round(to.x)}" y2="${Math.round(to.y)}"></line>`;
  }).join('');
  board.innerHTML = `
    <svg class="kw-kg-svg" viewBox="0 0 ${width} ${height}" preserveAspectRatio="none">${edgeMarkup}</svg>
    ${filtered.nodes.map((node) => {
      const pos = positions[node.id] || { x: centerX, y: centerY };
      return `
        <button
          type="button"
          class="kw-kg-node kind-${escapeAttr(node.kind || 'topic')}${kwKnowledgeMapState.selectedNodeId === node.id ? ' is-active' : ''}"
          style="left:${Math.round(pos.x)}px;top:${Math.round(pos.y)}px;width:${kwKnowledgeMapNodeWidth(node.kind)}px"
          data-node-id="${escapeAttr(node.id || '')}"
        >
          <div class="kw-kg-node-kind">${escapeHtml(kwKnowledgeMapKindLabel(node.kind || ''))}</div>
          <div class="kw-kg-node-label">${escapeHtml(node.full_label || node.label || '')}</div>
        </button>
      `;
    }).join('')}
  `;
  board.style.width = `${Math.round(width)}px`;
  board.style.height = `${Math.round(height)}px`;
  Array.from(board.querySelectorAll('[data-node-id]')).forEach((nodeEl) => {
    nodeEl.addEventListener('click', () => kwSelectKnowledgeMapNode(nodeEl.getAttribute('data-node-id') || ''));
  });
  const activeNode = nodeMap.get(kwKnowledgeMapState.selectedNodeId) || filtered.nodes.find((node) => node.kind === 'root') || filtered.nodes[0];
  kwKnowledgeMapState.selectedNodeId = activeNode ? activeNode.id : '';
  kwRenderKnowledgeMapDetail(activeNode || null);
  const centerTarget = kwKnowledgeMapState.centerNodeId || '';
  if (centerTarget && positions[centerTarget]) kwCenterKnowledgeMapNode(centerTarget, positions);
  kwKnowledgeMapState.centerNodeId = '';
}

async function loadWorkbenchKnowledgeMap(forceMessage = false) {
  const stage = document.getElementById('kw-kg-stage');
  if (stage) stage.textContent = '正在加载知识图谱…';
  try {
    const tenantSlug = (window.WORKBENCH_DATA && window.WORKBENCH_DATA.tenant && window.WORKBENCH_DATA.tenant.slug) || '';
    const resp = await fetch(`/api/kol/knowledge-graph?tenant=${encodeURIComponent(tenantSlug)}`);
    const data = await resp.json();
    if (!resp.ok || !data.ok) throw new Error((data && data.error) || 'knowledge_graph_load_failed');
    kwKnowledgeMapState.loaded = true;
    kwKnowledgeMapState.payload = data.graph || {};
    kwKnowledgeMapState.depth = Number((data.graph && data.graph.default_depth) || 3);
    kwKnowledgeMapState.defaultDepth = Number((data.graph && data.graph.default_depth) || 3);
    if (!kwKnowledgeMapState.selectedNodeId) {
      kwKnowledgeMapState.selectedNodeId = String((data.graph && data.graph.root_id) || '');
      kwKnowledgeMapState.centerNodeId = kwKnowledgeMapState.selectedNodeId;
    }
    kwRenderKnowledgeMap();
    if (forceMessage) showToast('知识图谱已刷新');
  } catch (error) {
    if (stage) stage.textContent = '知识图谱加载失败，当前无法展示。';
    const board = document.getElementById('kw-kg-board');
    if (board) board.innerHTML = '<div class="kw-kg-detail-empty" style="min-height:720px;background:transparent;color:var(--text-sub)">知识图谱加载失败。请稍后重试，或先检查知识条目是否已成功同步。</div>';
    kwRenderKnowledgeMapDetail(null);
    showToast(error.message || '知识图谱加载失败');
  }
}

function kwRenderKnowledgeAssetCharts(payload) {
  const section = document.getElementById('workbench-section-knowledge-encyclopedia');
  if (!section || section.style.display === 'none' || !window.GangtiseEcharts) return;
  const summary = payload && payload.summary && typeof payload.summary === 'object' ? payload.summary : {};
  const entries = Array.isArray(payload && payload.entries) ? payload.entries : [];
  const groups = payload && payload.relationship_groups && typeof payload.relationship_groups === 'object' ? payload.relationship_groups : {};
  const sourceRows = Array.isArray(payload && payload.source_breakdown) ? payload.source_breakdown : [];
  const axis = (overrides) => window.GangtiseEcharts.axisBase(Object.assign({
    axisLabel: { color: '#445468', fontSize: 11 },
  }, overrides || {}));
  const grid = (overrides) => window.GangtiseEcharts.gridBase(Object.assign({
    top: 28,
    left: 18,
    right: 18,
    bottom: 38,
  }, overrides || {}));
  ['kw-knowledge-source-chart', 'kw-knowledge-maturity-chart', 'kw-knowledge-hotspot-chart', 'kw-knowledge-coverage-chart']
    .forEach((id) => window.GangtiseEcharts.dispose(id));

  if (sourceRows.length) {
    const topRows = sourceRows.slice(0, 8);
    window.GangtiseEcharts.render('kw-knowledge-source-chart', {
      color: ['#2F74C0'],
      tooltip: window.GangtiseEcharts.tooltipBase((params) => `${params.name}<br>词条：${params.value}`),
      grid: grid({ top: 18, left: 18, right: 18, bottom: 48 }),
      xAxis: {
        ...axis({ splitLine: { show: false } }),
        type: 'category',
        data: topRows.map((item) => item.label || '--'),
        axisLabel: { color: '#445468', fontSize: 11, interval: 0, rotate: topRows.length > 4 ? 20 : 0 },
      },
      yAxis: {
        ...axis({ axisLabel: { color: '#445468', fontSize: 11 } }),
        type: 'value',
      },
      series: [{
        type: 'bar',
        data: topRows.map((item) => Number(item.count || 0)),
        barWidth: 18,
        itemStyle: { color: '#2F74C0', borderRadius: [8, 8, 0, 0] },
      }],
    });
  } else {
    kwRenderKnowledgeAssetEmptyChart('kw-knowledge-source-chart', '当前没有来源分布数据。');
  }

  const maturityRows = (() => {
    const counter = new Map();
    entries.forEach((entry) => {
      const label = String(entry && entry.maturity_label || '未分层').trim() || '未分层';
      counter.set(label, (counter.get(label) || 0) + 1);
    });
    return Array.from(counter.entries()).map(([label, value]) => ({ label, value }));
  })();
  if (maturityRows.length) {
    const colorMap = { '可复用': '#3DAA77', '就绪': '#3DAA77', '成长': '#2F74C0', '成长中': '#2F74C0', '构建': '#C8A96E', '构建中': '#C8A96E', '种子': '#8FA6C4', '未分层': '#D7E3F3' };
    window.GangtiseEcharts.render('kw-knowledge-maturity-chart', {
      color: maturityRows.map((item) => colorMap[item.label] || '#8FA6C4'),
      tooltip: window.GangtiseEcharts.tooltipBase((params) => `${params.name}<br>词条：${params.value}`),
      legend: window.GangtiseEcharts.legendBase({ bottom: 0, textStyle: { color: '#445468', fontSize: 11 } }),
      series: [{
        type: 'pie',
        radius: ['48%', '72%'],
        center: ['50%', '42%'],
        label: { color: '#445468', fontSize: 11, formatter: '{b}\n{c}' },
        labelLine: { length: 10, length2: 8 },
        data: maturityRows.map((item) => ({ name: item.label, value: item.value })),
      }],
    });
  } else {
    kwRenderKnowledgeAssetEmptyChart('kw-knowledge-maturity-chart', '当前没有成熟度分布数据。');
  }

  const hotspotRows = [
    ...((Array.isArray(groups.topics) ? groups.topics : []).slice(0, 3).map((item) => ({ label: `主题 · ${item.label || '--'}`, count: Number(item.count || 0) }))),
    ...((Array.isArray(groups.entities) ? groups.entities : []).slice(0, 3).map((item) => ({ label: `实体 · ${item.label || '--'}`, count: Number(item.count || 0) }))),
    ...((Array.isArray(groups.methods) ? groups.methods : []).slice(0, 2).map((item) => ({ label: `方法 · ${item.label || '--'}`, count: Number(item.count || 0) }))),
    ...((Array.isArray(groups.signals) ? groups.signals : []).slice(0, 2).map((item) => ({ label: `信号 · ${item.label || '--'}`, count: Number(item.count || 0) }))),
  ].sort((a, b) => b.count - a.count).slice(0, 10);
  if (hotspotRows.length) {
    window.GangtiseEcharts.render('kw-knowledge-hotspot-chart', {
      color: ['#C8A96E'],
      tooltip: window.GangtiseEcharts.tooltipBase((params) => `${params.name}<br>关联：${params.value}`),
      grid: grid({ top: 18, left: 18, right: 18, bottom: 24, containLabel: true }),
      xAxis: {
        ...axis({ splitLine: { show: false } }),
        type: 'value',
      },
      yAxis: {
        ...axis({ axisLabel: { color: '#445468', fontSize: 11 } }),
        type: 'category',
        data: hotspotRows.map((item) => item.label).reverse(),
      },
      series: [{
        type: 'bar',
        data: hotspotRows.map((item) => item.count).reverse(),
        barWidth: 14,
        itemStyle: { color: '#C8A96E', borderRadius: [0, 8, 8, 0] },
      }],
    });
  } else {
    kwRenderKnowledgeAssetEmptyChart('kw-knowledge-hotspot-chart', '当前没有热点结构数据。');
  }

  const coverageRows = [
    { label: '主题', value: Number(summary.topic_count || 0), color: '#2F74C0' },
    { label: '实体', value: Number(summary.entity_count || 0), color: '#C8A96E' },
    { label: '方法', value: Number(summary.method_count || 0), color: '#3DAA77' },
    { label: '信号', value: Number(summary.signal_count || 0), color: '#8FA6C4' },
  ];
  if (coverageRows.some((item) => item.value > 0)) {
    window.GangtiseEcharts.render('kw-knowledge-coverage-chart', {
      color: coverageRows.map((item) => item.color),
      tooltip: window.GangtiseEcharts.tooltipBase((params) => `${params.name}<br>数量：${params.value}`),
      grid: grid({ top: 18, left: 18, right: 18, bottom: 42 }),
      xAxis: {
        ...axis({ splitLine: { show: false } }),
        type: 'category',
        data: coverageRows.map((item) => item.label),
      },
      yAxis: {
        ...axis({ axisLabel: { color: '#445468', fontSize: 11 } }),
        type: 'value',
      },
      series: [{
        type: 'bar',
        data: coverageRows.map((item) => ({ value: item.value, itemStyle: { color: item.color, borderRadius: [8, 8, 0, 0] } })),
        barWidth: 24,
      }],
    });
  } else {
    kwRenderKnowledgeAssetEmptyChart('kw-knowledge-coverage-chart', '当前没有结构覆盖数据。');
  }
}

async function loadWorkbenchKnowledgeAssets(forceMessage = false) {
  const tenantSlug = (window.WORKBENCH_DATA && window.WORKBENCH_DATA.tenant && window.WORKBENCH_DATA.tenant.slug) || '';
  try {
    const resp = await fetch(`/api/kol/knowledge-assets?tenant=${encodeURIComponent(tenantSlug)}`);
    const data = await resp.json();
    if (!resp.ok || !data.ok) throw new Error((data && data.error) || 'knowledge_assets_load_failed');
    kwKnowledgeAssetState.payload = data.assets || {};
    kwKnowledgeAssetState.loaded = true;
    kwRenderKnowledgeAssets();
    kwRenderKnowledgeOverview();
    if (forceMessage) showToast('知识资产已刷新');
  } catch (error) {
    kwKnowledgeAssetState.payload = { summary: {}, relationship_groups: {}, source_breakdown: [], entries: [] };
    kwRenderKnowledgeAssets();
    kwRenderKnowledgeOverview();
    if (forceMessage) showToast(error.message || '知识资产加载失败');
  }
}

async function kwSubmitKnowledgeChat() {
  const tenantSlug = (window.ACTIVE_TENANT && window.ACTIVE_TENANT.slug) || '';
  const input = document.getElementById('kw-knowledge-chat-input');
  const submitModelInput = document.getElementById('kw-knowledge-chat-submit-model');
  const query = input ? String(input.value || '').trim() : '';
  const submitToModel = submitModelInput ? !!submitModelInput.checked : false;
  if (!tenantSlug) {
    showToast('tenant_missing');
    return;
  }
  if (!query) {
    showToast('请先输入问题');
    return;
  }
  kwKnowledgeChatState = {
    answer: '正在查询知识库，请稍候...',
    matches: [],
    submitToModel,
    llmMode: submitToModel ? 'requesting_model' : 'retrieval_only',
    llmNotice: submitToModel ? '已请求带上通用模型配置，正在查询知识库...' : '当前为纯知识检索模式，未提交给大模型。',
    llmModel: null,
  };
  kwRenderKnowledgeChatResult();
  try {
    const resp = await fetch('/api/kol/knowledge/query', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        tenant_slug: tenantSlug,
        query,
        submit_to_model: submitToModel,
        limit: 5,
      }),
    });
    const data = await resp.json();
    if (!resp.ok || !data.ok) throw new Error(data.error || 'knowledge_query_failed');
    kwKnowledgeChatState = {
      answer: data.answer || '未返回结果。',
      matches: Array.isArray(data.matches) ? data.matches : [],
      submitToModel: !!data.submit_to_model,
      llmMode: data.llm_mode || 'retrieval_only',
      llmNotice: data.llm_notice || '',
      llmModel: data.llm_model || null,
    };
    kwRenderKnowledgeChatResult();
    showToast('知识库查询完成');
  } catch (error) {
    kwKnowledgeChatState = {
      answer: error.message || '知识库查询失败',
      matches: [],
      submitToModel,
      llmMode: 'error',
      llmNotice: '',
      llmModel: null,
    };
    kwRenderKnowledgeChatResult();
    showToast(error.message || '知识库查询失败');
  }
}

function kwSwitchKnowledgeIntakeType(type) {
  if (!KW_KNOWLEDGE_INPUT_TYPES[type]) return;
  kwSyncKnowledgeDraftFromModal();
  if (type === 'manual' && !String(kwKnowledgeHtmlToPlainText(kwKnowledgeDraft.rawHtml || '')).trim()) {
    const voiceText = String(kwKnowledgeDraft.rawInput || '').trim();
    if (voiceText) {
      kwKnowledgeDraft.rawHtml = kwPlainTextToKnowledgeHtml(voiceText);
    }
  }
  kwKnowledgeIntakeType = type;
  kwKnowledgeRecording = false;
  if (type !== 'file') {
    kwKnowledgeUploadSamples = [];
    kwKnowledgeUploadBodies = [];
    kwKnowledgeUploadMeta = [];
  }
  if (type !== 'url') kwKnowledgeUrlPreview = null;
  kwRenderKnowledgeModal();
}

function kwToggleKnowledgeVoiceCapture() {
  if (kwKnowledgeVoiceUploading) return;
  kwSyncKnowledgeDraftFromModal();
  if (!navigator.mediaDevices || !navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia || typeof MediaRecorder === 'undefined') {
    showToast('当前浏览器不支持录音');
    return;
  }
  if (kwKnowledgeRecording && kwKnowledgeVoiceRecorder) {
    kwKnowledgeVoiceRecorder.stop();
    return;
  }
  navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true }).then((stream) => {
    const mimeType = MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported('audio/webm') ? 'audio/webm' : '';
    kwKnowledgeVoiceChunks = [];
    kwKnowledgeVoiceRecorder = new MediaRecorder(stream, mimeType ? { mimeType } : undefined);
    kwKnowledgeRecording = true;
    kwKnowledgeVoiceRecorder.ondataavailable = (event) => {
      if (event.data && event.data.size > 0) {
        kwKnowledgeVoiceChunks.push(event.data);
      }
    };
    kwKnowledgeVoiceRecorder.onerror = () => {
      kwKnowledgeRecording = false;
      kwKnowledgeVoiceUploading = false;
      stream.getTracks().forEach((track) => track.stop());
      kwRenderKnowledgeModal();
      showToast('录音失败，请重试');
    };
    kwKnowledgeVoiceRecorder.onstop = async () => {
      kwKnowledgeRecording = false;
      kwKnowledgeVoiceUploading = true;
      kwRenderKnowledgeModal();
      const blob = new Blob(kwKnowledgeVoiceChunks, { type: kwKnowledgeVoiceRecorder.mimeType || 'audio/webm' });
      stream.getTracks().forEach((track) => track.stop());
      try {
        const data = await kwUploadKnowledgeVoiceBlob(blob);
        if (!data.async || !data.job_code) throw new Error('voice_transcribe_job_missing');
        showToast('语音已提交，正在后台转写');
        kwStartAsyncJobPolling(data.job_code, {
          onSuccess(job) {
            const result = job.result || {};
            const transcript = String(result.display_transcript || result.enhanced_transcript || result.transcript || '').trim();
            const hadBody = !!String(kwKnowledgeDraft.rawInput || '').trim();
            if (!String(kwKnowledgeDraft.title || '').trim()) {
              kwKnowledgeDraft.title = '最新语音纪要整理';
            }
            kwKnowledgeDraft.rawInput = kwAppendTranscribedText(kwKnowledgeDraft.rawInput, transcript || '语音转写已完成，请继续补充观点和验证节点。');
            kwKnowledgeDraft.rawHtml = `<p>${escapeHtml(kwKnowledgeDraft.rawInput).replace(/\n/g, '<br>')}</p>`;
            kwKnowledgeDraft.summary = kwKnowledgeDraft.rawInput ? kwKnowledgeDraft.rawInput.slice(0, 140) : '系统已完成语音转写，待进一步整理摘要。';
            showToast(hadBody ? '录音已结束，转写结果已追加' : '录音已结束，转写结果已回填');
            kwRenderKnowledgeModal();
          },
          onFailed(job) {
            showToast(job.error_message || '语音转写失败');
          },
        });
      } catch (error) {
        showToast(error.message || '语音转写失败');
      } finally {
        kwKnowledgeVoiceUploading = false;
        kwKnowledgeVoiceRecorder = null;
        kwKnowledgeVoiceChunks = [];
        kwRenderKnowledgeModal();
      }
    };
    kwKnowledgeVoiceRecorder.start();
    kwRenderKnowledgeModal();
  }).catch(() => {
    showToast('未获得麦克风权限');
  });
}

function kwOpenKnowledgeFilePicker(multiple) {
  const input = document.createElement('input');
  input.type = 'file';
  input.accept = '.pdf,.docx,.xlsx,.xlsm,.txt,.md,.csv,.html,.htm';
  input.multiple = !!multiple;
  input.onchange = async () => {
    const files = Array.from(input.files || []);
    if (!files.length) return;
    kwSyncKnowledgeDraftFromModal();
    kwKnowledgeUploadSamples = [];
    kwKnowledgeUploadBodies = [];
    kwKnowledgeUploadMeta = [];
    for (const file of files) {
      const formData = new FormData();
      formData.append('file', file, file.name);
      const resp = await fetch('/api/kol/knowledge/file-preview', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: formData,
      });
      const data = await resp.json();
      if (!resp.ok || !data.ok) {
        showToast((data && data.error) || `文件解析失败：${file.name}`);
        continue;
      }
      const preview = data.preview || {};
      kwKnowledgeUploadSamples.push(preview.filename || file.name);
      kwKnowledgeUploadBodies.push(preview.body || '');
      kwKnowledgeUploadMeta.push(preview);
      if (!kwKnowledgeDraft.title) kwKnowledgeDraft.title = preview.filename || file.name;
      if (!kwKnowledgeDraft.summary) kwKnowledgeDraft.summary = preview.summary || '';
      const nextBody = preview.body || preview.summary || '';
      if (nextBody) {
        kwKnowledgeDraft.rawInput = kwAppendTranscribedText(kwKnowledgeDraft.rawInput || '', nextBody);
        kwKnowledgeDraft.rawHtml = kwMergePlainTextIntoKnowledgeHtml(kwKnowledgeDraft.rawHtml || '', nextBody);
        kwKnowledgeIntakeType = 'manual';
      }
    }
    kwRenderKnowledgeModal();
    if (kwKnowledgeUploadSamples.length) showToast(`已解析 ${kwKnowledgeUploadSamples.length} 个文件，可继续手动修改`);
  };
  input.click();
}

async function kwPreviewKnowledgeUrl() {
  kwSyncKnowledgeDraftFromModal();
  const url = (kwKnowledgeDraft.url || '').trim();

    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({ url }),
  });
  const data = await resp.json();
  if (!resp.ok || !data.ok) {
    showToast((data && data.error) || '网页抓取失败');
    return;
  }
  kwKnowledgeUrlPreview = data.preview || null;
  if (kwKnowledgeUrlPreview) {
    if (!kwKnowledgeDraft.title) kwKnowledgeDraft.title = kwKnowledgeUrlPreview.title || '';
    if (!kwKnowledgeDraft.summary) kwKnowledgeDraft.summary = kwKnowledgeUrlPreview.summary || '';
    const nextBody = kwKnowledgeUrlPreview.body || kwKnowledgeUrlPreview.summary || '';
    if (nextBody) {
      kwKnowledgeDraft.rawInput = kwAppendTranscribedText(kwKnowledgeDraft.rawInput || '', nextBody);
      kwKnowledgeDraft.rawHtml = kwMergePlainTextIntoKnowledgeHtml(kwKnowledgeDraft.rawHtml || '', nextBody);
      kwKnowledgeIntakeType = 'manual';
    }
  }
  kwRenderKnowledgeModal();
  if (kwKnowledgeUrlPreview) showToast('网页内容已提取，可继续手动修改');
}

      ...payload,

}

async function kwSubmitKnowledgeTuning() {
  initializeKwKnowledgeStore();
  kwSyncKnowledgeDraftFromModal();
  const cfg = KW_KNOWLEDGE_INPUT_TYPES[kwKnowledgeIntakeType] || KW_KNOWLEDGE_INPUT_TYPES.voice;
  if (kwKnowledgeIntakeType === 'file' && !kwKnowledgeUploadSamples.length && !kwKnowledgeEditingId) {
    showToast('请先选择至少一个文件');
    return;
  }
  if (kwKnowledgeIntakeType === 'url' && !kwKnowledgeUrlPreview && !(kwKnowledgeEditingId && kwKnowledgeDraft.url)) {
    showToast('请先抓取网页摘要');
    return;
  }
  if (kwKnowledgeIntakeType === 'manual' && !String(kwKnowledgeDraft.rawInput || '').trim() && !String(kwKnowledgeDraft.summary || '').trim()) {
    showToast('请先输入正文或摘要');
    return;
  }
  const title = String(kwKnowledgeDraft.title || '').trim() || cfg.defaultTitle;
  const summary = String(kwKnowledgeDraft.summary || '').trim() || cfg.placeholder.replace('例如：', '');
  const rawInput = String(kwKnowledgeDraft.rawInput || '').trim();
  const rawHtml = kwNormalizeKnowledgeHtml(kwKnowledgeDraft.rawHtml || '');
  const notes = String(kwKnowledgeDraft.notes || '').trim();
  const notesHtml = kwNormalizeKnowledgeHtml(kwKnowledgeDraft.notesHtml || '');
  const effectiveKnowledgeBody = rawInput || (kwKnowledgeIntakeType === 'file'
    ? kwKnowledgeUploadBodies.join('\n\n')
    : kwKnowledgeIntakeType === 'url'
      ? ((kwKnowledgeUrlPreview && kwKnowledgeUrlPreview.body) || summary)
      : summary);
  const editingEntry = kwKnowledgeEditingId ? getKwKnowledgeEntryById(kwKnowledgeEditingId) : null;
  if (kwKnowledgeIntakeType === 'manual') {
    try {
      const payload = await kwSaveManualKnowledgeEntry({
        id: editingEntry ? editingEntry.id : '',
        title,
        summary,
        body: rawInput || summary,
        raw_html: rawHtml,
        notes,
        notes_html: notesHtml,
        skip_ai_processing: (kwKnowledgeDraft.processingMode || 'algorithm') === 'none',
        processing_mode: kwKnowledgeDraft.processingMode || 'algorithm',
      });
      if (!payload.async || !payload.job_code) throw new Error('knowledge_job_missing');
      const optimisticId = editingEntry ? editingEntry.id : `kw-kb-pending-${Date.now()}`;
      kwAddOrReplaceKnowledgeEntry({
        ...(editingEntry || {}),
        id: optimisticId,
        type: 'manual',
        title,
        source: '纯文本编写',
        source_detail: '来源：纯文本编写',
        status: '同步中',
        summary,
        raw_input: rawInput || summary,
        raw_html: rawHtml,
        notes,
        notes_html: notesHtml,
        body: rawInput || summary,
        skip_ai_processing: (kwKnowledgeDraft.processingMode || 'algorithm') === 'none',
        processing_mode: kwKnowledgeDraft.processingMode || 'algorithm',
      });
      kwRenderKnowledgeList();
      kwCloseKnowledgeModal();
      showToast(editingEntry ? '知识微调已提交，后台处理中' : '知识已提交入库，后台处理中');
      kwStartAsyncJobPolling(payload.job_code, {
        onSuccess(job) {
          const result = job.result || {};
          if (result.knowledge_hub && Array.isArray(result.knowledge_hub.items)) {
            kwKnowledgeStore = result.knowledge_hub.items.map(item => ({...item}));
            if (window.WORKBENCH_DATA && window.WORKBENCH_DATA.knowledge_hub) {
              window.WORKBENCH_DATA.knowledge_hub = result.knowledge_hub;
            }
          }
          kwRenderKnowledgeList();
          loadWorkbenchKnowledgeAssets(false);
          kwOpenReviewIngestResultModal(editingEntry ? '知识微调成功，已写入向量库' : '知识入库成功，已写入向量库', [
            `embedding 引擎：${result.embedding_engine || '-'}`,
            `embedding 模型：${result.embedding_model || '-'}`,
            `存储方式：${(result.vector_record && result.vector_record.storage_mode) || '-'}`,
            `namespace：${(result.vector_record && result.vector_record.vector_namespace) || '-'}`,
            `知识标题：${title}`,
            `知识摘要：${summary}`,
            `正文预览：${(rawInput || summary || '').slice(0, 240)}`,
          ]);

      source_mode: String(userInputSection.source_mode || kwReviewDraft.sourceMode || 'manual').trim().toLowerCase() || 'manual',

      sector_profiles: Array.isArray(watchlistAnalysisSection.sector_profiles) ? watchlistAnalysisSection.sector_profiles.map((item) => ({
        sector: String((item || {}).sector || '').trim(),
        stock_names: Array.isArray((item || {}).stock_names) ? item.stock_names.slice(0) : [],
        representative_description: String((item || {}).representative_description || '').trim(),
      })) : [],
      items: Array.isArray(watchlistAnalysisSection.items) ? watchlistAnalysisSection.items.map((item) => ({
        stock_name: String((item || {}).stock_name || '').trim(),
        stock_code: String((item || {}).stock_code || '').trim(),
        sector: String((item || {}).sector || '').trim(),
        board_role: String((item || {}).board_role || '').trim(),
        analysis_text: String((item || {}).analysis_text || '').trim(),
        evidence: Array.isArray((item || {}).evidence) ? item.evidence.slice(0) : [],
      })) : [],
      annotation_evidence: Array.isArray(watchlistAnalysisSection.annotation_evidence) ? watchlistAnalysisSection.annotation_evidence.map((item) => ({
        annotation_id: (item || {}).annotation_id,
        stock_name: String((item || {}).stock_name || '').trim(),

function kwBuildReviewWatchlistAnalysisText(section) {
  const payload = section && typeof section === 'object' ? section : {};
  const combinedText = String(payload.combined_text || '').trim();
  const sectorSummary = String(payload.sector_summary || '').trim();
  if (combinedText) return [combinedText, sectorSummary ? `板块归纳：${sectorSummary}` : ''].filter(Boolean).join('\n\n');
  const parts = [];
  if (sectorSummary) parts.push(`板块归纳：${sectorSummary}`);
  const sectorProfiles = Array.isArray(payload.sector_profiles) ? payload.sector_profiles : [];
  if (sectorProfiles.length) {
    parts.push('板块代表性：');
    sectorProfiles.forEach((item) => {
      const label = String((item || {}).sector || '').trim();
      const text = String((item || {}).representative_description || '').trim();
      if (label || text) parts.push(`- ${label}：${text}`);
    });
  }
  const items = Array.isArray(payload.items) ? payload.items : [];
  if (items.length) {
    parts.push('逐股归纳：');
    items.forEach((item) => {
      const name = String((item || {}).stock_name || '').trim();
      const sector = String((item || {}).sector || '').trim();
      const body = String((item || {}).analysis_text || '').trim();
      if (name || body) parts.push(`- ${name}${sector ? `（${sector}）` : ''}：${body}`);
    });
  }
  return parts.join('\n').trim();
}

  }
  if (raw.includes('llm_request_failed')) {

  }
  if (raw.includes('review_prepare_preview_failed')) {

  }
  if (raw.includes('review_sector_summary_llm_not_configured')) {

  }
  if (raw.includes('review_sector_summary_empty_llm_response')) {

async function kwFetchAsyncJob(jobCode) {
  const resp = await fetch(`/api/jobs/${encodeURIComponent(jobCode)}`);
  const data = await resp.json();
  if (!resp.ok || !data.ok) throw new Error((data && data.error) || 'job_status_failed');
  return data.job;
}

function kwStartAsyncJobPolling(jobCode, handlers) {
  if (!jobCode) return;
  if (kwPendingAsyncJobs[jobCode]) {
    clearTimeout(kwPendingAsyncJobs[jobCode]);
    delete kwPendingAsyncJobs[jobCode];
  }
  const tick = async () => {
    try {
      const job = await kwFetchAsyncJob(jobCode);
      if (handlers && typeof handlers.onProgress === 'function') handlers.onProgress(job);
      if (job.status === 'success') {
        if (handlers && typeof handlers.onSuccess === 'function') handlers.onSuccess(job);
        delete kwPendingAsyncJobs[jobCode];
        return;
      }
      if (job.status === 'failed') {
        if (handlers && typeof handlers.onFailed === 'function') handlers.onFailed(job);
        delete kwPendingAsyncJobs[jobCode];
        return;
      }
      if (job.status === 'cancelled') {
        if (handlers && typeof handlers.onCancelled === 'function') handlers.onCancelled(job);
        delete kwPendingAsyncJobs[jobCode];
        return;
      }
      kwPendingAsyncJobs[jobCode] = setTimeout(tick, 1500);
    } catch (error) {
      if (handlers && typeof handlers.onError === 'function') handlers.onError(error);
      delete kwPendingAsyncJobs[jobCode];
    }
  };
  kwPendingAsyncJobs[jobCode] = setTimeout(tick, 1200);
}

}

function kwHydrateReviewDraftFromJob(job) {
  const payload = job && job.payload && typeof job.payload === 'object' ? job.payload : {};
  kwReviewDraft.period = String(payload.period || kwReviewDraft.period || 'day').trim().toLowerCase() || 'day';
  kwReviewDraft.reviewTitle = String(payload.review_title || kwReviewDraft.reviewTitle || '').trim();
  kwReviewDraft.sourceMode = String(payload.source_mode || kwReviewDraft.sourceMode || 'manual').trim().toLowerCase() || 'manual';
  kwReviewDraft.selectedWatchlist = Array.isArray(payload.selected_watchlist) ? payload.selected_watchlist.slice(0) : [];
  kwReviewDraft.aiPrompt = String(payload.prompt_text || '');
  kwReviewDraft.promptTags = Array.isArray(payload.prompt_tags) ? payload.prompt_tags.slice(0) : [];
  const sourceText = String(payload.source_text || '').trim();
  if (kwReviewDraft.sourceMode === 'voice') kwReviewDraft.voiceTranscript = sourceText;
  else if (kwReviewDraft.sourceMode === 'file') kwReviewDraft.fileText = sourceText;
  else if (kwReviewDraft.sourceMode === 'url') kwReviewDraft.urlText = sourceText;
  else if (sourceText) kwReviewDraft.manualHtml = kwPlainTextToKnowledgeHtml(sourceText);
}

function kwRemoveActiveReviewJob(jobCode) {
  const normalized = String(jobCode || '').trim();
  kwReviewActiveJobs = kwReviewActiveJobs.filter((item) => String(item.job_code || '').trim() !== normalized);
}

function kwResumeActiveReviewJob(job) {
  if (!job || !job.job_code || kwPendingAsyncJobs[job.job_code]) return;
  const jobType = String(job.job_type || '').trim();
  if (!['review_generate_draft', 'review_prepare_preview'].includes(jobType)) return;
  kwHydrateReviewDraftFromJob(job);
  kwReviewWorkspacePanel = 'generation';
  if (jobType === 'review_generate_draft') {
    kwReviewDraftGenerating = true;
    kwReviewDraftJobState = job;
    kwReviewDraft.flowStage = 'draft_generating';
  } else {
    kwReviewPreviewGenerating = true;
    kwReviewPreviewJobState = job;
    kwReviewDraft.flowStage = 'preview_generating';
  }
  kwRenderReviewStudio();
  kwStartAsyncJobPolling(job.job_code, {
    onProgress(nextJob) {
      if (jobType === 'review_generate_draft') kwReviewDraftJobState = nextJob || kwReviewDraftJobState;
      else kwReviewPreviewJobState = nextJob || kwReviewPreviewJobState;
      kwReviewActiveJobs = kwReviewActiveJobs.map((item) => item.job_code === job.job_code ? (nextJob || item) : item);
      kwRenderReviewStudio();
    },
    onSuccess(nextJob) {
      const result = nextJob.result || {};
      if (jobType === 'review_generate_draft') {
        kwReviewDraft.generatedPreviewText = result.text || '';
        kwReviewDraft.draftReviewText = result.text || kwGetReviewDraftContentText();
        kwReviewIngestResult = { ...(kwReviewIngestResult || {}), review_draft_llm: result.llm_model || null };
        kwReviewDraftGenerating = false;
        kwReviewDraftJobState = nextJob;
        kwReviewDraft.flowStage = 'draft_review';
      } else {
        kwReviewStructuredPreview = kwNormalizeReviewStructuredPreview(result);
        kwReviewPreviewGenerating = false;
        kwReviewPreviewJobState = nextJob;
        kwReviewDraft.flowStage = 'structured_review';
      }
      kwRemoveActiveReviewJob(job.job_code);
      kwReviewWorkspacePanel = 'generation';
      kwRenderReviewStudio();
      showToast(jobType === 'review_generate_draft' ? '优化成稿已完成，请先审核用户内容 Draft' : '洞见预览已生成，请审核后发布');
    },
    onFailed(nextJob) {
      if (jobType === 'review_generate_draft') {
        kwReviewDraftGenerating = false;
        kwReviewDraftJobState = nextJob;
        kwReviewDraft.flowStage = 'optimize_rule';
      } else {
        kwReviewPreviewGenerating = false;
        kwReviewPreviewJobState = nextJob;
        kwReviewDraft.flowStage = 'preview_failed';
      }
      kwRemoveActiveReviewJob(job.job_code);
      kwReviewWorkspacePanel = 'generation';
      kwRenderReviewStudio();
      showToast(nextJob.error_message || nextJob.summary || '洞见任务生成失败');
    },
    onCancelled(nextJob) {
      if (jobType === 'review_generate_draft') {
        kwReviewDraftGenerating = false;
        kwReviewDraftJobState = nextJob;
        kwReviewDraft.flowStage = 'optimize_rule';
      } else {
        kwReviewPreviewGenerating = false;
        kwReviewPreviewJobState = nextJob;
        kwReviewDraft.flowStage = 'draft_review';
      }
      kwRemoveActiveReviewJob(job.job_code);
      kwReviewWorkspacePanel = 'generation';
      kwRenderReviewStudio();
      showToast('已停止生成，原始输入已保留。');
    },
    onError(error) {
      if (jobType === 'review_generate_draft') kwReviewDraftGenerating = false;
      else kwReviewPreviewGenerating = false;
      kwRenderReviewStudio();
      showToast(error.message || '洞见任务状态读取失败');
    },
  });
}

async function kwLoadActiveReviewJobs() {
  const section = document.getElementById('workbench-section-review');
  if (!section || section.style.display === 'none' || kwReviewActiveJobsLoading) return;
  const tenant = window.ACTIVE_TENANT || {};
  const tenantSlug = String(tenant.slug || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!tenantSlug) return;
  kwReviewActiveJobsLoading = true;
  try {
    const resp = await fetch(`/api/review/jobs?tenant_slug=${encodeURIComponent(tenantSlug)}`);
    const data = await resp.json();
    if (!resp.ok || !data.ok) throw new Error((data && data.error) || 'review_jobs_unavailable');
    kwReviewActiveJobs = Array.isArray(data.jobs) ? data.jobs : [];
    kwReviewActiveJobs
      .filter((job) => ['review_generate_draft', 'review_prepare_preview'].includes(String(job.job_type || '').trim()))
      .forEach((job) => kwResumeActiveReviewJob(job));
  } catch (error) {
    console.warn('active workbench review jobs unavailable', error);
  } finally {
    kwReviewActiveJobsLoading = false;
  }
  if (section.style.display !== 'none') {
    if (kwReviewActiveJobsTimer) window.clearTimeout(kwReviewActiveJobsTimer);
    kwReviewActiveJobsTimer = window.setTimeout(kwLoadActiveReviewJobs, 5000);
  }
}

function kwRegisterActiveReviewJob(jobCode, jobType, payload) {

  if (!normalized) return;
  const existing = kwReviewActiveJobs.find((item) => String(item.job_code || '').trim() === normalized);
  const job = {
    ...(existing || {}),
    job_code: normalized,
    job_type: jobType,
    status: 'running',
    progress_stage: 'queued',
    progress_percent: 0,
    summary: '任务已提交，正在后台处理',
    payload: payload && typeof payload === 'object' ? payload : {},
    result: { live_log: [] },
  };
  kwReviewActiveJobs = existing
    ? kwReviewActiveJobs.map((item) => String(item.job_code || '').trim() === normalized ? job : item)
    : [job, ...kwReviewActiveJobs];
}

async function kwCancelReviewAsyncJob() {
  // Keep the prior preview result available for review, but do not mistake it
  // for a newly running Draft task when the user presses stop.
  const isPreview = kwReviewPreviewGenerating || kwReviewDraft.flowStage === 'preview_generating';
  const job = isPreview ? kwReviewPreviewJobState : kwReviewDraftJobState;
  const jobCode = String((job || {}).job_code || '').trim();
  kwReviewCancellationRequested = true;
  if (isPreview) {
    kwReviewPreviewGenerating = false;
    kwReviewPreviewJobState = null;
    kwReviewDraft.flowStage = 'draft_review';
  } else {
    kwReviewDraftGenerating = false;
    kwReviewDraftJobState = null;
    kwReviewDraft.flowStage = 'optimize_rule';
  }
  if (jobCode && kwPendingAsyncJobs[jobCode]) {
    clearTimeout(kwPendingAsyncJobs[jobCode]);
    delete kwPendingAsyncJobs[jobCode];
  }
  kwRemoveActiveReviewJob(jobCode);
  kwRenderReviewStudio();
  showToast('已停止生成，原始输入已保留。');
  if (!jobCode) return;
  try {
    const resp = await fetch(`/api/review/jobs/${encodeURIComponent(jobCode)}/cancel`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
    });
    const data = await resp.json().catch(() => ({}));
    if (!resp.ok || !data.ok) throw new Error((data && data.error) || 'review_job_cancel_failed');
  } catch (error) {
    console.warn('review job cancellation acknowledgement unavailable', error);
  }
}

      kwReviewDraft.flowStage = 'intake';
      kwReviewStructuredPreview = null;
      showToast('文件已解析为文本，可继续编辑后生成 Draft');
    } catch (error) {
      showToast(error.message || '文件解析失败');
    } finally {
      kwReviewFileUploading = false;
      kwRenderReviewStudio();
    }
  };
  input.click();
}

function kwSyncReviewDraftFromModal() {
  const promptInput = document.getElementById('kw-review-ai-prompt-input');
  const draftReviewInput = document.getElementById('kw-review-draft-review-input');
  const structuredUserInput = document.getElementById('kw-review-structured-user-input');
  const structuredSectorSummary = document.getElementById('kw-review-structured-sector-summary');
  const skipAiInput = document.getElementById('kw-review-skip-ai-processing');
  kwSyncReviewDraftFromEditors();
  kwSyncReviewTextInputs();
  if (promptInput) kwReviewDraft.aiPrompt = promptInput.value;
  if (skipAiInput) kwReviewDraft.skipAiProcessing = !!skipAiInput.checked;
  if (draftReviewInput) kwReviewDraft.draftReviewText = draftReviewInput.value;
  if (structuredUserInput || structuredSectorSummary) {
    kwReviewStructuredPreview = kwNormalizeReviewStructuredPreview(kwReviewStructuredPreview || {});
    if (structuredUserInput) {
      kwReviewStructuredPreview.user_input_section = kwReviewStructuredPreview.user_input_section || {};
      kwReviewStructuredPreview.user_input_section.display_text = structuredUserInput.value;
      kwReviewDraft.draftReviewText = structuredUserInput.value;
    }
    if (structuredSectorSummary) {
      kwReviewStructuredPreview.watchlist_analysis_section = kwReviewStructuredPreview.watchlist_analysis_section || {};
      if (String(kwReviewStructuredPreview.watchlist_analysis_section.combined_text || '').trim()) {
        kwReviewStructuredPreview.watchlist_analysis_section.combined_text = structuredSectorSummary.value;
      } else {
        kwReviewStructuredPreview.watchlist_analysis_section.sector_summary = structuredSectorSummary.value;
      }
    }
    const itemNodes = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[data-kw-review-watchlist-analysis-index]'));
    const items = ((kwReviewStructuredPreview.watchlist_analysis_section || {}).items || []);
    itemNodes.forEach((node) => {
      const index = Number(node.getAttribute('data-kw-review-watchlist-analysis-index'));
      if (!Number.isInteger(index) || !items[index]) return;
      items[index].analysis_text = node.value;
    });
  }
}

async function kwPrepareReviewStructuredPreview() {
  // Old browser bookmarks are handled by the current Insight draft route.
  kwPrepareReviewDirectPreview();
  return;
  const runtime = ensureKwReviewRuntime();
  if (!kwValidateReviewIntakeReady()) return;
  kwSyncReviewDraftFromModal();
  kwReviewStructuredPreview = null;
  kwReviewPreviewGenerating = true;
  kwReviewCancellationRequested = false;
  kwReviewPreviewJobState = {
    status: 'running',
    progress_stage: 'queued',
    progress_percent: 8,
    summary: '已提交预览任务，正在准备洞见预览',
    result: { live_log: [] },
  };
  kwReviewDraft.flowStage = 'preview_generating';
  kwReviewDraft.previewReady = false;
  kwReviewWorkspacePanel = 'generation';
  kwRenderReviewStudio();
  try {
    const previewResult = await kwRequestReviewStructuredPreview();
    if (!previewResult.async || !previewResult.job_code) throw new Error('review_prepare_preview_job_missing');
    kwReviewPreviewJobState = {
      ...kwReviewPreviewJobState,
      job_code: previewResult.job_code,
      job_type: 'review_prepare_preview',
    };
    kwRegisterActiveReviewJob(previewResult.job_code, 'review_prepare_preview', {
      tenant_slug: (window.ACTIVE_TENANT || {}).slug || '',
      period: kwReviewDraft.period || 'day',
      review_title: kwReviewDraft.reviewTitle || '',
      source_mode: kwReviewDraft.sourceMode || 'manual',
      source_text: kwGetReviewUserInputDisplayText(),
      selected_watchlist: (kwReviewDraft.selectedWatchlist || []).slice(0),
    });
    if (kwReviewCancellationRequested) {
      await fetch(`/api/review/jobs/${encodeURIComponent(previewResult.job_code)}/cancel`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
      }).catch(() => {});
      kwReviewPreviewJobState = null;
      kwRemoveActiveReviewJob(previewResult.job_code);
      return;
    }
    let completed = false;
    await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      kwStartAsyncJobPolling(previewResult.job_code, {
        onProgress(job) {
          kwReviewPreviewJobState = job || kwReviewPreviewJobState;
          kwRenderReviewStudio();
        },
        onSuccess(job) {
          const result = job.result || {};
          kwReviewStructuredPreview = kwNormalizeReviewStructuredPreview(result);
          kwReviewPreviewGenerating = false;
          kwReviewPreviewJobState = job;
          kwReviewDraft.previewReady = false;
          kwReviewDraft.flowStage = 'structured_review';
          runtime.kolGeneratedAt = '刚刚生成';
          kwReviewWorkspacePanel = 'generation';
          completed = true;
          kwRemoveActiveReviewJob(previewResult.job_code);
          resolve();
        },
        onFailed(job) {
          kwReviewPreviewGenerating = false;
          kwReviewPreviewJobState = job;
          kwReviewDraft.flowStage = 'preview_failed';
          kwReviewWorkspacePanel = 'generation';
          kwRemoveActiveReviewJob(previewResult.job_code);
          kwRenderReviewStudio();
          showToast(job.error_message || job.summary || '洞见预览生成失败');
          resolve();
        },
        onCancelled(job) {
          kwReviewPreviewGenerating = false;
          kwReviewPreviewJobState = job;
          kwReviewDraft.flowStage = 'draft_review';
          kwReviewWorkspacePanel = 'generation';
          kwRemoveActiveReviewJob(previewResult.job_code);
          kwRenderReviewStudio();
          resolve();
        },
        onError(error) {
          reject(error);
        },
      });
    });
    if (!completed) return;
  } catch (error) {
    kwReviewPreviewGenerating = false;
    if (kwReviewDraft.flowStage !== 'preview_failed') {
      kwReviewPreviewJobState = null;
      kwReviewDraft.flowStage = kwReviewDraft.generatedPreviewText ? 'draft_review' : 'intake';
    }
    kwReviewWorkspacePanel = kwReviewDraft.flowStage === 'intake' ? 'input' : 'generation';
    kwRenderReviewStudio();
    showToast(kwGetReviewDraftGenerationErrorMessage(error));
    return;
  } finally {
    kwReviewPreviewGenerating = false;
    if (kwReviewPreviewJobState && kwReviewPreviewJobState.status === 'success') {
      kwReviewPreviewJobState = null;
    }
  }
  kwRenderReviewStudio();
  showToast('洞见预览已生成，请审核后发布');
}

      prompt_tags: (kwReviewDraft.promptTags || []).slice(0),

    });

      await fetch(`/api/review/jobs/${encodeURIComponent(draftResult.job_code)}/cancel`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
      }).catch(() => {});
      kwReviewDraftJobState = null;
      kwRemoveActiveReviewJob(draftResult.job_code);
      return;
    }
    let completed = false;
    await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      kwStartAsyncJobPolling(draftResult.job_code, {
        onProgress(job) {
          kwReviewDraftJobState = job || kwReviewDraftJobState;
          kwRenderReviewStudio();
        },
        onSuccess(job) {
          const result = job.result || {};
          kwReviewDraft.generatedPreviewText = result.text || '';

          kwReviewIngestResult = {
            ...(kwReviewIngestResult || {}),

          kwReviewDraftGenerating = false;

          resolve();
        },
        onFailed(job) {

          kwReviewDraft.flowStage = 'optimize_rule';
          kwRemoveActiveReviewJob(draftResult.job_code);
          kwRenderReviewStudio();
          showToast(job.error_message || job.summary || '大模型洞见草稿生成失败');

          kwRenderReviewStudio();

        },

    if (kwReviewDraftJobState && kwReviewDraftJobState.status === 'success') {

    }
  }
  kwReviewDraft.flowStage = 'draft_review';

function kwAppendTranscribedText(existingText, incomingText) {

async function kwLoadInsightDrafts() {
  const tenant = window.ACTIVE_TENANT || {};
  if (kwInsightDraftsLoading || kwInsightDraftsLoaded || !tenant.slug) return;
  kwInsightDraftsLoading = true;
  try {
    const response = await fetch(`/api/tenant/${encodeURIComponent(tenant.slug)}/insight-drafts`);
    const data = await response.json();
    if (!response.ok || !data.ok) throw new Error(data.error || 'insight_drafts_unavailable');
    kwInsightDrafts = Array.isArray(data.drafts) ? data.drafts : [];
    kwInsightDraftsLoaded = true;
    kwRenderReviewStudio();
  } catch (error) {
    console.warn('Insight drafts unavailable', error);
  } finally {
    kwInsightDraftsLoading = false;
  }
}

function kwEditInsightDraft(draftId) {
  const draft = kwInsightDrafts.find((item) => String((item || {}).id || '') === String(draftId || ''));
  if (!draft) return;
  kwReviewDraft.insightDraftId = String(draft.id || '');
  kwReviewDraft.reviewTitle = String(draft.title || '').trim();
  kwReviewDraft.accessMode = draft.access_mode === 'subscriber' ? 'subscriber' : 'public';
  kwReviewDraft.sourceMode = String(draft.source_mode || 'manual').trim() || 'manual';
  kwReviewDraft.manualHtml = kwMergePlainTextIntoKnowledgeHtml('', String(draft.content_text || '').trim());
  kwReviewDraft.draftReviewText = String(draft.content_text || '').trim();
  kwReviewDraft.generatedPreviewText = '';
  kwReviewDraft.previewReady = false;
  kwReviewDraft.flowStage = 'intake';
  kwReviewWorkspacePanel = 'input';
  kwRenderReviewStudio();
}

async function kwSaveReviewDraft() {
  const tenant = window.ACTIVE_TENANT || {};
  if (!tenant.slug) return;
  kwSyncReviewDraftFromModal();
  const text = kwGetReviewPreviewText() || kwGetReviewDraftContentText();
  if (!String(kwReviewDraft.reviewTitle || '').trim()) {
    showToast('请先填写洞见主题');
    return;
  }
  if (!String(text || '').trim()) {
    showToast('请先补充洞见内容');
    return;
  }
  try {
    const response = await fetch(`/api/tenant/${encodeURIComponent(tenant.slug)}/insight-drafts`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
      body: JSON.stringify({
        id: kwReviewDraft.insightDraftId || undefined,
        title: String(kwReviewDraft.reviewTitle || '').trim(),
        content_text: String(text).trim(),
        source_mode: kwReviewDraft.sourceMode || 'manual',
        access_mode: kwReviewDraft.accessMode === 'subscriber' ? 'subscriber' : 'public',
      }),
    });
    const data = await response.json();
    if (!response.ok || !data.ok) throw new Error(data.error || 'insight_draft_storage_failed');
    kwReviewDraft.insightDraftId = String((data.draft || {}).id || kwReviewDraft.insightDraftId || '');
    kwInsightDrafts = Array.isArray(data.drafts) ? data.drafts : kwInsightDrafts;
    kwInsightDraftsLoaded = true;
    kwRenderReviewStudio();
    showToast('洞见草稿已保存，可随时继续编辑或发布');
  } catch (error) {
    showToast(error.message || '洞见草稿保存失败');
  }
}

async function kwDeleteInsightDraft(draftId) {
  const tenant = window.ACTIVE_TENANT || {};
  if (!draftId || !tenant.slug || !window.confirm('确认删除这篇洞见草稿吗？删除后无法恢复。')) return;
  try {
    const response = await fetch(`/api/tenant/${encodeURIComponent(tenant.slug)}/insight-drafts/${encodeURIComponent(draftId)}`, {method: 'DELETE'});
    const data = await response.json();
    if (!response.ok || !data.ok) throw new Error(data.error || 'insight_draft_delete_failed');
    kwInsightDrafts = Array.isArray(data.drafts) ? data.drafts : [];
    if (kwReviewDraft.insightDraftId === draftId) kwReviewDraft.insightDraftId = '';
    kwRenderReviewStudio();
    showToast('洞见草稿已删除');
  } catch (error) {
    showToast(error.message || '洞见草稿删除失败');
  }
}

function kwGetReviewWorkspacePanelIndex(panelId) {
  return KW_REVIEW_WORKSPACE_PANELS.findIndex((item) => item.id === panelId);
}

function kwGetReviewWizardStepState(panelId) {
  const stage = kwReviewDraft.flowStage || 'intake';
  const hasInput = !!kwGetReviewDraftContentText();
  const hasCards = !!(kwGetReviewSelectedCards().length + kwGetReviewSelectedKnowledge().length);
  const hasDraft = !!String(kwReviewDraft.draftReviewText || kwReviewDraft.generatedPreviewText || '').trim();
  const hasStructured = !!kwReviewStructuredPreview;
  const hasPreview = !!String(kwGetReviewPreviewText() || '').trim();
  if (panelId === 'overview') {
    return kwReviewWorkspacePanel === panelId ? 'active' : 'done';
  }
  if (panelId === 'cards') {
    if (kwReviewWorkspacePanel === panelId) return 'active';
    return hasCards ? 'done' : 'todo';
  }
  if (panelId === 'input') {
    if (kwReviewWorkspacePanel === panelId) return 'active';
    return hasInput ? 'done' : 'todo';
  }
  if (panelId === 'generation') {
    if (kwReviewWorkspacePanel === panelId) return 'active';
    if (stage === 'draft_generating' || stage === 'draft_review' || stage === 'preview_generating' || stage === 'structured_review' || stage === 'preview_failed') return 'done';
    return hasDraft || hasStructured ? 'done' : 'todo';
  }
  if (panelId === 'preview') {
    if (kwReviewWorkspacePanel === panelId) return 'active';
    return hasPreview ? 'done' : 'todo';
  }
  return 'todo';
}

function kwCanOpenReviewWorkspacePanel(panelId) {
  const targetIndex = kwGetReviewWorkspacePanelIndex(panelId);
  if (targetIndex <= 0) return true;
  if (panelId === 'cards') return true;
  if (panelId === 'input') return true;
  if (panelId === 'generation') {
    return !!kwGetReviewDraftContentText();
  }
  if (panelId === 'preview') {
    return !!String(kwGetReviewPreviewText() || '').trim();
  }
  return true;
}

function kwTryOpenReviewWorkspacePanel(panelId) {
  if (!kwCanOpenReviewWorkspacePanel(panelId)) {
    if (panelId === 'generation') {
      showToast('先完成用户洞见输入');
      return;
    }
    if (panelId === 'preview') {
      showToast('先完成用户洞见，再进入最终预览');
      return;
    }
  }
  kwSetReviewWorkspacePanel(panelId);
}

function kwInferReviewWorkspacePanel() {
  const stage = kwReviewDraft.flowStage || 'intake';
  if (kwReviewDraft.previewReady || stage === 'preview') return 'preview';
  if (stage === 'draft_generating' || stage === 'draft_review' || stage === 'optimize_rule' || stage === 'preview_generating' || stage === 'structured_review' || stage === 'preview_failed') {
    return 'generation';

  return 'input';
}

function kwSetReviewWorkspacePanel(panelId, options) {

function kwCaptureReviewVoiceInput() {
  if (kwReviewVoiceUploading) return;
  if (!navigator.mediaDevices || !navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia || typeof MediaRecorder === 'undefined') {
    showToast('当前浏览器不支持录音');
    return;
  }
  if (kwReviewVoiceRecording && kwReviewVoiceRecorder) {
    kwReviewVoiceRecorder.stop();
    return;
  }
  navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true }).then((stream) => {
    const mimeType = MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported('audio/webm') ? 'audio/webm' : '';
    kwReviewVoiceChunks = [];
    kwReviewVoiceRecorder = new MediaRecorder(stream, mimeType ? { mimeType } : undefined);
    kwReviewVoiceRecording = true;
    kwReviewDraft.previewReady = false;
    kwReviewVoiceRecorder.ondataavailable = (event) => {
      if (event.data && event.data.size > 0) {
        kwReviewVoiceChunks.push(event.data);
      }
    };
    kwReviewVoiceRecorder.onerror = () => {
      kwReviewVoiceRecording = false;
      kwReviewVoiceUploading = false;
      stream.getTracks().forEach((track) => track.stop());
      kwRenderReviewStudio();
      showToast('录音失败，请重试');
    };
    kwReviewVoiceRecorder.onstop = async () => {
      kwReviewVoiceRecording = false;
      kwReviewVoiceUploading = true;
      kwRenderReviewStudio();
      const blob = new Blob(kwReviewVoiceChunks, { type: kwReviewVoiceRecorder.mimeType || 'audio/webm' });
      stream.getTracks().forEach((track) => track.stop());
      try {
        const data = await kwUploadReviewVoiceBlob(blob);
        if (!data.async || !data.job_code) throw new Error('voice_transcribe_job_missing');
        showToast('语音已提交，正在后台转写');
        kwStartAsyncJobPolling(data.job_code, {
          onSuccess(job) {
            const result = job.result || {};
            const hadTranscript = !!String(kwReviewDraft.voiceTranscript || '').trim();
            kwReviewDraft.voiceTranscript = kwAppendTranscribedText(
              kwReviewDraft.voiceTranscript,
              result.display_transcript || result.enhanced_transcript || result.transcript || ''
            );
            kwReviewDraft.previewReady = false;
            kwReviewIngestResult = result;
            kwRenderReviewStudio();
            showToast(hadTranscript ? '语音已追加到文案' : '语音已转成文案，待确认发布');
          },
          onFailed(job) {
            showToast(job.error_message || '语音转写失败');
          },
        });
      } catch (error) {
        showToast(error.message || '语音转写失败');
      } finally {
        kwReviewVoiceUploading = false;
        kwReviewVoiceRecorder = null;
        kwReviewVoiceChunks = [];
        kwRenderReviewStudio();
      }
    };
    kwReviewVoiceRecorder.start();
    kwRenderReviewStudio();
  }).catch(() => {
    showToast('未获得麦克风权限');
  });
}

function kwCaptureReviewFileInputLegacy() {
  const input = document.createElement('input');
  input.type = 'file';
  input.accept = '.pdf,.docx,.xlsx,.xlsm,.txt,.md,.csv,.html,.htm,application/pdf,application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document,application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet,text/plain,text/csv,text/html';
  input.onchange = async () => {
    const file = input.files && input.files[0];
    if (!file) return;
    const formData = new FormData();
    formData.append('file', file, file.name);
    const resp = await fetch('/api/kol/knowledge/file-preview', {
      method: 'POST',
      body: formData,
    });
    const data = await resp.json();
    if (!resp.ok || !data.ok) {
      showToast((data && data.error) || '文件解析失败');
      return;
    }
    const preview = data.preview || {};
    kwReviewDraft.fileName = preview.filename || file.name;
    kwReviewDraft.fileText = preview.body || preview.summary || '';
    kwReviewDraft.manualHtml = kwMergePlainTextIntoKnowledgeHtml(kwReviewDraft.manualHtml || '', kwReviewDraft.fileText || '');
    kwReviewDraft.sourceMode = 'manual';
    kwReviewDraft.previewReady = false;
    kwReviewStructuredPreview = null;
    kwRenderReviewStudio();
    showToast('文件已转成文案，可继续手动修改');
  };
  input.click();
}

function kwPublishReviewDraft() {
  const runtime = ensureKwReviewRuntime();
  if (kwReviewPublishSubmitting) return;
  kwSyncReviewTextInputs();
  const item = kwBuildPublishedReviewFromDraft();
  const finalText = kwGetReviewPreviewText();
  const transcriptionEngine = kwReviewDraft.sourceMode === 'voice'
    ? ((kwReviewIngestResult && kwReviewIngestResult.transcript_engine) || 'local')
    : 'manual';
  const transcriptModel = kwReviewDraft.sourceMode === 'voice'
    ? ((kwReviewIngestResult && kwReviewIngestResult.transcript_model) || '')
    : 'manual_input';
  const previewPayload = kwReviewStructuredPreview && typeof kwReviewStructuredPreview === 'object' ? kwReviewStructuredPreview : {};
  const llmModels = [];
  if (kwReviewIngestResult && kwReviewIngestResult.review_draft_llm) {
    llmModels.push({
      stage: 'draft',
      key: kwReviewIngestResult.review_draft_llm.key || '',
      label: kwReviewIngestResult.review_draft_llm.label || '',
      provider: kwReviewIngestResult.review_draft_llm.provider || '',
      model_name: kwReviewIngestResult.review_draft_llm.model_name || '',
      purpose: kwReviewIngestResult.review_draft_llm.purpose || '',
    });
  }
  (previewPayload.llm_models || []).forEach((item) => {
    if (item && !llmModels.some((row) => row.stage === item.stage && row.key === item.key && row.model_name === item.model_name)) {
      llmModels.push(item);
    }
  });
  kwReviewPublishSubmitting = true;
  kwRenderReviewStudio();
  showToast('正在发布洞见，请稍候');
  kwPublishReviewContent(finalText, transcriptionEngine, transcriptModel, {
    review_summary: previewPayload.review_summary || '',
    user_input_section: previewPayload.user_input_section || {
      source_mode: kwReviewDraft.sourceMode || 'manual',
      source_mode_label: (KW_REVIEW_SOURCE_OPTIONS.find((option) => option.value === kwReviewDraft.sourceMode) || {}).label || '用户输入',
      display_text: kwGetReviewUserInputDisplayText(),
      summary_source: 'llm_user_input_only',
    },
    watchlist_analysis_section: previewPayload.watchlist_analysis_section || {},
    llm_models: llmModels,
  }).then((publishResult) => {
    kwReviewPublishSubmitting = false;
    kwReviewIngestResult = publishResult || {};
    runtime.kolPublishedAt = '刚刚发布';
    runtime.kolGeneratedAt = '刚刚发布';
    runtime.latestReviewTitle = kwReviewDraft.reviewTitle || '';
    runtime.draftReady = false;
    kwSyncPublishedReviewState(publishResult);
    if (window.WORKBENCH_DATA) {
      if (Array.isArray(publishResult.snapshots) && publishResult.snapshots.length) {
        window.WORKBENCH_DATA.published_reviews = publishResult.snapshots.slice(0, 20);
      } else {
        const reviews = Array.isArray(window.WORKBENCH_DATA.published_reviews) ? window.WORKBENCH_DATA.published_reviews : [];
        reviews.unshift(publishResult.snapshot || item);
        window.WORKBENCH_DATA.published_reviews = reviews.slice(0, 20);
      }
      if (publishResult.message_center_state) {
        const threadItems = Array.isArray(publishResult.message_center_state.threads) ? publishResult.message_center_state.threads : [];
        window.WORKBENCH_DATA.message_center = {
          summary: publishResult.message_center_state.summary || ((window.WORKBENCH_DATA.message_center || {}).summary) || '',
          items: threadItems.slice(0, 6).map((thread) => ({
            name: thread.name || thread.user_name || '',
            type: thread.type === 'review_notification' ? '系统消息' : (thread.status === '待回复' ? '粉丝提问' : '追问消息'),
            time: thread.time || '--',
            content: thread.content || '',
            status: thread.status || '待处理',
          })),
          threads: threadItems,
        };
      }
    }
    kwCloseReviewTriggerModal();
    kwRenderReviewStudio();
    kwRenderPublishedReviewList();
    renderWorkbenchAnnotationViews();
    showToast((publishResult && publishResult.message) || '洞见已发布');
  }).catch((error) => {
    kwReviewPublishSubmitting = false;
    kwRenderReviewStudio();
    showToast(error.message || '发布入库失败');
  });
}

async function kwDeletePublishedReview(reviewId) {
  const normalizedReviewId = String(reviewId || '').trim();
  const tenantSlug = String(((window.ACTIVE_TENANT || {}).slug) || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!normalizedReviewId || !tenantSlug) {
    showToast('当前洞见缺少有效标识，无法删除');
    return;
  }
  if (!window.confirm('确认删除这篇已发布洞见吗？删除后将不再对前台用户展示，且无法撤销。')) return;
  try {
    const response = await fetch(`/api/tenant/${encodeURIComponent(tenantSlug)}/reviews/${encodeURIComponent(normalizedReviewId)}`, {
      method: 'DELETE',
    });
    const payload = await response.json();
    if (!response.ok || !payload.ok) throw new Error(payload.error || 'review_delete_failed');
    kwSyncPublishedReviewState(payload);
    if (window.WORKBENCH_DATA) {
      window.WORKBENCH_DATA.published_reviews = Array.isArray(payload.snapshots) ? payload.snapshots.slice(0, 20) : [];
    }
    kwRenderPublishedReviewList();
    kwRenderReviewStudio();
    showToast(payload.message || '洞见已删除');
  } catch (error) {
    showToast(error.message || '洞见删除失败');
  }
}

function replaceWorkbenchStockAnnotations(stockCode, items) {
  const tenantId = window.ACTIVE_TENANT && window.ACTIVE_TENANT.id;
  if (!tenantId) return;
  const storage = loadWorkbenchWatchlistAnnotations();
  if (!storage[tenantId]) storage[tenantId] = {};
  storage[tenantId][String(stockCode || '').toUpperCase()] = (Array.isArray(items) ? items : []).map((item) => ({
    id: item.id,
    candleIndex: Number(item.candleIndex ?? item.candle_index ?? 0),
    dateLabel: item.dateLabel || item.candle_date || '',
    title: item.title || '',
    note: item.note || '',
    trigger: item.trigger || '',
    updatedAt: item.updatedAt || item.updated_at || item.createdAt || item.created_at || '刚刚',
  }));
}

async function kwSyncLocalWatchlistAnnotationsToServer(stockRefs) {
  // Annotation writes are sent to the server at creation time. There is no
  // browser-side queue to replay before preview or publish.
  return Promise.resolve();
}

async function kwLoadWatchlistAnnotationsFromServer(stockRefs) {
  const tenant = window.ACTIVE_TENANT || {};
  if (!tenant.slug) return;
  const detailsMap = window.WATCHLIST_DETAILS_MAP || {};
  const codes = (Array.isArray(stockRefs) ? stockRefs : [stockRefs]).map((item) => {
    const raw = String(item || '').trim();
    if (!raw) return '';
    const detail = Object.values(detailsMap).find((row) => row && (row.code === raw || row.name === raw));
    return String((detail && detail.code) || raw).trim().toUpperCase();
  }).filter(Boolean);
  await Promise.all(codes.map(async (stockCode) => {
    try {
      const resp = await fetch(`/api/watchlist/${encodeURIComponent(stockCode)}/annotations?tenant_slug=${encodeURIComponent(String(tenant.slug || '').trim().toLowerCase())}`);
      const data = await resp.json();
      if (resp.ok && data.ok) {
        replaceWorkbenchStockAnnotations(stockCode, data.items || []);
        kwLoadedWatchlistAnnotationCodes[`${String(tenant.slug || '').trim().toLowerCase()}:${stockCode}`] = true;
      }
    } catch (e) {}
  }));
}

function getWorkbenchStockAnnotations(stockCode) {
  const tenantId = window.ACTIVE_TENANT && window.ACTIVE_TENANT.id;
  const storage = loadWorkbenchWatchlistAnnotations();
  const bucket = tenantId && storage[tenantId] && storage[tenantId][String(stockCode || '').toUpperCase()];
  return Array.isArray(bucket) ? bucket.slice().sort((a, b) => Number(a.candleIndex || 0) - Number(b.candleIndex || 0)) : [];
}

function getWorkbenchReviewAnnotations(reviewItem) {
  const detailsMap = window.WATCHLIST_DETAILS_MAP || {};
  const watchlist = Array.isArray(reviewItem.watchlist) ? reviewItem.watchlist : [];
  return watchlist.map((name) => {
    const detail = Object.values(detailsMap).find(item => item && item.name === name);
    if (!detail) return null;
    const annotations = getWorkbenchStockAnnotations(detail.code);
    if (!annotations.length) return null;
    return {
      name,
      summary: annotations.slice(0, 2).map(item => `${item.dateLabel} ${item.note}`).join('；'),
    };
  }).filter(Boolean);
}

function renderWorkbenchAnnotationViews() {
  const tenant = window.ACTIVE_TENANT || {};
  const tenantSlug = String(tenant.slug || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const watchNodeCodes = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[data-workbench-watch-annotation]')).map((node) => String(node.getAttribute('data-workbench-watch-annotation') || '').trim().toUpperCase()).filter(Boolean);
  const reviews = (window.WORKBENCH_DATA && window.WORKBENCH_DATA.published_reviews) || [];
  const reviewCodes = reviews.flatMap((reviewItem) => {
    const watchlist = Array.isArray(reviewItem.watchlist) ? reviewItem.watchlist : [];
    return watchlist.map((name) => {
      const detail = Object.values(window.WATCHLIST_DETAILS_MAP || {}).find((item) => item && item.name === name);
      return String((detail && detail.code) || '').trim().toUpperCase();
    }).filter(Boolean);
  });
  const codesToHydrate = Array.from(new Set(watchNodeCodes.concat(reviewCodes))).filter((code) => tenantSlug && !kwLoadedWatchlistAnnotationCodes[`${tenantSlug}:${code}`]);
  if (codesToHydrate.length) {
    kwLoadWatchlistAnnotationsFromServer(codesToHydrate).then(() => {
      renderWorkbenchAnnotationViews();
    }).catch(() => null);
  }
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-workbench-watch-annotation]').forEach((node) => {
    const stockCode = node.getAttribute('data-workbench-watch-annotation') || '';
    const annotations = getWorkbenchStockAnnotations(stockCode);
    if (!annotations.length) {
      node.innerHTML = '<div class="kw-side-note">当前还没有 K 线标注，H5 里的大V视角新增后会同步显示在这里。</div>';
      return;
    }
    const latest = annotations[annotations.length - 1];
    node.innerHTML = `
      <div class="kw-watch-chip-row" style="margin-bottom:8px">
        <span class="kw-watch-chip">K线标注 ${annotations.length} 条</span>
      </div>
      <div class="kw-side-card">
        <div class="kw-knowledge-title">${escapeHtml(latest.title || '最新标注')}</div>
        <div class="kw-knowledge-meta">${escapeHtml(latest.dateLabel || '--')} · 最新洞见</div>
        <div class="kw-side-note" style="margin-top:6px">${escapeHtml(latest.note || '')}${latest.trigger ? `｜验证节点：${escapeHtml(latest.trigger)}` : ''}</div>
      </div>
    `;
  });

  document.querySelectorAll('[data-workbench-review-annotation]').forEach((node) => {
    const index = Number(node.getAttribute('data-workbench-review-annotation') || 0);
    const reviewItem = reviews[index];
    const annotations = reviewItem ? getWorkbenchReviewAnnotations(reviewItem) : [];
    if (!annotations.length) {
      node.innerHTML = '';
      return;
    }
    node.innerHTML = `
      <div class="kw-side-card">
        <div class="kw-side-title" style="margin-bottom:8px">本篇洞见引用的 K 线标注</div>
        ${annotations.map(item => `
          <div class="kw-side-item" style="display:block;border-bottom:none;padding:0 0 8px">
            <div class="kw-knowledge-title">${escapeHtml(item.name)}</div>
            <div class="kw-side-note" style="margin-top:4px">${escapeHtml(item.summary)}</div>
          </div>
        `).join('')}
      </div>
    `;
  });
}

}

function renderWorkbenchForecastEdges() {
  const layer = document.getElementById('kw-forecast-edge-layer');
  const board = document.getElementById('kw-forecast-workflow-board');
  const viewport = document.getElementById('kw-forecast-stage-viewport');
  if (!layer || !board) return;
  const nodes = Array.isArray(kwForecastGraph.nodes) ? kwForecastGraph.nodes : [];
  const edges = Array.isArray(kwForecastGraph.edges) ? kwForecastGraph.edges : [];
  const width = Math.max(1800, ...nodes.map((item) => Number(item.x || 0) + 280));
  const height = Math.max(760, ...nodes.map((item) => Number(item.y || 0) + 180));
  board.style.width = `${width}px`;
  board.style.height = `${height}px`;
  if (viewport) {
    viewport.style.width = `${width}px`;
    viewport.style.height = `${height}px`;
  }
  layer.setAttribute('width', String(width));
  layer.setAttribute('height', String(height));
  layer.setAttribute('viewBox', `0 0 ${width} ${height}`);
  layer.innerHTML = `
    <defs>
      <marker id="kw-workflow-arrowhead" viewBox="0 0 12 12" refX="10" refY="6" markerWidth="12" markerHeight="12" markerUnits="userSpaceOnUse" orient="auto">
        <path d="M 0 1 L 11 6 L 0 11 z" fill="rgba(47, 116, 192, 0.96)"></path>
      </marker>
    </defs>
    ${edges.map((edge) => {
      const fromNode = nodes.find((item) => item.id === edge.from);
      const toNode = nodes.find((item) => item.id === edge.to);
      if (!fromNode || !toNode) return '';
      const startX = Number(fromNode.x || 0) + 220;
      const startY = Number(fromNode.y || 0) + 52;
      const endX = Number(toNode.x || 0);
      const endY = Number(toNode.y || 0) + 52;
      const deltaX = endX - startX;
      const controlOffset = Math.max(80, Math.min(180, Math.abs(deltaX) * 0.45));
      const controlA = startX + (deltaX >= 0 ? controlOffset : -controlOffset);
      const controlB = endX - (deltaX >= 0 ? controlOffset : -controlOffset);
      const path = `M ${startX} ${startY} C ${controlA} ${startY}, ${controlB} ${endY}, ${endX} ${endY}`;
      return `
        <g data-edge-id="${escapeAttr(edge.id || '')}">
          <path class="kw-workflow-edge-shadow" d="${path}"></path>
          <path class="kw-workflow-edge" d="${path}" marker-end="url(#kw-workflow-arrowhead)"></path>
          <circle class="kw-workflow-edge-anchor" cx="${startX}" cy="${startY}" r="5"></circle>
          <circle class="kw-workflow-edge-anchor" cx="${endX}" cy="${endY}" r="5"></circle>
        </g>
      `;
    }).join('')}
  `;
}
