function bindWorkbenchForecastGraphEvents() {
  document.querySelectorAll('.kw-workflow-node').forEach((node) => {
    node.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
      if (event.target instanceof HTMLElement && event.target.dataset.portAction) return;
      kwSelectedForecastNodeId = node.dataset.nodeId || '';
      renderWorkbenchForecastWorkflow();
      renderWorkbenchForecastConfigBoard();
      renderWorkbenchForecastNodeDebug();
    });
    node.addEventListener('pointerdown', (event) => {
      if (event.target instanceof HTMLElement && event.target.dataset.portAction) return;
      const nodeId = node.dataset.nodeId || '';
      const item = (kwForecastGraph.nodes || []).find((row) => row.id === nodeId);
      if (!item) return;
      kwSelectedForecastNodeId = nodeId;
      kwForecastDragState = {
        nodeId,
        startX: event.clientX,
        startY: event.clientY,
        originX: Number(item.x || 0),
        originY: Number(item.y || 0),
      };
      node.setPointerCapture?.(event.pointerId);
    });
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-port-action="link"]').forEach((node) => {
    node.addEventListener('pointerdown', (event) => {
      const target = event.currentTarget;
      if (!(target instanceof HTMLElement) || !target.closest('.kw-workflow-node')) return;
      kwForecastLinkState = {from: target.dataset.nodeId || ''};
      renderWorkbenchForecastWorkflow();
      renderWorkbenchForecastConfigBoard();
      event.preventDefault();
    });
    node.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
      const target = event.currentTarget;
      if (!(target instanceof HTMLElement) || !target.closest('.kw-workflow-node')) return;
      kwForecastLinkState = {from: target.dataset.nodeId || ''};
      renderWorkbenchForecastWorkflow();
      renderWorkbenchForecastConfigBoard();
    });
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-port-action="select"]').forEach((node) => {
    node.addEventListener('pointerup', (event) => {
      const target = event.currentTarget;
      if (!(target instanceof HTMLElement) || !target.closest('.kw-workflow-node')) return;
      const nodeId = target.dataset.nodeId || '';
      if (kwForecastLinkState?.from && kwForecastLinkState.from !== nodeId) {
        addWorkbenchForecastEdge(kwForecastLinkState.from, nodeId);
        kwForecastLinkState = null;
        renderWorkbenchForecastWorkflow();
        renderWorkbenchForecastConfigBoard();
        renderWorkbenchForecastNodeDebug();
        showToast('连线已完成');
        event.preventDefault();
      }
    });
    node.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
      const target = event.currentTarget;
      if (!(target instanceof HTMLElement) || !target.closest('.kw-workflow-node')) return;
      const nodeId = target.dataset.nodeId || '';
      if (kwForecastLinkState?.from && kwForecastLinkState.from !== nodeId) {
        addWorkbenchForecastEdge(kwForecastLinkState.from, nodeId);
        kwForecastLinkState = null;
        renderWorkbenchForecastWorkflow();
        renderWorkbenchForecastConfigBoard();
        renderWorkbenchForecastNodeDebug();
        showToast('连线已完成');
        return;
      }
      kwSelectedForecastNodeId = nodeId;
      renderWorkbenchForecastWorkflow();
      renderWorkbenchForecastConfigBoard();
      renderWorkbenchForecastNodeDebug();
    });
  });
}

window.addEventListener('pointermove', (event) => {
  if (!kwForecastDragState) return;
  const item = (kwForecastGraph.nodes || []).find((row) => row.id === kwForecastDragState.nodeId);
  if (!item) return;
  const zoom = kwForecastZoom || 1;
  item.x = Math.max(8, kwForecastDragState.originX + (event.clientX - kwForecastDragState.startX) / zoom);
  item.y = Math.max(8, kwForecastDragState.originY + (event.clientY - kwForecastDragState.startY) / zoom);
  renderWorkbenchForecastWorkflow();
  renderWorkbenchForecastConfigBoard();
  renderWorkbenchForecastNodeDebug();
});

window.addEventListener('pointerup', () => {
  kwForecastDragState = null;
});

function addWorkbenchForecastNode(processor) {
  const catalog = Array.isArray(kwForecastWorkflowMeta.catalog) ? kwForecastWorkflowMeta.catalog : [];
  const spec = catalog.find((item) => item.processor === processor) || {label: processor, params: []};
  const nextIndex = (kwForecastGraph.nodes || []).length + 1;
  const nodeId = `${processor}_${Date.now()}_${nextIndex}`;
  const params = {};
  (spec.params || []).forEach((item) => {
    params[item.key] = '';
  });
  kwForecastGraph.nodes.push({
    id: nodeId,
    label: spec.label || processor,
    processor,
    x: 120 + (nextIndex % 3) * 260,
    y: 120 + Math.floor(nextIndex / 3) * 120,
    params,
  });
  kwSelectedForecastNodeId = nodeId;
  renderWorkbenchForecastWorkflow();
  renderWorkbenchForecastConfigBoard();
  renderWorkbenchForecastNodeDebug();
}

function addWorkbenchForecastEdge(fromId, toId) {
  if (!fromId || !toId || fromId === toId) return;
  if ((kwForecastGraph.edges || []).some((item) => item.from === fromId && item.to === toId)) return;
  kwForecastGraph.edges.push({id: `edge_${Date.now()}_${kwForecastGraph.edges.length + 1}`, from: fromId, to: toId});
}

function deleteWorkbenchForecastNode() {
  if (!kwSelectedForecastNodeId) return;
  kwForecastGraph.nodes = (kwForecastGraph.nodes || []).filter((item) => item.id !== kwSelectedForecastNodeId);
  kwForecastGraph.edges = (kwForecastGraph.edges || []).filter((item) => item.from !== kwSelectedForecastNodeId && item.to !== kwSelectedForecastNodeId);
  kwSelectedForecastNodeId = (kwForecastGraph.nodes || [])[0]?.id || '';
  renderWorkbenchForecastWorkflow();
  renderWorkbenchForecastConfigBoard();
  renderWorkbenchForecastNodeDebug();
}

function centerWorkbenchForecastView() {
  const stage = document.querySelector('#workbench-section-forecast-model .kw-workflow-stage');
  const viewport = document.getElementById('kw-forecast-stage-viewport');
  if (!stage) return;
  const targetWidth = viewport ? viewport.offsetWidth * kwForecastZoom : stage.scrollWidth;
  const targetHeight = viewport ? viewport.offsetHeight * kwForecastZoom : stage.scrollHeight;
  stage.scrollLeft = Math.max(0, (targetWidth - stage.clientWidth) / 2);
  stage.scrollTop = Math.max(0, (targetHeight - stage.clientHeight) / 2);
}

function collectWorkbenchForecastConfig() {
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-kw-forecast-field]').forEach((fieldNode) => {
    const field = fieldNode.dataset.kwForecastField;
    if (!field) return;
    kwForecastConfig[field] = Number(fieldNode.value || 0);
  });
  const selectedNode = (kwForecastGraph.nodes || []).find((item) => item.id === kwSelectedForecastNodeId);
  if (selectedNode) {
    const labelNode = document.querySelector('[data-kw-node-label]');
    if (labelNode instanceof HTMLInputElement) {
      selectedNode.label = labelNode.value || selectedNode.label;
    }
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-kw-node-param]').forEach((fieldNode) => {
      const field = fieldNode.dataset.kwNodeParam;
      if (!field) return;
      selectedNode.params = selectedNode.params || {};
      selectedNode.params[field] = fieldNode.value;
    });
  }
  kwForecastGraph.tuning = {...kwForecastConfig};
}

async function loadWorkbenchForecastModel(forceReload) {
  if (kwForecastLoaded && !forceReload && kwForecastEditorBootstrapped) return;
  const res = await fetch('/api/admin/forecast-config');
  const data = await res.json();
  if (!res.ok || data.ok === false) throw new Error(data.error || 'forecast_config_failed');
  kwForecastConfig = data.config || {};
  kwForecastWorkflowMeta = data.workflow_meta || {};
  kwForecastGraph = kwForecastWorkflowMeta.graph || {nodes: [], edges: [], tuning: kwForecastConfig};
  kwForecastGraph.tuning = {...kwForecastConfig};
  kwSelectedForecastNodeId = (kwForecastGraph.nodes || [])[0]?.id || '';
  kwForecastLoaded = true;
  renderWorkbenchForecastWorkflow();
  renderWorkbenchForecastConfigBoard();
  renderWorkbenchForecastNodeDebug();
  centerWorkbenchForecastView();
}

  collectWorkbenchForecastConfig();

  });

  if (!res.ok || data.ok === false) throw new Error(data.error || 'save_failed');

  kwForecastWorkflowMeta = data.workflow_meta || {};
  kwForecastGraph = kwForecastWorkflowMeta.graph || kwForecastGraph;

  });
  document.getElementById('kw-forecast-reset-graph')?.addEventListener('click', async () => {

function showWorkbenchSection(name, navEl) {

  }
  if (name === 'indicator-lake') {
    name = 'lake-market';
  }
  if (name === 'knowledge') {
    name = 'knowledge-overview';
  }
  if (name.indexOf('knowledge-') === 0 && !isWorkbenchFeatureEnabled('knowledge')) {
    showToast('知识专区当前暂不开放');

    return;

  if (name === 'hermes' && !isWorkbenchFeatureEnabled('hermes')) {
    showToast('Hermes 专区当前未开放');
    return;
  }
  document.querySelectorAll('[id^="workbench-section-"]').forEach(el => {
    el.style.display = 'none';
  });
  const target = document.getElementById('workbench-section-' + name);
  if (target) target.style.display = 'block';
  document.querySelectorAll('.admin-nav-item').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('active'));
  const activeNav = navEl || document.querySelector(`.admin-nav-item[data-section="${name}"]`);
  if (activeNav) {
    activeNav.classList.add('active');
    const groupEl = activeNav.closest('.admin-nav-group');
    if (groupEl) {
      setWorkbenchNavGroupCollapsed(groupEl, false);
      const state = readWorkbenchNavState();
      const key = groupEl.dataset.navGroup;
      if (key) {
        state[key] = false;
        writeWorkbenchNavState(state);
      }
    }
  }
  const meta = workbenchSectionMeta[name] || workbenchSectionMeta.overview;
  const title = document.getElementById('workbench-page-title');
  const summary = document.getElementById('workbench-page-summary');
  if (title) title.textContent = meta.title;
  if (summary) summary.textContent = meta.summary;
  if (name === 'biz-dashboard') {
    renderKwBizDashboard();
    refreshKwBusinessAnalytics();
  }
  if (name === 'dashboard') {
    kwRenderDashboardPreview();
  }
  if (name === 'watchlist-pool' || name === 'published' || name === 'review') {
    renderWorkbenchAnnotationViews();
  }
  if (name === 'watchlist-insights') {
    renderWorkbenchWatchlistCommentAnalytics();
  }
  if (name === 'review') {
    kwRenderReviewStudio();
    kwLoadActiveReviewJobs();
  }
  if (name === 'knowledge-overview') {
    loadWorkbenchKnowledgeAssets(false).then(() => {
      kwRenderKnowledgeOverview();
    }).catch((error) => showToast(error.message || '加载失败'));
  }
  if (name === 'knowledge-intake') {
    kwRenderKnowledgeList();
  }
  if (name === 'knowledge-encyclopedia') {
    loadWorkbenchKnowledgeAssets(false).catch((error) => showToast(error.message || '加载失败'));
  }
  if (name === 'knowledge-entries') {
    loadWorkbenchKnowledgeAssets(false).catch((error) => showToast(error.message || '加载失败'));
  }
  if (name === 'knowledge-graph') {
    loadWorkbenchKnowledgeMap(false);
  }
  if (name === 'hermes-overview') {
    loadWorkbenchHermesUsageStats();
  }
  if (name === 'hermes-memory') {
    loadWorkbenchHermesMemorySummary(false).catch((error) => showToast(error.message || '加载失败'));
  }
  if (name === 'hermes-capability') {
    loadWorkbenchHermesCapabilityGrowth(false);
  }
  if (name === 'published') {
    kwRenderPublishedReviewList();
  }
  if (name === 'forecast-model') {
    initWorkbenchForecastEditorEvents();
    loadWorkbenchForecastModel().catch((error) => showToast(error.message || '加载失败'));
  }
  if (window.GangtiseEcharts && typeof window.GangtiseEcharts.resizeAll === 'function') {
    window.requestAnimationFrame(() => window.GangtiseEcharts.resizeAll());
  }
  const url = new URL(window.location.href);
  url.searchParams.set('section', name);
  window.history.replaceState({}, '', url);
}

const WORKBENCH_NAV_STORAGE_KEY = 'gangtise-workbench-nav-groups-v1';

function readWorkbenchNavState() {
  try {
    return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(WORKBENCH_NAV_STORAGE_KEY) || '{}');
  } catch (error) {
    return {};
  }
}

function writeWorkbenchNavState(state) {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(WORKBENCH_NAV_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(state || {}));
  } catch (error) {
    // ignore storage write failures
  }
}

function setWorkbenchNavGroupCollapsed(groupEl, collapsed) {
  if (!groupEl) return;
  groupEl.classList.toggle('is-collapsed', !!collapsed);
  const toggle = groupEl.querySelector('.admin-nav-group-toggle');
  if (toggle) toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', collapsed ? 'false' : 'true');
}

function toggleWorkbenchNavGroup(toggleEl) {
  const groupEl = toggleEl ? toggleEl.closest('.admin-nav-group') : null;
  if (!groupEl) return;
  const collapsed = !groupEl.classList.contains('is-collapsed');
  setWorkbenchNavGroupCollapsed(groupEl, collapsed);
  const state = readWorkbenchNavState();
  const key = groupEl.dataset.navGroup;
  if (key) {
    state[key] = collapsed;
    writeWorkbenchNavState(state);
  }
}

function initWorkbenchNavGroups() {
  const state = readWorkbenchNavState();
  document.querySelectorAll('.admin-nav-group[data-nav-group]').forEach((groupEl) => {
    const key = groupEl.dataset.navGroup;
    const collapsed = !!state[key];
    setWorkbenchNavGroupCollapsed(groupEl, collapsed);
  });
}

function kwBizChart(hostId, option, emptyMessage = '当前暂无可展示的数据') {
  const host = document.getElementById(hostId);
  if (!host) return;
  const series = Array.isArray(option && option.series) ? option.series : [];
  const hasValues = series.some((item) => {
    const data = item && item.data;
    return Array.isArray(data) && data.length > 0;
  });
  if (!hasValues) {
    host.innerHTML = `<div class="kw-biz-chart-empty">${escapeHtml(emptyMessage)}</div>`;
    return;
  }
  if (!window.GangtiseEcharts || typeof window.GangtiseEcharts.render !== 'function') {
    host.innerHTML = '<div class="kw-biz-chart-empty">图表组件暂未就绪，请刷新页面后重试</div>';
    return;
  }
  window.requestAnimationFrame(() => {
    const target = document.getElementById(hostId);
    if (!target) return;
    window.GangtiseEcharts.render(target, option);
    window.GangtiseEcharts.flush(target.parentElement || target);
  });
}

async function refreshKwBusinessAnalytics() {
  const tenantSlug = (window.ACTIVE_TENANT && window.ACTIVE_TENANT.slug) || '';
  if (!tenantSlug) return;
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`/api/kol/business-analytics?tenant=${encodeURIComponent(tenantSlug)}`, {cache: 'no-store'});
    const data = await res.json();
    if (!res.ok || data.ok === false) throw new Error(data.error || 'load_business_analytics_failed');
    window.WORKBENCH_DATA = window.WORKBENCH_DATA || {};
    window.WORKBENCH_DATA.stats = data.stats || window.WORKBENCH_DATA.stats || {};
    window.WORKBENCH_DATA.business_analytics = data.analytics || {};
    renderKwOpsStats();
    const section = document.getElementById('workbench-section-biz-dashboard');
    if (section && section.style.display !== 'none') renderKwBizDashboard();
  } catch (error) {
    showToast(error.message || '数据分析加载失败');
  }
}

async function confirmKwFanStatusChange(userId, status) {
  const tenantSlug = (window.ACTIVE_TENANT && window.ACTIVE_TENANT.slug) || '';
  if (!tenantSlug) return;
  const host = document.getElementById('kw-fan-status-modal-content');
  if (host) host.innerHTML += '<div class="kw-dashboard-panel-note" style="margin-top:10px">正在更新账号状态，请稍候...</div>';
  try {
    const response = await fetch(`/api/kol/users/status?tenant=${encodeURIComponent(tenantSlug)}`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
      body: JSON.stringify({user_id: userId, status}),
    });
    const data = await response.json();
    if (!response.ok || data.ok === false) {
      const messages = { tenant_user_not_found: '未找到当前租户下的粉丝账号。', database_unavailable: '数据库当前不可用，请稍后重试。' };
      throw new Error(messages[data.error] || data.error || '账号状态更新失败');
    }
    kwFans = Array.isArray(data.users) ? data.users.map(normalizeKwFan) : kwFans;
    renderKwFans();
    closeKwFanStatusModal();
    await refreshKwBusinessAnalytics();
    showToast(status === 'disabled' ? '粉丝账号已停用' : '粉丝账号已启用');
  } catch (error) {
    if (host) host.innerHTML += `<div style="font-size:12px;color:#F2B8B5;margin-top:10px">${escapeHtml(error.message || '账号状态更新失败')}</div>`;
    showToast(error.message || '账号状态更新失败');
  }
}

function normalizeKwFan(user) {
  const fan = user || {};
  return {
    id: Number(fan.id || 0),
    username: fan.username || fan.name || '',
    membership: fan.membership || fan.tier || '投资者视角',
    is_paid_sample: !!fan.is_paid_sample,
    source: fan.source || fan.source_label || '用户导入',
    created_at: fan.created_at || fan.joined || '--',
    paid_sample_note: fan.paid_sample_note || '',
    labels: Array.isArray(fan.labels) ? fan.labels : (fan.is_paid_sample ? ['付费用户'] : []),
    phone_masked: fan.phone_masked || fan.value || '--',
    status: fan.status || 'active',
  };
}

async function applyKwFanLabel(labelOverride) {
  const tenantSlug = (window.ACTIVE_TENANT && window.ACTIVE_TENANT.slug) || '';
  const input = document.getElementById('kw-fan-label-input');

  try {

      method: 'POST',

async function loadKwFans() {

    showToast('tenant_missing');

  try {

async function loadKwCommerce() {
  const host = document.getElementById('kw-commerce-summary');
  if (!host) return;
  try {
    const response = await fetch(`/api/kol/commerce?tenant=${encodeURIComponent(kwCommerceTenantSlug())}`, {cache:'no-store'});
    const data = await response.json();
    if (!response.ok || !data.ok) throw new Error(data.error || 'commerce_load_failed');
    const commerce = data.commerce || {};
    const settings = commerce.settings || {};
    document.getElementById('kw-commerce-instructions').value = settings.payment_instructions || '';
    document.getElementById('kw-commerce-qr-url').value = settings.collection_qr_url || '';
    document.getElementById('kw-commerce-paywall').value = settings.paywall_enabled ? 'on' : 'off';
    document.getElementById('kw-commerce-review-access').value = settings.default_review_access === 'free' ? 'free' : 'subscriber';
    host.innerHTML = `${commerce.enabled ? '商业化已开启' : '商业化开关未开启'} · ${(commerce.products || []).length} 个有效订阅产品 · ${(data.qr_invites || []).length} 个扫码入口`;
    renderKwCommerceOrders(commerce.orders || []);
  } catch (error) { host.textContent = `商业化配置暂不可用：${error.message || 'unknown_error'}`; }
}

function renderKwCommerceOrders(orders) {
  const host = document.getElementById('kw-commerce-orders');
  if (!host) return;
  const rows = Array.isArray(orders) ? orders : [];
  if (!rows.length) {
    host.innerHTML = '<div class="kw-card-desc">暂无订阅订单。粉丝完成下单后会在这里出现，只有人工核验到账才会开通权益。</div>';
    return;
  }
  host.innerHTML = `<div class="table-wrap" style="margin-top:0"><div class="table-header"><div class="table-title">订阅订单</div><span class="kw-tag">最近 ${rows.length} 笔</span></div><table><thead><tr><th>粉丝</th><th>产品 / 金额</th><th>订单号</th><th>状态</th><th>操作</th></tr></thead><tbody>${rows.map((order) => {
    const status = String(order.status || 'pending');
    const statusLabel = {pending:'待确认到账', paid:'已开通', expired:'已过期', cancelled:'已取消', refunded:'已退款'}[status] || status;
    const action = status === 'pending' ? `<button class="btn-gold" type="button" style="padding:5px 9px;font-size:11px" onclick="confirmKwCommerceOrder('${escapeAttr(order.order_no || '')}')">确认到账</button>` : '—';
    return `<tr><td>${escapeHtml(order.username || '粉丝')}</td><td>${escapeHtml(order.product_name || '')} · ¥${Number(order.amount_yuan || 0).toFixed(2)}</td><td style="font-size:11px">${escapeHtml(order.order_no || '')}<br><span style="color:#8899aa">附言 ${escapeHtml(order.payment_reference || '')}</span></td><td>${escapeHtml(statusLabel)}</td><td>${action}</td></tr>`;
  }).join('')}</tbody></table></div>`;
}

async function confirmKwCommerceOrder(orderNo) {
  if (!orderNo || !window.confirm('请确认已核验真实到账。确认后会立即开通粉丝订阅权益。')) return;
  try {
    const response = await fetch(`/api/kol/commerce/orders/${encodeURIComponent(orderNo)}/confirm?tenant=${encodeURIComponent(kwCommerceTenantSlug())}`, {method:'POST'});
    const data = await response.json();
    if (!response.ok || !data.ok) throw new Error(data.error || 'payment_confirm_failed');
    showToast('已确认到账，订阅权益已开通');
    loadKwCommerce();
  } catch (error) { showToast(error.message || '确认到账失败'); }
}

async function submitKwFanImportRows() {
  const tenantSlug = (window.ACTIVE_TENANT && window.ACTIVE_TENANT.slug) || '';
  const users = collectKwFanImportRows();
  if (!tenantSlug) {
    showToast('tenant_missing');
    return;
  }
  if (!users.length) {
    showToast('请至少填写一位粉丝');
    return;
  }
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`/api/kol/users/import?tenant=${encodeURIComponent(tenantSlug)}`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
      body: JSON.stringify({users}),
    });
    const data = await res.json();
    if (!res.ok || data.ok === false) throw new Error(data.error || 'import_kol_users_failed');
    kwFans = Array.isArray(data.users) ? data.users.map(normalizeKwFan) : kwFans;
    renderKwFans();
    closeKwFanImportModal();
    await refreshWorkbenchSiteConfig({silent: true});

    showToast(`已导入 ${Array.isArray(data.created) ? data.created.length : 0} 位粉丝${skipped ? `，跳过 ${skipped} 条` : ''}`);

function kwNormalizeSmartTagLabel(label) {
  return String(label || '').replace(/[【】]/g, '').trim();
}

function kwEscapeRegExp(value) {
  return String(value || '').replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');
}

function kwCollectPromptMatchedTagCodes(promptText, tagCatalog) {
  const prompt = String(promptText || '').trim();
  if (!prompt) return [];
  const normalize = (value) => String(value || '').replace(/[\s_\-.\/：:，,。.!！?？【】\[\]()（）]/g, '').toLowerCase();
  const normalizedPrompt = normalize(prompt);
  const catalog = Array.isArray(tagCatalog) ? tagCatalog.slice() : [];
  const explicitLabels = Array.from(prompt.matchAll(/【([^】]+)】/g)).map((match) => kwNormalizeSmartTagLabel(match[1]));
  // A bracketed label is an explicit formula reference. Do not widen it with
  // fuzzy matching to similarly named historical smart-indicator definitions.
  if (explicitLabels.length) {
    return Array.from(new Set(explicitLabels.map((label) => {
      const tag = catalog.find((item) => kwNormalizeSmartTagLabel(item && item.label) === label);
      return tag && tag.tag_code;
    }).filter(Boolean)));
  }
  return catalog
    .filter((tag) => tag && tag.auto_match !== false)
    .sort((left, right) => kwNormalizeSmartTagLabel(right.label).length - kwNormalizeSmartTagLabel(left.label).length)
    .filter((tag) => {
      const candidates = [tag && tag.label].concat(Array.isArray(tag && tag.prompt_aliases) ? tag.prompt_aliases : []);
      return candidates.some((candidate) => {
        const normalizedCandidate = normalize(kwNormalizeSmartTagLabel(candidate));
        if (!normalizedCandidate) return false;
        if (normalizedPrompt.includes(normalizedCandidate)) return true;
        if (normalizedPrompt.length >= 3 && normalizedCandidate.includes(normalizedPrompt)) return true;
        return normalizedPrompt.length >= 3 && normalizedPrompt.length <= 8 && normalizedCandidate.includes(normalizedPrompt);
      });
    })
    .map((tag) => tag.tag_code)
    .filter(Boolean);
}

function kwEscapeSmartRegExp(value) {
  return String(value || '').replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');
}

function kwCanonicalizeSmartPrompt(promptText, tagCatalog) {
  const source = String(promptText || '');
  const candidates = [];
  const seen = new Set();
  (Array.isArray(tagCatalog) ? tagCatalog : []).filter((tag) => tag && tag.auto_match !== false).forEach((tag) => {
    const label = kwNormalizeSmartTagLabel(tag && tag.label);
    if (!label) return;
    [label].concat(Array.isArray(tag && tag.prompt_aliases) ? tag.prompt_aliases : []).forEach((value) => {
      const alias = kwNormalizeSmartTagLabel(value);
      const key = `${alias}\u0000${label}`;
      if (!alias || alias.length < 2 || seen.has(key)) return;
      seen.add(key);
      candidates.push({ alias, label });
    });
  });
  candidates.sort((left, right) => right.alias.length - left.alias.length);
  if (!candidates.length) return source;
  const pattern = new RegExp(candidates.map((item) => kwEscapeSmartRegExp(item.alias)).join('|'), 'gi');
  // Preserve an unclosed reference while the user is editing it. Otherwise
  // Backspace can turn "【指标" into "【【指标】" on every input event.
  return source.split(/(【[^】]*(?:】|$))/g).map((part) => {
    if (/^【/.test(part)) return part;
    return part.replace(pattern, (match) => {
      const normalized = kwNormalizeSmartTagLabel(match).toLowerCase();
      const found = candidates.find((item) => item.alias.toLowerCase() === normalized);
      return found ? `【${found.label}】` : match;
    });
  }).join('');
}

function kwTokenizeSmartPrompt(promptText, tagCatalog) {
  const prompt = String(promptText || '');
  const tags = Array.isArray(tagCatalog) ? tagCatalog : [];
  if (!prompt) return [];
  return prompt.split(/(【[^】]+】|[+\-*\/()])/g).filter((part) => part !== '').map((part) => {
    if (/^【[^】]+】$/.test(part)) {
      const label = kwNormalizeSmartTagLabel(part);
      const tag = tags.find((item) => kwNormalizeSmartTagLabel(item && item.label) === label);
      const selected = tag && Array.isArray(tag.selected_indicators) ? tag.selected_indicators : [];
      return {
        type: 'reference',
        label,
        tagCode: tag ? tag.tag_code : '',
        indicatorCode: selected.length === 1 ? selected[0].indicator_code : '',
      };
    }
    if (/^[+\-*\/()]$/.test(part)) return { type: 'operator', text: part };
    if (/^\d+(\.\d+)?$/.test(part.trim())) return { type: 'number', text: part.trim() };
    return { type: 'text', text: part };
  });
}

function kwGetSmartIndicatorEffectiveTagCodes() {
  const manualCodes = Array.isArray(kwSmartIndicatorDraft.selectedTagCodes) ? kwSmartIndicatorDraft.selectedTagCodes : [];
  const matchedCodes = kwCollectPromptMatchedTagCodes(kwSmartIndicatorDraft.promptText, kwGetSmartTagCatalog());
  const suppressed = new Set(kwSmartIndicatorDraft.suppressedTagCodes || []);
  return Array.from(new Set(manualCodes.concat(matchedCodes))).filter((code) => !suppressed.has(code));
}

function kwRenderSmartIndicatorTagSelection() {
  const tagCatalog = kwGetSmartTagCatalog();
  const effectiveTagCodes = kwGetSmartIndicatorEffectiveTagCodes();
  const selectedTagSet = new Set(effectiveTagCodes);
  const selectedTags = tagCatalog.filter((tag) => selectedTagSet.has(tag.tag_code));
  const selectedHost = document.getElementById('kw-smart-indicator-selected-tags');
  const poolHost = document.getElementById('kw-smart-indicator-tag-pool');
  const toggleHost = document.getElementById('kw-smart-indicator-tag-toggle');
  const matchedCodes = new Set(kwCollectPromptMatchedTagCodes(kwSmartIndicatorDraft.promptText, tagCatalog));
  const previewList = kwSmartIndicatorDraft.tagPoolExpanded ? tagCatalog : tagCatalog.slice(0, 5);
  if (selectedHost) {
    selectedHost.innerHTML = selectedTags.length
      ? selectedTags.map((tag) => {
          const autoMatched = matchedCodes.has(tag.tag_code);
          return `<button class="kw-dashboard-chip active" type="button" onclick="kwToggleSmartTag('${escapeHtml(tag.tag_code)}')" title="点击移除该标签">${escapeHtml(tag.label)}${autoMatched ? ' · 已识别' : ''} ×</button>`;
        }).join('')
      : '<span style="font-size:12px;color:#8899aa">在上方选择指标，或直接在下方输入与指标名完全一致的词。</span>';
  }
  if (poolHost) {
    poolHost.innerHTML = previewList.map((tag) => `<button class="kw-dashboard-chip ${selectedTagSet.has(tag.tag_code) ? 'active' : ''}" type="button" onclick="kwToggleSmartTag('${escapeHtml(tag.tag_code)}')">${escapeHtml(tag.label)}</button>`).join('');
  }
  if (toggleHost) {
    toggleHost.innerHTML = tagCatalog.length > 5
      ? `<button class="kw-dashboard-chip" type="button" onclick="kwToggleSmartTagPool()">${kwSmartIndicatorDraft.tagPoolExpanded ? '收起' : '...'}</button>`
      : '';
  }
}

function kwToggleSmartTagPool() {
  kwSmartIndicatorDraft.tagPoolExpanded = !kwSmartIndicatorDraft.tagPoolExpanded;

function kwHandleSmartIndicatorPromptInput(value) {
  const input = document.getElementById('kw-smart-indicator-draft-prompt');
  kwSmartIndicatorDraft.promptText = kwCanonicalizeSmartPrompt(value, kwGetSmartTagCatalog());
  if (input && input.value !== kwSmartIndicatorDraft.promptText) input.value = kwSmartIndicatorDraft.promptText;
  kwSmartIndicatorDraft.isGenerating = false;
  kwSmartIndicatorDraft.directIndicatorCode = '';
  kwSmartIndicatorDraft.preview = null;
  const matchedCodes = kwCollectPromptMatchedTagCodes(kwSmartIndicatorDraft.promptText, kwGetSmartTagCatalog());
  kwSmartIndicatorDraft.selectedTagCodes = (kwSmartIndicatorDraft.selectedTagCodes || [])
    .filter((code) => matchedCodes.includes(code));
  kwSmartIndicatorDraft.suppressedTagCodes = (kwSmartIndicatorDraft.suppressedTagCodes || []).filter((code) => matchedCodes.includes(code));
  kwRenderSmartIndicatorTagSelection();
}

function kwFocusSmartIndicatorPrompt() {
  const input = document.getElementById('kw-smart-indicator-draft-prompt');
  if (input) input.focus();
}

function kwToggleSmartTag(tagCode) {
  const effective = kwGetSmartIndicatorEffectiveTagCodes();
  const matched = kwCollectPromptMatchedTagCodes(kwSmartIndicatorDraft.promptText, kwGetSmartTagCatalog()).includes(tagCode);
  if (effective.includes(tagCode)) {
    kwSmartIndicatorDraft.selectedTagCodes = kwSmartIndicatorDraft.selectedTagCodes.filter((code) => code !== tagCode);
    if (matched && !(kwSmartIndicatorDraft.suppressedTagCodes || []).includes(tagCode)) kwSmartIndicatorDraft.suppressedTagCodes = (kwSmartIndicatorDraft.suppressedTagCodes || []).concat(tagCode);
  } else {
    kwSmartIndicatorDraft.suppressedTagCodes = (kwSmartIndicatorDraft.suppressedTagCodes || []).filter((code) => code !== tagCode);
    kwSmartIndicatorDraft.selectedTagCodes = kwSmartIndicatorDraft.selectedTagCodes.concat(tagCode);
  }
  kwSmartIndicatorDraft.preview = null;
  kwRenderSmartIndicatorEditorModal();
}

async function kwPreviewSmartIndicator() {
  if (kwSmartIndicatorDraft.isGenerating || kwSmartIndicatorDraft.isSaving) return;
  const nameInput = document.getElementById('kw-smart-indicator-draft-name');
  const promptInput = document.getElementById('kw-smart-indicator-draft-prompt');
  kwSmartIndicatorDraft.indicatorName = nameInput ? nameInput.value.trim() : '';
  kwSmartIndicatorDraft.promptText = kwCanonicalizeSmartPrompt(promptInput ? promptInput.value.trim() : '', kwGetSmartTagCatalog());
  if (promptInput) promptInput.value = kwSmartIndicatorDraft.promptText;
  const tenantSlug = (window.ACTIVE_TENANT && window.ACTIVE_TENANT.slug) || '';
  if (!kwSmartIndicatorDraft.promptText) {
    showToast('请先填写提示词');
    return;
  }
  const selectedTagCodes = kwGetSmartIndicatorEffectiveTagCodes();
  const directPreview = kwGetDirectPreviewCandidate(selectedTagCodes);
  if (directPreview) {
    kwSmartIndicatorDraft.isGenerating = false;
    kwSmartIndicatorDraft.selectedTagCodes = selectedTagCodes;
    kwSmartIndicatorDraft.directIndicatorCode = directPreview.indicator_code || '';
    kwSmartIndicatorDraft.preview = directPreview;
    kwRenderSmartIndicatorEditorModal();
    showToast('已直接引用指标，无需重复生成');
    return;
  }
  kwSmartIndicatorDraft.directIndicatorCode = '';
  kwSmartIndicatorDraft.isGenerating = true;
  kwSmartIndicatorDraft.preview = null;
  kwRenderSmartIndicatorEditorModal();
  try {
    const resp = await fetch(`/api/tenant/${encodeURIComponent(tenantSlug)}/smart-indicators`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        action: 'preview',
        indicator_name: kwSmartIndicatorDraft.indicatorName,
        prompt_text: kwSmartIndicatorDraft.promptText,
        selected_tag_codes: selectedTagCodes,
        suppressed_tag_codes: kwSmartIndicatorDraft.suppressedTagCodes || [],
        formula_tokens: kwTokenizeSmartPrompt(kwSmartIndicatorDraft.promptText, kwGetSmartTagCatalog()),
      }),
    });
    const payload = await resp.json();
    if (!resp.ok || !payload.success) throw new Error(payload.error || 'smart_indicator_preview_failed');
    kwSetSmartIndicatorCatalog(payload.smart_indicator_catalog);
    kwSmartIndicatorDraft.preview = payload.preview || null;
    const resolvedCodes = (kwSmartIndicatorDraft.preview && Array.isArray(kwSmartIndicatorDraft.preview.selected_indicators))
      ? kwSmartIndicatorDraft.preview.selected_indicators.map((item) => item && item.indicator_code).filter(Boolean)
      : [];
    const resolvedTagCodes = kwGetSmartTagCatalog()
      .filter((tag) => (tag.selected_indicators || []).some((item) => resolvedCodes.includes(item.indicator_code)))
      .map((tag) => tag.tag_code);
    kwSmartIndicatorDraft.selectedTagCodes = Array.from(new Set(selectedTagCodes.concat(resolvedTagCodes)));
    if (kwSmartIndicatorDraft.preview && kwSmartIndicatorDraft.preview.indicator_name) {
      kwSmartIndicatorDraft.indicatorName = kwSmartIndicatorDraft.preview.indicator_name;
    }
    kwSmartIndicatorDraft.isGenerating = false;
    kwRenderSmartIndicatorEditorModal();
  } catch (error) {
    kwSmartIndicatorDraft.isGenerating = false;
    kwRenderSmartIndicatorEditorModal();
    showToast(error.message || '预览生成失败');
  }
}

async function kwConfirmSmartIndicator() {
  if (kwSmartIndicatorDraft.isSaving) return;
  const preview = kwSmartIndicatorDraft.preview;
  if (!preview) {
    showToast('请先生成预览');
    return;
  }
  const tenantSlug = (window.ACTIVE_TENANT && window.ACTIVE_TENANT.slug) || '';
  const active = kwGetActiveDashboardConfig();
  const layout = active.layout || '2x2';
  const target = kwGetDashboardCardTarget(layout);
  const slotIndex = Number(kwSmartIndicatorDraft.slotIndex);
  if (!Number.isInteger(slotIndex) || slotIndex < 0 || slotIndex >= target) {
    showToast('请选择 Dashboard 中的空白格后再创建指标');
    return;
  }
  const selectedSlot = Array.isArray(active.cards) ? active.cards[slotIndex] : null;
  if (selectedSlot && !kwIsSmartPlaceholderCard(selectedSlot)) {
    showToast('该格已被占用，请重新选择空白格');
    return;
  }
  kwSmartIndicatorDraft.isSaving = true;
  kwRenderSmartIndicatorEditorModal();
  try {
    if (preview.direct_reference === true && preview.indicator_code) {
      const nextCards = Array.from({ length: target }, (_, index) => {
        const raw = Array.isArray(active.cards) && typeof active.cards[index] === 'object' ? active.cards[index] : {};
        const indicatorCode = String(raw.indicatorCode || raw.indicator_code || '').trim();
        return indicatorCode ? { indicatorCode } : {};
      });
      nextCards[slotIndex] = { indicatorCode: preview.indicator_code };
      await kwSyncFundDashboard('save_draft', { ...active, layout, cards: nextCards }, '已直接加入 Dashboard 草稿');
      kwSmartIndicatorEditingCode = preview.indicator_code;
      kwSmartIndicatorSelectedCodes = (preview.selected_indicators || []).map((item) => item && item.indicator_code).filter(Boolean);
      kwSmartIndicatorDraft.isSaving = false;
      kwCloseSmartIndicatorEditor();
      return;
    }
    const resp = await fetch(`/api/tenant/${encodeURIComponent(tenantSlug)}/smart-indicators`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        action: 'save',
        indicator_name: preview.indicator_name || kwSmartIndicatorDraft.indicatorName,
        prompt_text: preview.prompt_text || kwSmartIndicatorDraft.promptText,
        category: preview.category || '',
        unit: preview.unit || '',
        selected_indicators: preview.selected_indicators || [],
        formula_js: preview.formula_js || '',
        add_to_dashboard: false,
      }),
    });
    const payload = await resp.json();
    if (!resp.ok || !payload.success) throw new Error(payload.error || 'smart_indicator_save_failed');
    kwSetSmartIndicatorCatalog(payload.smart_indicator_catalog);
    const nextCards = Array.from({ length: target }, (_, index) => {
      const raw = Array.isArray(active.cards) && typeof active.cards[index] === 'object' ? active.cards[index] : {};
      const indicatorCode = raw && (raw.indicatorCode || raw.indicator_code) ? (raw.indicatorCode || raw.indicator_code) : '';
      return indicatorCode ? { indicatorCode } : {};
    });
    nextCards[slotIndex] = { indicatorCode: ((payload.definition || {}).indicator_code) || '' };
    const nextDashboard = {
      ...active,
      layout,
      cards: nextCards,
    };
    await kwSyncFundDashboard('save_draft', nextDashboard, '智能指标已加入 Dashboard 草稿');
    kwSmartIndicatorEditingCode = ((payload.definition || {}).indicator_code) || '';
    kwSmartIndicatorSelectedCodes = ((preview.selected_indicators || []).map((item) => item.indicator_code)).filter(Boolean);
    kwSmartIndicatorDraft.isSaving = false;
    kwCloseSmartIndicatorEditor();
  } catch (error) {
    kwSmartIndicatorDraft.isSaving = false;
    kwRenderSmartIndicatorEditorModal();
    showToast(error.message || '智能指标保存失败');
  }
}

function kwFindSmartIndicatorCatalogItem(indicatorCode) {
  return (kwGetSmartIndicatorCatalog().tenant_smart_indicators || []).find((entry) => entry.indicator_code === indicatorCode);
}

function kwIsSmartPlaceholderCard(card) {
  const item = card && typeof card === 'object' ? card : {};
  const indicatorCode = String(item.indicatorCode || item.indicator_code || '').trim();
  const name = String(item.name || '').trim();
  return !!(
    item.isEmpty
    || (!indicatorCode && /^待添加智能指标\s*\d*$/u.test(name))
    || (!indicatorCode && !String(item.prompt || '').trim() && !Array.isArray(item.selectedIndicators))
  );
}

function kwOpenSmartIndicatorLibraryDetail(indicatorCode) {

  kwOpenSmartIndicatorDetailModal({

    value: item.value || '--',

function kwOpenSmartIndicatorDetail(index) {
  const active = kwGetActiveDashboardConfig();

    kwOpenSmartIndicatorEditor(index);

  const catalogItem = kwFindSmartIndicatorCatalogItem(item.indicatorCode || item.indicator_code || '');

    indicatorCode: item.indicatorCode || item.indicator_code || '',
    name: item.name,
    value: item.value || '--',
    unit: item.unit || '',
    prompt: item.prompt || '',
    updatedAt: item.updatedAt || active.updatedAt || '',
    algorithmDetail: item.algorithmDetail || (catalogItem && catalogItem.algorithm_detail) || '',
    interpretation: item.interpretation || item.assessment || (catalogItem && (catalogItem.interpretation || catalogItem.assessment)) || '',
    assessmentTemplate: (catalogItem && catalogItem.assessment_template) || item.interpretation || item.assessment || '',
    alertTemplate: (catalogItem && catalogItem.alert) || '',
    selectedIndicators: item.selectedIndicators || (catalogItem && catalogItem.selected_indicators) || [],

    data_unavailable: item.data_unavailable === true || (catalogItem && catalogItem.data_unavailable === true),
    slotIndex: index,
  });
}

async function kwSaveSmartIndicatorDefinitionFromDetail(indicatorCode) {
  const item = kwFindSmartIndicatorCatalogItem(indicatorCode);
  const nameInput = document.getElementById('kw-smart-indicator-detail-name');
  const categoryInput = document.getElementById('kw-smart-indicator-detail-category');
  const unitInput = document.getElementById('kw-smart-indicator-detail-unit');
  const interpretationInput = document.getElementById('kw-smart-indicator-detail-interpretation');
  const algorithmInput = document.getElementById('kw-smart-indicator-detail-algorithm');
  const promptInput = document.getElementById('kw-smart-indicator-detail-prompt');
  const name = nameInput ? nameInput.value.trim() : '';
  const category = categoryInput ? categoryInput.value.trim() : '';
  const unit = unitInput ? unitInput.value.trim() : '';
  const interpretation = interpretationInput ? interpretationInput.value.trim() : '';
  const algorithm = algorithmInput ? algorithmInput.value.trim() : '';
  const promptText = promptInput ? promptInput.value.trim() : '';
  const tenantSlug = (window.ACTIVE_TENANT && window.ACTIVE_TENANT.slug) || '';
  if (!item || !name || !promptText) {
    showToast('名称和提示词不能为空');
    return;
  }
  kwOpenSmartIndicatorDetailModal({...cardFromSmartIndicatorItem(item), isSaving: true});
  const controller = new AbortController();
  const timeoutId = window.setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 90000);
  try {
    const resp = await fetch(`/api/tenant/${encodeURIComponent(tenantSlug)}/smart-indicators`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      signal: controller.signal,
      body: JSON.stringify({
        action: 'save',
        indicator_code: item.indicator_code,
        indicator_name: name,
        category,
        unit,
        prompt_text: promptText,
        description: algorithm,
        assessment_template: interpretation,
        alert_template: item.alert || '',
        selected_indicator_codes: (item.selected_indicators || []).map((source) => source.indicator_code).filter(Boolean),
        add_to_dashboard: false,
      }),
    });
    const payload = await resp.json();
    if (!resp.ok || !payload.success) throw new Error(payload.error || 'smart_indicator_update_failed');
    kwSetSmartIndicatorCatalog(payload.smart_indicator_catalog);
    kwFundDashboardState = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(payload.fund_dashboard_state || kwFundDashboardState || {}));
    if (window.WORKBENCH_DATA) {
      window.WORKBENCH_DATA.fund_dashboard_state = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(kwFundDashboardState || {}));
      window.WORKBENCH_DATA.fund_dashboard = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify((payload.dashboard || {}).fund_dashboard || {}));
    }
    kwCloseSmartIndicatorDetailModal();
    kwRenderDashboardPreview();
    kwRenderSmartIndicatorLibrary();
    showToast('指标已更新，结果已重新计算');
  } catch (error) {
    kwOpenSmartIndicatorDetailModal({
      ...cardFromSmartIndicatorItem(item),
      name,
      category,
      unit,
      prompt: promptText,
      algorithmDetail: algorithm,
      assessmentTemplate: interpretation,
    });
    showToast(error && error.name === 'AbortError' ? '保存超时，请检查服务端任务状态后重试' : (error.message || '指标更新失败'));
  } finally {
    window.clearTimeout(timeoutId);
  }
}

function cardFromSmartIndicatorItem(item) {
  return {
    indicatorCode: item.indicator_code,
    name: item.indicator_name,
    value: item.value !== null && item.value !== undefined && String(item.value).trim() ? item.value : '--',
    unit: item.unit || '',
    prompt: item.prompt_text || '',
    updatedAt: item.last_updated || '',
    dataAt: item.data_at || '',
    snapshotAt: item.last_updated || '',
    algorithmDetail: item.algorithm_detail || '',
    interpretation: item.interpretation || item.assessment || '',
    assessmentTemplate: item.assessment_template || item.interpretation || item.assessment || '',
    selectedIndicators: item.selected_indicators || [],
    category: item.category || '',
    data_status: item.data_status || '',
    data_status_label: item.data_status_label || '',
    data_unavailable: item.data_unavailable === true,
  };

async function kwAddExistingIndicatorToDraft(indicatorCode) {
  const active = kwGetActiveDashboardConfig();
  const layout = active.layout || '2x2';
  const target = kwGetDashboardCardTarget(layout);
  const nextCards = Array.from({ length: target }, (_, index) => {
    const item = Array.isArray(active.cards) ? active.cards[index] : null;
    const code = item && (item.indicatorCode || item.indicator_code);
    return code ? { indicatorCode: code } : {};
  });
  if (nextCards.some((item) => item.indicatorCode === indicatorCode)) {
    showToast('该指标已经在 Dashboard 草稿中');
    return;
  }
  const emptyIndex = nextCards.findIndex((item) => !item.indicatorCode);
  if (emptyIndex < 0) {
    showToast('当前布局已无空白格，请先调整布局或移出一个指标');
    return;
  }
  nextCards[emptyIndex] = { indicatorCode };
  active.cards = nextCards;
  try {
    await kwSyncFundDashboard('save_draft', active, '已加入 Dashboard 草稿');
  } catch (error) {
    showToast(error.message || '加入 Dashboard 草稿失败');
  }
}

async function kwRemoveSmartDashboardCard(index) {
  if (!window.confirm('确认只从当前 Dashboard 草稿移除这个指标吗？指标定义、快照和历史数据会保留。')) return;
  const active = kwGetActiveDashboardConfig();
  const target = kwGetDashboardCardTarget(active.layout || '2x2');
  const nextCards = Array.from({ length: target }, (_, slotIndex) => {
    const raw = Array.isArray(active.cards) && typeof active.cards[slotIndex] === 'object' ? active.cards[slotIndex] : {};
    if (slotIndex === index) return {};
    const indicatorCode = raw && (raw.indicatorCode || raw.indicator_code) ? (raw.indicatorCode || raw.indicator_code) : '';
    return indicatorCode ? { indicatorCode } : {};
  });
  active.cards = nextCards;
  try {
    await kwSyncFundDashboard('save_draft', active, '已从草稿移除，指标定义仍保留');
  } catch (error) {
    showToast(error.message || '从 Dashboard 移除失败');
  }
}

async function kwDeleteSmartIndicator(indicatorCode, fromDetail = false) {
  const tenantSlug = (window.ACTIVE_TENANT && window.ACTIVE_TENANT.slug) || '';
  if (!window.confirm('确认删除这个指标定义吗？删除后会从指标库、草稿和已发布看板移除，并清理快照与历史数据，且无法撤销。')) return;
  const item = kwFindSmartIndicatorCatalogItem(indicatorCode);
  if (fromDetail && item) kwOpenSmartIndicatorDetailModal({...cardFromSmartIndicatorItem(item), isDeleting: true});
  try {
    const resp = await fetch(`/api/tenant/${encodeURIComponent(tenantSlug)}/smart-indicators`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ action: 'delete', indicator_code: indicatorCode }),
    });
    const payload = await resp.json();
    if (!resp.ok || !payload.success) throw new Error(payload.error || 'smart_indicator_delete_failed');
    kwSetSmartIndicatorCatalog(payload.smart_indicator_catalog);
    kwFundDashboardState = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify((payload.dashboard || {}).fund_dashboard_state || kwFundDashboardState || {}));
    if (fromDetail) kwCloseSmartIndicatorDetailModal();
    kwRenderDashboardPreview();
    kwRenderSmartIndicatorLibrary();
    showToast('智能指标已删除');
  } catch (error) {
    if (fromDetail && item) kwOpenSmartIndicatorLibraryDetail(indicatorCode);
    showToast(error.message || '智能指标删除失败');
  }
}

async function loadWorkbenchHermesUsageStats() {
  if (kwHermesUsageState.loading) return;
  const tenantSlug = String(((window.ACTIVE_TENANT || {}).slug) || '').trim();
  kwHermesUsageState.loading = true;
  try {
    const resp = await fetch(`/api/kol/hermes/usage-stats?tenant=${encodeURIComponent(tenantSlug)}`);

function kwRenderDashboardPreview() {
  const previewHost = document.getElementById('kw-dashboard-preview');

  if (!previewHost || !metaHost) return;

function kwSetDashboardPublishActionState(action) {
  kwDashboardPublishAction = action || '';
  if (kwDashboardPublishActionTimer) {
    clearInterval(kwDashboardPublishActionTimer);
    kwDashboardPublishActionTimer = null;
  }
  const publishButton = document.getElementById('kw-dashboard-publish-button');
  const resetButton = document.getElementById('kw-dashboard-reset-button');
  const note = document.getElementById('kw-smart-dashboard-publish-note');
  const isPublishing = action === 'publish';
  const isRestoring = action === 'restore';
  [publishButton, resetButton].filter(Boolean).forEach((button) => {
    button.disabled = !!action;
    button.style.opacity = action ? '0.65' : '';
    button.style.cursor = action ? 'wait' : '';
  });
  const dots = '<span class="kw-publish-dots" aria-hidden="true"><span>.</span><span>.</span><span>.</span></span>';
  if (publishButton) publishButton.innerHTML = isPublishing ? `正在发布 ${dots}` : '发布到前台';
  if (resetButton) resetButton.innerHTML = isRestoring ? `正在恢复 ${dots}` : '恢复发布版';
  if (!action || !note) return;
  const renderProgress = () => {
    const message = isPublishing ? '正在发布到前台' : '正在等待服务端确认草稿已恢复';
    note.innerHTML = `${message} ${dots}`;
  };
  renderProgress();
}

async function kwPublishFundDashboard() {
  if (kwDashboardPublishAction) return;
  const draft = kwFundDashboardState && kwFundDashboardState.draft;
  if (!draft) {
    showToast('请先至少生成一个智能指标草稿');
    return;
  }
  kwSetDashboardPublishActionState('publish');
  try {
    await kwSyncFundDashboard('publish', draft, '已发布到前台 H5 和租户门户');
  } catch (error) {
    showToast(error.message || '发布失败，请稍后重试');
  } finally {
    kwSetDashboardPublishActionState('');
  }
}

async function kwResetFundDashboardDraft() {
  if (kwDashboardPublishAction) return;
  kwSetDashboardPublishActionState('restore');
  try {
    await kwSyncFundDashboard('reset_draft', null, '已恢复到当前发布版');
  } catch (error) {
    showToast(error.message || '恢复失败，请稍后重试');
  } finally {
    kwSetDashboardPublishActionState('');
  }
}
